description: Job DescriptionAbout Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. You will analyze our CRM and loyalty database to uncover insights and trends, build audiences for targeted marketing programs, and measure the incremental impact of customer campaigns.The Customer Analyst is a hands-on execution role at the heart of our Understand & Activate Customer agenda. Working within our modern data lake environment (Azure + Databricks), you will support the full analytics lifecycle: building audiences and test/control designs, running campaign measurement, performing customer segmentation, and delivering ad hoc analysis that informs CRM, Marketing, and Merchandising decisions. This is a hybrid role reporting into the support center at Legacy West in Plano Texas.ResponsibilitiesCampaign Measurement & Reporting including vendor-funded targeted offers (35%) Campaign Analysis: Analyze the performance of CRM and marketing campaigns (email, SMS, push, direct mail) and recommend opportunities to improve performance, targeting, and incremental revenue.  Test vs. Control Execution: Support the execution of the Test & Learn measurement framework, ensuring flawless setup of customer targeting, test and control groups, and statistically sound performance readouts.  Loyalty Program Health: Conduct recurring analysis of the loyalty database to assess overall program health, including enrollment, engagement, redemption, and retention trends.  Reporting Hygiene: Follow and help maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for campaign measurement, reporting consistency, and data integrity. Customer Segmentation & Audience Building (30%) Audience Development: Build campaign audiences and customer segments based on transactional and behavioral data (e.g., RFM, lifecycle stage, category engagement) to drive more relevant targeted communications.  Retention, Upsell & Cross-Sell: Perform segmentation for campaigns that are critical drivers of customer retention, upsell, and cross-sell, generating significant incremental revenue.  Model Support: Assist in developing and scoring propensity models to identify customers who are likely to respond, increase visitation, or defect. Data Analysis & Ad Hoc Insights (25%) Ad Hoc Agility: Deliver timely ad hoc analysis in support of CRM, Marketing, and Merchandising questions, balancing speed with accuracy.  Customer 360 Understanding: Integrate information from a variety of data sources (transactions, loyalty, digital, campaign response) to arrive at a broader understanding of the SALLY and BSG customer.  Insight Communication: Summarize findings into clear, well-organized outputs (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI) that senior analysts and business partners can act on. Data Quality & Collaboration (10%) Data Stewardship: Help ensure accuracy and consistency of customer data used in analyses and downstream reporting tools (Power BI, dashboards).  Team Collaboration: Partner with senior analysts, data science, CRM, and marketing teams; proactively share learnings and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and business curiosity. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities RequirementsEducation & Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics/Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Marketing Analytics, or related field required.  Experience: 2+ years of directly related experience in data, customer, CRM, or marketing analytics.  Industry: Experience in a Retail, CPG, and/or agency marketing environment preferred.  CRM Exposure: Experience in CRM or loyalty analytics (Email/SMS/Push) is preferred. Technical Skills Core Languages: Proficiency in SQL and Python required.  Big Data & Cloud: Exposure to Databricks, Spark/PySpark, or cloud data environments (Azure/AWS) is a plus; willingness to learn is required.  Statistical Knowledge: Foundational understanding of hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and segmentation techniques (e.g., RFM, clustering).  Visualization: Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools is a plus.  Presentation: Strong Excel skills and the ability to build clear, well-structured PowerPoint outputs. Competencies & attributesAbility to “connect the dots” across disparate data points and communicate findings clearly. A self-starter with strong attention to detail who is eager to learn, takes ownership of deliverables, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving data environment. Passionate Learner – inquisitive about the business; open to feedback and coaching, applies learning quickly; applies learning to improve processes and procedures, proactively shares learning with colleagues and leaders  Flexible & Agile Adapter – responsive and open to change; works well with ambiguity; adapts to new plans or directions; keeps calm under pressure; perseveres to achieve the plan/task; doesn't dwell on the past  Effective Communicator – articulates in an appropriate and accurate manner; emotionally astute while remaining authentic to own style/self; demonstrates active listening and uses probing questions; is concise and relevant with data/info  Team Builder – references the importance of teamwork and actively demonstrates collaboration and sharing; participates in effective teams; values the importance of inclusion and various sources of thought/input; humble when operating within a team  Customer Focused Partner – understands internal and external customer needs; contributes to plans and actions to improve the associate and customer journey/experience; holds self accountable for improving the customer experience; is an advocate for the customer  Results Driver – effective at delivering on plans; holds self accountable to a high standard of delivery; focuses on the right priorities and uses resources/time wisely; demonstrates grit and determination  Problem Solver & Decision Maker – able to consume department/operational data to identify business opportunities; identifies, gathers, and examines the relevant information; makes recommendations and takes action to solve challenges Working Conditions & Physical RequirementsThe typical working environment is in the support center office, and the work is sedentary. Typically, the associate may sit comfortably to do the job. However, some tasks and activities may be walking, standing, bending, carrying light items such as papers, files, books, and small parts, driving an automobile to a store location, etc. These activities are not frequent and do not require significant physical demands to perform the work.While involving everyday risks or discomforts, the work environment is designed with standard safety precautions. These precautions, typical of offices, meeting and training rooms, retail stores, residences, or commercial vehicles, include using safe work practices with office equipment, avoiding trips and falls, observing fire regulations and traffic signals, etc. The work area is adequately lighted, heated, and ventilated, ensuring the safety and comfort of our associates.BenefitsWe offer a competitive salary and outstanding benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life Insurance, paid vacation and sick days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement and 401(k) with company match. Model Support: Assist in developing and scoring propensity models to identify customers who are likely to respond, increase visitation, or defect. Insight Communication: Summarize findings into clear, well-organized outputs (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI) that senior analysts and business partners can act on. It’s the spirit we share with the people that fly with us, our partners, and our colleagues.So, whether you are a reassuring voice on the end of a phone, a smile at the door, under a wing keeping the turbines spinning or landing us gently in far-flung places, a job at British Airways is yours to make.We know great things can happen when you’re inspired to think big and bring your ambition to work every day, which is why, at British Airways the sky is never the limit.The role: Digital Analytics & Insights AnalystHow do you improve a digital experience used by millions of customers worldwide?Join the Digital Performance Analytics team within Commercial Leisure Strategy, Planning & Analytics and help shape the future of BA.com and the British Airways app. From booking a flight to managing a trip, our digital platforms are a key part of every customer's journey.Curious about why customers behave the way they do? Love turning data into ideas that make a real difference? This could be the role for you!Working with Product, Digital and Commercial teams, you'll use customer, digital and commercial data to uncover opportunities, solve problems and influence decisions. Whether it's understanding customer behaviour, improving a digital journey or testing a new idea, your insights will help create better experiences for our customers and better outcomes for the business.What You'll DoImprove customer journeys across BA.com and the British Airways app.Use data from analytics tools, customer research, surveys and session replays to uncover actionable insights.Support experimentation and A/B testing to help teams learn what works best.Turn business questions into clear analysis and practical recommendations.Spot opportunities to improve customer engagement, conversion and digital performance.Deliver insight, reporting and forecasting to support key business decisions.Bring data to life through engaging storytelling and stakeholder presentations. Leverage AI-driven tools to transform analytical processes, generate actionable insights and provide data-led recommendations.What You'll BringA curious mindset, strong analytical skills and a passion for solving problems. You'll enjoy digging into data, spotting patterns and turning complex information into clear recommendations.You'll also be a confident communicator who can build relationships, challenge thinking and influence decisions through insight.Your ExperienceExperience analysing data and delivering actionable insights.Experience working with digital, customer or online performance data.Strong analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.Experience presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders.Experience using analytics, reporting or visualisation tools.Qualifications demonstrating analytical capability.Exposure to AI and AI-powered analytics tools would be an advantage.What We OfferWe believe that all the people who work with us should feel valued for the part they play. It’s one of the reasons our rewards go far beyond a competitive salary.From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways flights. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.At British Airways you’ll have the chance to take on new challenges and move forward in a way that feels right for you. We encourage all those who work for us to consider opportunities right across our business to help you develop and progress.We never stand still, and we don’t expect our people to either.Inclusion & DiversityAt British Airways we all have a part to play in creating an inclusive place to work. Diverse representation among our people is really important to us and we recognise that all our colleagues are uniquely different and bring their own originality, creativity and identity to work.Inclusion and diversity is a key driver of innovation and we’re committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they can be themselves. We’re looking for people from all backgrounds and cultures to join us and be a part of our journey to become a Better BA as we continue to connect Britain with the world and the world with Britain.

title: Senior Analyst, Marketing Operations
description: We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Senior Analyst, Marketing Operations.This role sits primarily within the Marketing Operations team and is responsible for the delivery of targeted customer communications across email, SMS and other owned channels. The successful candidate will lead audience selection, segmentation, campaign execution and quality assurance to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, on time and in line with business objectives.Working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, Commercial and Customer Insight teams, the role requires strong communication and relationship-building skills to gather requirements, provide expert guidance on campaign targeting and execution, and ensure activity is aligned with business priorities.A key part of the role is understanding data compliance requirements and ensuring all activity adheres to these standards. In addition, the role will support the Customer Insight team through digital and behavioural insight, campaign performance analysis and ad hoc reporting where required.What you will be doing:Support the end-to-end delivery of marketing campaigns across email, SMS and push notifications in line with the Club's campaign schedule.Interpret campaign briefs and execute audience targeting requirements through customer segmentation and data selection.Build, test, QA and deploy campaigns, ensuring accuracy, compliance and best practice across all customer communications.Create and maintain audience segments for email, SMS, CRM and social media activation.Support the optimisation and development of automated, triggered and lifecycle marketing programmes.Act as a key point of contact for stakeholders across the business, translating marketing objectives into effective customer targeting and campaign delivery plans.Build strong relationships with Marketing, Commercial, Digital and Customer Insight teams to understand requirements, manage expectations and provide campaign delivery expertise.Facilitate campaign planning discussions and provide recommendations on segmentation strategy, channel selection and customer contact strategy.Clearly communicate campaign outcomes, optimisation opportunities and operational considerations to both technical and non-technical audiences.Maintain accurate campaign documentation, processes and operational records to ensure consistency and business continuity.Support compliance with GDPR, regulatory and information security requirements, investigating data issues and maintaining appropriate system administration controls.Produce campaign performance reports and provide data to support marketing measurement and optimisation.Analyse customer, digital and behavioural data to provide actionable insights and recommendations where required.Create insight reports and dashboards that support the Customer Insight team and wider business stakeholders.Manage ad hoc requests for customer and marketing insights and attend cross-functional meetings to understand business requirements.What we are looking for:The ideal candidate will have strong experience in CRM, marketing operations and data-driven campaign delivery, particularly within email and SMS marketing. You will be highly organised, detail-focused and comfortable managing multiple concurrent campaigns while ensuring excellent levels of accuracy and compliance.You will be an excellent communicator who enjoys working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders. Able to translate business requirements into actionable campaign plans, you will confidently manage relationships, challenge constructively where required and communicate complex data or technical concepts in a clear and engaging way. Support for customer insight and performance reporting will form an important but secondary aspect of the role.You will be educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant discipline such as Business, Marketing, Mathematics or Statistics and will ideally have an understanding of commercial operations within a sports or membership-based environment.Technically, you will have strong MS Office skills, especially Excel and hands‑on experience with email marketing and automation platforms. You will also be a confident communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills, capable of translating business requirements into effective campaign solutions and explaining technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.You will demonstrate good knowledge of GDPR and data protection, experience using data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and an understanding of Google Analytics and key digital marketing metrics. SQL experience for data querying and experience working in cloud environments such as AWS or Azure and with DotDigital, particularly automated and triggered programs, would be highly desirable. You will also have an appreciation of database structures, data quality principles, and familiarity with agile methodologies. Experience presenting campaign performance, recommendations and operational updates to stakeholders is highly desirable, as is the ability to influence decision-making through a combination of data, insight and strong communication.Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%Life Assurance CoverFree financial guidance and mortgage adviceCar salary sacrifice scheme for affordable drivingCycle to Work scheme to keep you activePurchase season ticket loans for easier commutingExclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailersWill Writing Service for future planningEmployee Assistance Programme for confidential supportMedicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needsVolunteering opportunities to give back to the communitySpecial LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdfAt Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.#LFCJobs

title: Analyst, EMEA Customer Research - A&F Co.
description: At Abercrombie & Fitch, the EMEA Customer Research Analyst is a London-based in-house resource for brand and business partners across the region. A key advocate for the EMEA customer, this role is responsible for designing, executing and communicating high-quality customer research that informs brand, marketing, merchandising, and strategic decisions across both the Abercrombie & Fitch and Hollister brands. The Analyst will work closely with the Customer Insights Manager and cross-functional partners, including global insights, brand strategy, merchandising, marketing, and digital teams, to ensure insights are translated into action.The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the fashion retail industry, strong foundational research skills (qual and quant), exceptional analytical capabilities, as well as clear and confident communication skills (written and verbal). Alongside an insatiable curiosity about our customers, they will also bring a passion for problem-solving and for delivering clear, compelling, data-driven narratives to inspire customer-centric decision-making.This job is located at our Home Office in London, UK.What Will You Be Doing? Executing primary research initiatives inclusive of writing briefs, programming surveys, moderating research engagements, synthesising actions/recommendations, delivering concise/impactful written reports Influencing business actions by translating insights into clear, actionable recommendations that support brand, marketing and product decisions across EMEA Supporting London-based cross-functional teams by representing and sharing knowledge of the EMEA customer consistently and effectively Working collaboratively with cross-regional analytics and insights teams to bring the holistic, global customer narrative to life for internal business stakeholders Contributing to the on-going evolution of the Customer Insights discipline at A&F Co. especially as it relates to learning about and strategically implementing new research technologies and techniques Additional responsibilities may include: research community management, project coordination, participant recruitment, report cataloguing, brand health tracking, etc. What Do You Need To Bring? Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience Minimum 4 years in a customer/marketing research, analytics or other related role Minimum 2 years of experience conducting primary quant and qual research utilising research communities/panels, survey platforms (e.g., Qualtrics, Alchemer) and MS Office programmes (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint) Methodological expertise and excellence with the ability and passion to implement research best practices to tell a cohesive and actionable story Experience conducting advanced quantitative methodologies such as segmentation, Max/Diff, Conjoint, longitudinal brand tracking and comfortable moderating qualitative engagements such as focus groups and IDIs Proven ability to independently drive projects to conclusion and work effectively with a variety of cross-functional partners from various levels within a company Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity, structure and stakeholder-oriented storytelling A deep empathy for both the customer and your team's goals Positive, proactive, solutions-oriented attitude, with strong accountability and a collaborative mindset Willingness to travel – quarterly domestic or regional travel will be a requirement of this role Experience working in a Retail/eCommerce environment is strongly preferred Fluency in German a strong plus Our Company Abercrombie & Fitch Co. is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.The company operates a family of brands, including Abercrombie & Fitch, YPB, abercrombie kids, Hollister and Gilly Hicks, each sharing a commitment to offer products of enduring quality and exceptional comfort that support global customers on their journey to being and becoming who they are. Abercrombie & Fitch Co. operates over 750 stores under these brands across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East, as well as the e-commerce sites abercrombie.com, abercrombiekids.com, and hollisterco.com.At Abercrombie & Fitch Co., we lead with purpose and always put our people first. We’re proud to offer equitable compensation and benefits, including flexibility and competitive Paid Time Off, as well as education and engagement events, including various Associate Resource Groups, volunteer opportunities and additional time off to give back to our global communities. Benefits & PerksAs an Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward: Incentive bonus program401(K) savings plan with company matchAnnual companywide review process Flexible spending accounts Medical, dental and vision insurance Life and disability insurance Associate assistance program Paid parental and adoption leave Access to fertility and adoption benefits through Carrot Access to mental health and wellness app, HeadspacePaid Caregiver LeaveMobile StipendPaid time off and one paid volunteer day per year, allowing you to give back to your community Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles and six work from anywhere weeks per year) Seven associate wellness half days per year Merchandise discount on all of our brands Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within Access to multiple Associate Resource Groups Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

title: Business Intelligence Analyst, GBM
description: ResponsibilitiesAbout the TeamGlobal Business Marketing (GBM) at TikTok is at an inflection point. As the business evolves from establishing its brand presence to driving measurable commercial growth, the way we analyse, interpret and act on marketing performance needs to evolve with it. This role sits at the heart of that shift.About the RoleGBM Strategy & Operations exists to transform strategic ambition into operational reality. A core part of that is ensuring that every marketing initiative we run, across every hub sub-function and every region, is measured against what it actually delivers for the business, not just what it produced in activity terms.This is the role that owns that capability. As the leading Analyst, Performance & Insights, you will be the connective layer between GBM's global and regional teams, the Business Analytics organisation, building the measurement governance, analytical infrastructure, and commercial intelligence that allows the business to track impact against our P0 priorities, with New Client Acquisition and Marketing ROI as the two primary lens.This is an experienced, hands on, individual contributor role for someone who isn't afraid to get their hands dirty while  owning the measurement backbone of a global marketing function, not just report against it. You will work at the intersection of data, commercial strategy, and cross-functional governance, and your output will directly inform executive decision-making and business planning. Examples of key outputs include adhoc executive-level analysis reports and QBRs. ResponsibilitiesMeasurement Governance & Infrastructure- Own and operationalise GBM's measurement governance framework — the methodology, standards, and processes that define how marketing impact is tracked consistently across global hub teams and regional spokes- Design, govern, and continuously improve the performance dashboards and reporting infrastructure used across global and regional S&O- Set data governance standards and ensure data integrity and consistency across reporting sourcesCommercial Intelligence & P0 Priority Tracking- Lead the tracking and reporting of impact against GBM's P0 business priorities, with New Client Acquisition as the primary focus area- Produce executive-level analysis and QBR reporting that connects marketing execution to business outcomes, translating data into clear commercial narratives for leadership- Lead deep-dive root cause analysis when performance diverges from plan, and partner with regional teams to understand and act on those findingsMarTech & Cross-Functional Partnership- Serve as the primary S&O interface with MarTech and the MSO organisation on data infrastructure, measurement tooling, and how commercial intelligence flows between teams- Partner with integrated marketing teams, including digital channels and events, on attribution and channel performance measurement, ensuring what is being tracked reflects real commercial impactRegional Alignment- Work closely with regional S&O leads to ensure a consistent measurement methodology is applied across all regions- Working with multiple regional stakeholders within the broader marketing team and business analytics team across different timezones and culturesQualificationsMinimum Qualification(s)- Minimum 5+ years of experience in advanced analytics, business intelligence, or performance insights role- Proven ability to translate complex data into executive-ready narratives, comfortable presenting to and influencing leadership- Strong understanding of marketing ecosystems and how data flows between marketing, sales, and commercial operations, including familiarity with business analytics teams or equivalent commercial operations environments- Strong SQL skills, with the ability to independently explore, transform, and validate data. Proficiency in Python for advanced analysis. Experience with A/B testing and experimental design.- Proficiency in building visualizations and reports using tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar.- Commercially oriented, you think about marketing in terms of outcomes, not just outputsPreferred Qualification(s)- Experience in a marketing, media, or platform business- Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can manage multiple workstreams and deadlines without dropping the ball- Clear written and verbal communicator, able to present findings in a way that is easy to understand and act on- A bias toward simplification and action, not just strategising but being able to follow through with building systems and frameworks that make things clearer, not more complex- Genuine curiosity about business to business marketing and GTM impact- Exposure to or interest in B2B marketing environments or commercial go-to-market models- Familiarity with OKR frameworks, planning cycles or reporting processes- Some exposure to media attribution or marketing performance measurement, even at an introductory level- Experience or interest in working across multiple markets or culturesAbout TikTokTikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​Why Join UsInspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an Always Day 1 mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​​Diversity & Inclusion​TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Experimental Excellence: Lead the design and evaluation of complex A/B tests. Ensure we aren't just measuring lift, but understanding the long-term impact on subscriber value and retention. Holistic Storytelling: Collaborate with the Research and Data Science teams to integrate qualitative survey data with quantitative behavioral data, creating a complete view of the customer. Data Governance & Quality: Ensure the integrity of our tracking. Work with Insight Products to ensure our data observability allows for decentralized, high-speed insight creation. Talent Development: Act as a mentor to other team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, technical rigor, and commercial urgency. You take personal agency for commercial outcomes. Experience of building or commissioning marketing mix models and deterministic attribution models is a must-have - as is demonstrable experience of apply these capabilities to deliver measurable commercial outcomes Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO): Working with the acquisition and product teams to measure and optimise traffic volumes, conversion rates and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) of our B2C websites and apps. You should have experience with large-scale data environments [ e.g. Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery], visualization tools (e.g. Tableau) and digital analytics [e.g. Amplitude, Adobe or Google Analytics] Trusted Advisor Exceptional ability to translate technical findings for C-suite and non-technical stakeholders. Regular deep dives to diagnose and quantify performance drivers - and to identify quantified improvement opportunities - are an important element of this role. You will be routinely asked to advise very senior stakeholders on high-stakes decisions. T-Shaped Professional: Deep expertise in subscription/behavioral analytics with a broad understanding of how consumer research, market intelligence, data science and AI can be integrated into the analyst workflow. Rigorous Methodology: Experience in advanced analytical techniques such as causal inference modelling or econometrics to distinguish between correlation and causation. Leadership Presence: Experience in leading projects or small teams, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations, make decisions, deliver quickly and prioritize high-value work under pressure. People Leadership: Demonstrated track record of developing more junior team members and of lifting the performance and capabilities of your team. Has an ambition to move into a formal people management role in the future. Desirable ExperienceDomain Expertise: Prior experience in a B2C subscription, media, or e-commerce environment is highly desirable Advanced Tooling: Experience is Python/R for advanced statistical analysis. AI Integration: A forward-thinking approach to, and a track record of, using AI tools to a] increase the speed and quality of routine analytical tasks and b] improve the quality and usability of our outputs Pricing Insight : Experience in modelling, forecasting and measuring the impact of pricing, promotional and discounting strategies Working ArrangementsThe majority of our roles operate on a hybrid working pattern, with 3+ days office attendance required.AI usage for your applicationWe are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We provide centralized sales, marketing, underwriting, and operational support that helps our companies unlock their full growth potential.With hundreds of specialty insurance programs and partnerships and more than 20,000 agent and broker relationships nationwide, DOXA’s rapid growth is reaching new heights.Our rapid evolution means we can deliver on something most companies just talk about: building a workplace where talented professionals are drawn to the impact they can make. We offer competitive benefits and compensation, but what really differentiates us is our culture of empowerment and commitment to innovation in the specialty insurance space.If you're a marketing professional who thrives at the intersection of strategy, storytelling, and execution, we’d love to talk. Ready to join a community of experts redefining the specialty insurance space?Why AGIA?AGIA Affinity is an established but growing insurance and benefits marketing partner to some of the largest and most iconic associations and organizations in the country. Our clients include many veterans' organizations, fraternal organizations, loyalty programs, and more. Ensuring that our client’s members have the coverages they need when they need it is at the heart of everything we do. For 66 years we have sought to improve the lives of not only our client members but our internal members as well.What Are The Benefits?AGIA offers health benefits including medical, dental, and vision, 401K with 100% company match up to 3% of your annual income and an additional 50% match on the next 2% of income, a prefunded optional FSA , 100% covered Life Insurance, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Short Term/Long Term Disability, and a $250 Wellness Benefit. Our medical plan has in-network provider coverage for mental health, reproduction, chiropractic, and massage therapy.DescriptionWe are seeking a Marketing Project Coordinator to ensure the successful implementation of marketing campaigns by owning and directing end-to-end project execution with accuracy and on-time delivery. In this role, you will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to support consistent, high-quality campaign delivery, including campaign execution, analytics collection and reporting, and shared corporate initiatives that contribute to business goals and revenue projections.The ideal candidate is highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong project coordination skills, a collaborative mindset, and an interest in using performance insights to continuously improve campaign results.This role will focus on supporting Unemployment Services Trust (UST), an AGIA client. Learn more about UST at ChooseUST.org.Key ResponsibilitiesManage Marketing Campaigns Identify, develop, and execute digital and direct response marketing campaigns for assigned clients/partners as defined in assigned marketing plans. Own end-to-end campaign execution using defined processes and marketing technology platforms to ensure accuracy, quality, and on-time delivery. Coordinate campaign tasks across internal stakeholders to manage timelines, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables. Leverage historical campaign results, product knowledge, and current marketing materials to support effective execution and testing. Maintain documentation, schedules, and project tracking to support consistent delivery and process adherence.Analyze Results and Recommend Strategy Assist in analyzing historical marketing results to recommend creative and segmentation strategies that meet or exceed revenue projections. Apply basic statistical principles to determine appropriate test quantities and configurations for valid creative testing (A/B testing). Support analytics collection and reporting by compiling campaign results and performance insights for internal teams and external partners.Support Partner Relationships Support partner relationships by providing marketing reports and responding to external communications in a timely, professional manner. Communicate with partners to obtain approvals on marketing campaigns and creative assets. Share campaign strategy information and performance results with internal stakeholders (e.g., Business Development) and, as needed, directly with external partners. Help ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across channels by collaborating closely with internal teams and external vendors.Travel up to 10% for in-person meetings. Other duties as assigned.RequirementsQualificationsThe Ideal Candidate Will Possess: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 1+ year of marketing experience applying direct response principles and methodologies. 1+ year of project management experience (or experience working on a project team). Experience executing email campaigns using CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Mailchimp, HubSpot). Familiarity with design principles and creative tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva). Exposure to multi-channel marketing (digital, direct mail, blogs, social media, advertising). Experience working with internal and external stakeholders; strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience with social media scheduling tools; copy writing and design for a variety of social media channels. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneDrive). Comfort with ambiguity, learning new processes quickly, and improving performance through testing and iteration (A/B testing). Knowledge of webinar tools, including registration setup and post-event follow up logistics. Ability to coordinate conference materials, exhibit shipments, and event logistics Experience maintaining marketing inventory and ordering printed materials Ability to coordinate direct mail campaigns, including vendor communication, production timelines, mailing lists, and fulfillment.Benefits & Work EnvironmentDOXA Insurance Holdings offers a dynamic work environment and a collaborative culture. Our headquarters is located on the 10th floor of the Indiana Michigan building at 101 E. Washington in the revitalized downtown Fort Wayne, Indiana.Salary Description$55,000-$65,000 per year

title: Senior Loyalty & CRM Specialist EMEA
description: Who We AreKontoor Brands is a portfolio of three of the world’s most iconic lifestyle, outdoor and workwear brands: Wrangler®, Lee® and Helly Hansen®. We design high-quality apparel that empowers self-expression. Be part of our global community of more than 10,000 employees, fostering collaboration and innovation. Join us in our Geneva office and help shape the future with us.What’s the scope?As a Senior Loyalty & CRM Specialist EMEA you will Lead the strategic development, optimization and execution of loyalty and CRM programs for Lee & Wrangler in EMEA. You will enhance customer retention, grow customer lifetime value, increase engagement, and drive database growth through seamless, personalized experiences across customer touchpoints, including marketing, eCommerce, and retail channels.As our Senior Loyalty & CRM Specialist EMEA, your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:Loyalty & CRM Strategy: Define, execute and nurture a loyalty program that boosts retention, lifetime value, and advocacy; own the CRM roadmap across digital and physical (Direct to Consumer) touchpoints. Customer Data & Segmentation: Manage the CDP for advanced personalization; create data‑driven segmentation; ensure GDPR compliance.Email & Direct Marketing (e.g. SMS): Design, deliver and oversee email campaigns, customer journeys and automated CRM workflows (welcome series, win‑back, rewards etc.); collaborate with brand and eCom teams for consistent omni channel messaging.Performance Analysis & Optimization: Track CRM/loyalty KPIs, conduct A/B tests, optimize campaigns; present insights to stakeholders.EmailCampaign Planning & Execution:Develop and manage a comprehensive email marketing calendar, aligning with marketing, e-commerce, and seasonal campaigns.Design, build, and deploy a variety of email campaigns, including promotional, informational, transactional (e.g., order confirmations, shipping updates), and lifecycle-triggered emails.Collaborate with creative teams (designers, copywriters) to produce visually compelling and on-brand email content that drives engagement and conversions.Implement A/B testing strategies for subject lines, content, calls-to-action (CTAs), send times, and design elements to continually optimize email performance.Automation & updates (e.g., order status), and loyalty program notifications.Ensure SMS messaging is concise, impactful, and compliant with relevant regulations (e.g., local telecommunication laws, marketing opt-in requirements).Integration & PersonalizationIntegrate SMS campaigns with the CRM and CDP to leverage customer data for personalized messaging and audience segmentation.Explore and implement automated SMS flows as part of broader customer journeys (e.g., welcome SMS, loyalty point updates).Performance MonitoringTrack key SMS metrics such as delivery rates, open rates, click-through rates, and conversion rates, using insights to refine future campaigns.LoyaltyProgram Design & Management:Lead the end-to-end development and ongoing management of the loyalty programs for Lee & Wrangler in EMEA.Define loyalty program tiers, rewards, benefits, and redemption mechanisms that align with brand objectives and customer preferences.Continuously evaluate and refine the loyalty program structure to maximize member engagement, retention, and advocacy.Member Engagement & CommunicationDevelop targeted communications to loyalty members, including personalized offers, status updates, and exclusive content.Strategize and execute campaigns to encourage loyalty member participation, point accumulation, and reward redemption.Performance & ROITrack and report on loyalty program KPIs, including member acquisition, retention rates, lifetime value, engagement metrics, and return on investment (ROI).Analyze loyalty data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.CRM (Customer Relationship Management)CRM Roadmap Ownership:Own and evolve the CRM roadmap, identifying new opportunities to enhance customer relationships and drive lifetime value.Champion the strategic use of CRM across marketing, e-commerce, and retail channels to ensure a unified customer view and consistent interactions.Customer Lifecycle ManagementDevelop and implement strategies for managing customers across their entire lifecycle, from acquisition and onboarding to retention, growth, and potential win-back.Identify key moments in the customer journey where CRM interventions can maximize engagement and value.Cross-functional CollaborationServe as the central point of contact for CRM initiatives, fostering strong collaboration with marketing, e-commerce, retail, sales, and customer service teams to ensure alignment and consistency in customer interactions.Provide guidance and support to other departments on CRM best practices and system utilization.CDP (Customer Data Platform)Data Integration & Management:Act as the primary owner and expert for the Customer Data Platform (CDP) for the Region of EMEA.Oversee the ingestion and integration of customer data from various sources (e.g., e-commerce platform, POS, website, mobile app, CRM) into the CDP, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.Develop and maintain a robust data governance framework for customer data within the CDP, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and internal policies.Advanced Segmentation & PersonalizationLeverage the CDP's capabilities to create highly granular and dynamic customer segments based on demographics, behavior, purchase history, preferences, and engagement levels.Utilize CDP insights to drive advanced personalization across all marketing channels, including email, SMS, website, and retail experiences.Data Activation & OrchestrationActivate customer data segments and profiles from the CDP to power targeted marketing campaigns and personalized experiences across various platforms (e.g., ESP, SMS platform, ad platforms).Collaborate with IT and data engineering teams to optimize data flows and ensure the CDP is fully utilized for strategic initiatives.Skills For Success5+ years of experience in CRM, loyalty marketing, or customer retention within e commerce or retail environments.Expertise in CRM platforms, loyalty programs, and Customer Data Platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, BlueConic).Strong analytical and segmentation skills, capable of translating data into targeted, personalized campaigns.Excellent project‑management abilities, with a proven track record of leading initiatives from strategy to execution.Experience managing within cross‑functional digital and retail teams, ensuring alignment and delivery across stakeholders.Fluent in English (written & verbal), any other European language is an advantage.Strong communication skills & presentation skills.Highly motivated and great Team player.We OfferWe value trust and transparency and focus on collaboration and teamwork. We live by our clear Purpose, Mission & Values where we strive for continuous innovation & cutting-edge sustainable technology.We offer competitive benefits, perks and personal development opportunities;Attractive salary package;Discount on our brands; Lee® & Wrangler®.Casual Denim dress code in the office and outside of work;Multi-cultural, diverse and inclusive workforce where we foster many different nationalities;Employee resource groups focusing on diversity, sustainability, wellbeing and social activities;Development opportunities in a growth-driven environment;Benefits of a global company.Why Kontoor Brands?At Kontoor, we offer a comprehensive benefit package to fit your lifestyle. Our benefits are crafted with the same care as our products.When our employees are healthy, secure, and well, they bring their best selves to work. Kontoor Brands supports you with a competitive benefits program that provides choice and flexibility to meet your and your family’s needs – now and in the future. We offer resources to support your physical, emotional, social, and financial wellbeing, plus benefits like discounts on our apparel. Kontoor Brands also provides four weeks of Paid Parental Leave to eligible employees who are new parents, Flexible Fridays, and Tuition Reimbursement.We are proud to offer a workplace culture centered on equitable opportunities and a sense of belonging for all team members. Here we have a global workforce of high-performing teams that both unlocks our individual uniqueness and harnesses our collaborative talents.

title: Commercial Excellence & Analytics Trainee - Geneva
description: OM Pharma is an international biopharmaceutical company specialized in the prevention of respiratory and urinary tract infections. As a committed local player, we train and support the talents of tomorrow through meaningful and educational internships.In this context, we are offering a paid 6-month internship within our Marketing team, with a start date to be agreed or as soon as possible. Under the guidance of our Commercial Excellence & Analytics Lead, your mission is to transform data into meaningful insights. You support the team in delivering business intelligence and market analyses that guide strategic commercial and marketing decisions. You also create, maintain, and improve dashboards and visualizations that enable data-driven decision-making across the business.Your Main Tasks Are The FollowingCollaborate with Brand Leads and cross-functional teams to deliver analyses that support commercial and marketing decision-makingContribute to the analysis of product performance and commercial strategies across countries, regions, and product portfoliosPrepare analytical reports, insights, and presentation materials for the commercial team and senior managementParticipate in and support ad hoc market research projects to generate actionable business insightsContribute to forecasting and market potential assessments to support product launches and identify growth opportunities in strategic marketsDevelop, update, and maintain Power BI dashboards to track commercial and market performance indicatorsEnsure the quality, consistency, and harmonization of data used for reporting and analysisTo carry out these activities, we are looking for a person with the following profile:Currently pursuing Master’s program in Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Intelligence, or Life Sciences with a minor in Data Science - including a mandatory 6 month internship covered by a tripartite agreement with your universityBackground, experience, or demonstrated interest in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medtech environmentsGood understanding of data modeling and dashboard design principles, with the ability to analyze large datasetsStrong proficiency in Microsoft Office, with solid expertise in Power BI; SQL and Python are considered an assetFluent in English; knowledge of French and/or Spanish is an advantageThis Internship Will Enable You ToGain hands-on experience in international pharmaceutical environment and understand how teams collaborate to support data-driven decision-makingDevelop your skills in Business Intelligence and marketing analytics, with a focus on transforming data into actionable insights that inform commercial strategy and performance monitoringWork with real business data and contribute to the development of dashboards, reports, and analyses used by senior stakeholdersLearn from experienced and passionate professionals who will support your technical and professional development throughout the internshipYou are a curious and analytical individual with an interest in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and data-driven decision-making. You are a team player who is eager to learn and comfortable working both independently and within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. You have good communication and interpersonal skills, enabling you to collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.If you are passionate about Business Intelligence and eager to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic environment, this internship is an excellent opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow. We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!About UsOM Pharma is a global Geneva-based biopharmaceutical company. It is a leader in the prevention of recurrent respiratory and urinary tract infections and is also active in the treatment of vascular diseases.It operates worldwide through a strong network of international partners and invests its profits in R&D to develop microbial derived immunotherapeutic products to treat acute and chronic immunological disorders resulting from inflammation and infections.The company strives to improve the quality of life of patients around the world by providing access to better treatment of immunological imbalances.For more information, visit the website: ompharma.com .

title: (Senior) Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description: Job Description:Location:Zurich: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf (Hybrid – 4 days in the office)Berlin: Erkelenzdamm 11-13, 10999 Berlin (Hybrid – 3 days in the office)Who We ArePflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest-growing health-tech scale-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale-up. We're building an e-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.What You'll OwnThe paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end-to-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well-maintained feeds.Meta & creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day-to-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E-Commerce, stress-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or just grew that way, you challenge it.The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.What You Bring3+ years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale-up, or agencyHands-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboardA data-driven understanding of marketing and e-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendationOwnership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for oneComfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and qualityGerman and English Nice to haveExperience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feedsFamiliarity with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platformBasic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agenciesKnowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analyticsAn affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deepWhy this role0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.How we operate — non-negotiable:Insanely great for families — delivered nowForget mere satisfaction. We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is insanely great, period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.Speed is king — ruthless focus is keyVelocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the #1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.Raise the bar — crush mediocrityMediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerateBuild momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. It can't be done means you haven't figured it out yet — go do it. Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.Act like owners — bold bets, fast actionThis is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.The bottom line:We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!____________________________________________________________________________________________________________Deutsch:Wer wir sindPflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health-Tech-Scale-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale-ups. Wir bauen ein E-Commerce-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.Was du ownstDie Paid-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end-to-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.Meta & Creatives. Du planst, launchst und optimierst unsere Meta-Kampagnen. Du treibst die Creatives, die sie füttern – Static und Video – von Inhouse-Produktion bis zum Briefen und Steuern von Agenturen. Du weisst: Eine Gewinner-Ad ist kein Glückstreffer, sondern eine Testing-Pipeline.Funnels. Du baust Marketing-Funnels entlang der gesamten Customer Journey und optimierst sie konsequent – vom ersten Klick bis zum Wiederkauf.Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.Der Shop. Du hilfst mit, die Shop-Experience zu verbessern, E-Commerce-Sales zu treiben und die Customer Experience auf ein neues Level zu heben – deine Insights und Verbesserungsvorschläge können schnell und direkt umgesetzt werden, um unseren Kunden eine bessere Customer Experience zu ermöglichen.Die Zahlen. Du analysierst Marketing- und Sales-KPIs, um Wachstumschancen und Effizienzen zu finden. Deine Analyse geht nicht nur in einen Report – sie hat einen direkten Einfluss auf unser Spending und Budget Allocations.Was du mitbringst3+ Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start-ups, Scale-ups oder AgenturHands-on-Erfahrung mit Paid-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtetEin datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing- und E-Commerce-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, schnell von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommenOwnership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu wartenEinen Umgang mit Ambiguität und eine gesunde Balance zwischen Speed und QualitätDeutsch und Englisch PluspunkteErfahrung mit Google Merchant Center und Shopping-FeedsVertrautheit mit Shopify oder einer vergleichbaren E-Commerce-PlattformBasic Creative-Skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, Video Production) und Erfahrung im Briefen von KreativagenturenKenntnisse in A/B-Testing, CRO und Funnel-AnalytikEine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchenWarum dieser Platz0-to-1, wirklich. Du baust die Growth-Engine, anstatt auf andere zu warten.Direkte Leitung zur Führung. Du berichtest an den Senior Growth Manager und arbeitest eng mit der Chief Business Development Officer zusammen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheide, keine Bürokratie. Du lernst schnell, bekommst direktes Feedback und bekommst schnell Ownership über eigene Themen und Verantwortungsbereiche.Impact, den du siehst. Kleines, eigenständiges Team; deine Tests landen sofort im Business.Skalierung im Rücken. Das Tempo und die Autonomie eines Startups, gestützt durch die Ressourcen einer internationalen Gruppe – in einem der grössten Wachstumsmärkte überhaupt: Homecare und Digital Health.Wie wir arbeiten – nicht verhandelbar:Wahnsinnig gut für Familien — sofort geliefertVergiss reine Zufriedenheit. Wir liefern Unterstützung, die Pflegende sich gesehen, verstanden und wertgeschätzt fühlen lässt. Antizipiere ihre Bedürfnisse und löse Probleme schnell. Der Massstab ist wahnsinnig gut, Punkt. Alles darunter bremst uns aus und lässt unsere Familien im Stich.Speed ist König — gnadenloser Fokus ist der SchlüsselGeschwindigkeit entsteht durch Fokus. Eliminiere Ablenkungen. Konzentriere die gesamte Energie auf das eine kritische Ziel, bis es erledigt ist, dann geh zum nächsten über. Entscheide, was nicht zu tun ist, und streiche es kompromisslos. Breit, aber oberflächlich zu sein, ist ein Scheitern — beweg jetzt etwas.Latte höher legen — Mittelmass zerschlagenMittelmass tötet Tempo, Moral und Unternehmen. Spür es auf und eliminiere es. Gut genug ist nie gut genug. Verlange Spitzenleistung von dir selbst und allen um dich herum. Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Arbeit, liefere schnell Exzellenz und akzeptiere keine Ausreden.Der Speed-Algorithmus — Hinterfragen, Streichen, Vereinfachen, BeschleunigenBaue Momentum auf, indem du jede Anforderung hinterfragst: Wer hat das verlangt und warum? Streiche gnadenlos — Bestandteile, Prozesse, Bürokratie. Vereinfache, was übrig bleibt. Beschleunige Durchlaufzeiten konsequent. Das geht nicht bedeutet Du hast es noch nicht herausgefunden — geh und tu es. Durchbrich Engpässe, finde Abkürzungen und beseitige Reibungsverluste.Handle wie ein Owner — Mutige Wetten, schnelles HandelnDas ist dein Unternehmen. Übernimm Verantwortung für die Mission und die Ergebnisse. Ergreife Initiative, mach mutige Wetten, die den Fortschritt beschleunigen, und handle entschlossen. Wenn du stolperst, lerne schneller und mach weiter. Handlungsbereitschaft ist alles.

title: Digital Sales & Marketing Analyst

Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!Als Digital Sales & Marketing Analyst werk je in een dynamische omgeving waar je data van verschillende digitale platforms analyseert en omzet in concrete aanbevelingen. Je werkt nauw samen met marketing-, sales- en commerciële teams in de BeNe regio en draagt direct bij aan het behalen van onze digitale groeidoelstellingen.OVER ONS AANBODPersoonlijke voordelen: aantrekkelijk loon, bonusschema’s, uitgebreide reis(gerelateerde) voordelen, uitgebreide support op vlak van (mentaal) welzijn en meer! Flexibel werken: Werk is iets wat je doet, niet iets waar je heen gaat. We moedigen een gezonde work-life balans aan binnen een dynamische, flexibele werkomgeving Een carrière om vorm te geven: Krijg toegang tot de TUI Learning hub en ‘level-up’ om je ambities te bereiken. Breid je netwerk uit: We moedigen internationale samenwerking aan en voorzien de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan internationale projecten/ in internationale teams Community: Wees betrokken bij prachtige lokale goede doelen en duurzaamheids-initiatieven zoals de TUI Care Foundation. OVER DE FUNCTIEData-analyse & rapportage: Je verzamelt en analyseert data van diverse digitale kanalen, stelt regelmatige rapportages op en identificeert trends die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming Proactieve insights: Je deelt niet alleen cijfers, maar komt met concrete, actionable aanbevelingen en volgt de impact van geïmplementeerde verbeteringen op Cross-platform analyse: Je analyseert klantgedrag over web en app heen, identificeert patronen en ontdekt kansen voor optimalisatie Technische implementatie: Je onderhoudt tag management, ondersteunt tracking oplossingen en signaleert tijdig technische issues aan developers Dashboard beheer: Je zorgt voor actuele dashboards en bewaakt de datakwaliteit in alle rapportages Testing & experimenten: Je voert A/B tests uit voor BeNe digital marketing activiteiten, analyseert resultaten en stelt proactief nieuwe testideeën voor op basis van data-inzichten Stakeholder management: Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere presentaties en onderhoudt sterke relaties met interne teams en externe partners OVER JOUOpleiding: Je hebt een diploma in een analytisch vakgebied zoals Statistiek, Wiskunde, Econometrics of Data Analytics Ervaring: Je hebt 1-3 jaar ervaring met data-analyse, bij voorkeur in digital marketing of e-commerce Technische skills: Je beheerst SQL en data visualisatie tools (Data Studio, Tableau), en hebt affiniteit met web analytics platforms zoals Google en/of Adobe Analytics Analytisch vermogen: Je hebt sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden met oog voor detail en data-nauwkeurigheid Proactieve houding: Je identificeert kansen en issues voordat ze kritiek worden en bent action-oriented in je aanpak Communicatief sterk: Je communiceert bevindingen helder en beknopt, zowel in het Nederlands als in het Engels, naar verschillende stakeholders en werkt graag samen met verschillende teams Digital marketingkennis: Je hebt basiskennis van digitale marketingkanalen en relevante metrics Bonus: Kennis van de reisindustrie is een pré Van je werk tot een plaats waar je je thuisvoelt.
