B. Marketing, Produktmanagement, Customer Support), um datenbasierte Entscheidungen bei HSE voranzutreiben.Das Bringst Du MitDu hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Analytics, Marketing, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachbereich mit starkem statistischem Hintergrund.Du verfügst über fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Analytics oder Data Science, idealerweise mit mehreren Jahren Erfahrung in digitaler Analytics und E-Commerce-Umgebungen.Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python zur Analyse großer Datenmengen sowie fundierte Expertise in statistischen Analysen mit Python oder R.Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich Customer Analytics mit (Erfahrung in Product Analytics und/oder Marketing Analytics ist von Vorteil) und verfügst über praktische Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Statistik im Geschäftskontext.Du hast Erfahrung in agilen Arbeitsumgebungen und überzeugst durch hohe Flexibilität, analytisches Denken, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail.Du verfügst über starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, analytische Tiefe mit einer klaren Business-Impact-Orientierung zu verbinden.Du sprichst fließend Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil) und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit einem agilen Mindset sowie Begeisterung für Innovationen.Hannah BucherHR

Adjust, Mixpanel, Braze).Automation & Prozessdenken datengetrieben: Du verstehst Datenflüsse, Tracking-Logik und Conversion-Pfade – und kannst daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. title: Growth Marketer - Data & Experimentation | Berlin
description: Tomorrow Bio is the fastest growing human cryopreservation company in the world.We are pushing the boundary of what medicine, biology, and human longevity can become.Our members are not typical wellness buyers. They are thoughtful, skeptical, analytical people: founders, software engineers, scientists, investors, rationalists, biohackers, and longevity-curious high performers. They do not respond to generic marketing. They need rigor, clarity, evidence, and a message that respects their intelligence.We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketer into build the system that helps more of these people discover, understand, trust, and join us.This is not a pure brand role. It is not a “manage agencies and approve campaigns” role. It is a data-first, execution-heavy growth role for someone who can move between analytics, experimentation, funnel design, campaign execution, and technical marketing infrastructure. WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WITH PROVEN EXPERIENCE IN GROWING MARKETING AND SM CHANNELS.The most important requirement is not that you are a polished copywriter. It is that you can understand a complex product, understand a highly analytical audience, run disciplined experiments, and use data to decide what we do next.Read about the topic BEFORE applying:https://waitbutwhy .com/2016/03/cryonics.htmlTasks**What you will own:**1. Growth experiments and funnel analyticsYou will design, run, and evaluate experiments across our acquisition and conversion funnel. That means defining hypotheses, setting up tests properly, measuring results, and making clear decisions about what to scale, change, or kill. You should be comfortable working directly with data rather than waiting for someone else to interpret it for you.You will look at questions like:Which audiences convert best, and why?Which lead magnets create serious prospects rather than vanity leads?Which email, WhatsApp, webinar, or sales flows improve conversion?Which channels have the strongest CAC, LTV, and payback profile?Where do people get stuck in the decision-making process?What do high-intent prospects believe before they join?2. Campaigns for a technical, rational audienceYou will create and ship campaigns that speak to people who are rational, technically minded, and resistant to hype.Our audience includes software developers, founders, investors, rationalists, scientists, biohackers, and people already thinking seriously about longevity, AI, biology, and the future of medicine. The right candidate either comes from this world or understands it deeply enough to communicate without sounding like an outsider.You will work on:Lead magnetsLanding pagesEmail and WhatsApp sequencesPaid campaignsWebinars and event funnelsOutbound experimentsReferral and member-get-member campaignsAudience research and segmentationYou will not just brief ideas. You will ship them.3. The growth stackYou will own the systems that allow us to acquire, track, convert, and learn from prospects.This includes CRM, marketing automation, attribution, analytics dashboards, campaign tooling, and AI-assisted workflows. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be technically comfortable and able to work well with engineering when something needs to be built or integrated.You should be able to look at a growth stack and say:What is broken?What is missing?What data do we need?What can be automated?What should be built internally?What should be solved with existing tools?What decisions can we now make that we could not make before?TASKSOwn the growth funnel from acquisition to conversion: lead generation, landing pages, paid campaigns, email/WhatsApp flows, webinars, outbound, referrals, and other experiments.Design and run structured marketing experiments: define hypotheses, set up tests, measure results, and decide what to scale, change, or kill.Work directly with data: query databases, build dashboards, analyze funnels, cohorts, attribution, CAC/LTV, and conversion performance.Identify where prospects get stuck and translate that into better campaigns, messaging, segmentation, and sales handoffs.Create and ship campaigns for a highly analytical audience: founders, software engineers, investors, rationalists, scientists, biohackers, and longevity-curious high performers.Write and refine clear, precise marketing copy for people who are skeptical of hype and generic wellness messaging.Own and improve the growth stack: CRM, automation, attribution, dashboards, AI-assisted workflows, and campaign tooling.Work closely with the founder, sales, medical/scientific team, and engineering to turn insights into fast execution.RequirementsStrong data and analytical skills. This is the most important requirement.You should be able to query data yourself without relying on an analyst layer.Experience with funnel analysis, cohort analysis, attribution, CAC/LTV, conversion modeling, and dashboard building.Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests or other structured growth experiments.Comfortable using BI or analytics tools such as DataStudio,Metabase, Looker, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Tableau, or similar.Strong spreadsheet modeling skills for budgets, forecasts, channel performance, and growth projections.Ability to ship campaigns yourself, not only brief agencies or wait for a team.Clear written English. You do not need to be a world-class copywriter, but you need to write precisely for smart, rational people in our ICP.Strong understanding of technical, rational, high-agency audiences. Ideally, you are close to our ICP in mindset or interests: founders, developers, investors, rationalists, biohackers, quantified-self people, longevity enthusiasts, or frontier-tech operators.Personal interest in longevity, biohacking, health-tech, biotech, AI, rationalism, or ambitious frontier technology.Comfortable using AI tools to move faster across analysis, writing, automation, and execution.Excellent spoken and written English. (German is a plus).Based in Berlin, remote is not possible.Nice to have:Experience in DTC, health-tech, longevity, biohacking, premium subscriptions, biotech, or high-innovation startups.German, French, or Italian.Python or R for analysis.Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation tools.Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, or similar.A personal project, newsletter, podcast, community, or audience in longevity, rationalism, quantified self, startups, investing, or frontier technology.BenefitsFull ownership of growth at one of Europe’s most ambitious life extension companies.Direct access to the founder and leadership team, with no unnecessary middle layer.High autonomy and fast decision-making.A complex, meaningful product with a highly unusual and intellectually serious audience.The opportunity to build the growth function, systems, and playbook from the ground up.Berlin Mitte office location.This role is for someone who combines analytical rigor, technical comfort, strong audience intuition, and hands-on execution.We are not looking for a traditional marketer who only manages agencies or produces campaign decks. We are looking for someone who can understand a complex product, think in systems, work directly with data, and communicate with people who are skeptical, technical, and serious about the future of medicine and longevity.Please include one example of work that shows how you think. This could be an A/B test writeup, funnel analysis, dashboard, SQL-based analysis, campaign retrospective, growth model, or relevant personal project.

title: Data Analyst (f/d/m)
description: Join us as femtasy's first internal Data Analyst (f/d/m). Sit with Marketing, Product, and Finance to turn messy questions into clear, actionable answers, working directly with our Head of Data.This is femtasyfemtasy is the audio-only streaming platform for sensual audio stories & sexy sounds for women. We inspire women to explore and enjoy on their own terms. We're a female-centric product, led by a female CEO & Founder, with over 90% of our team identifying as women+. We've already positively impacted the lives of hundreds of thousands of women by redefining female pleasure – and we're just getting started.Your mission and your impact:Today, all data requests from Marketing (our principal stakeholder), Product, and Finance funnel through our Head of Data, who scopes every ask before an external agency executes it. That doesn't scale. You'll be the first internal hire to change that: sitting directly with stakeholders, turning vague requests into well-defined problems, and delivering a good-enough solution fast.You'll report to the Head of Data and work alongside an Analytics Engineer who owns the heavier dbt/pipeline work.Six months in, this is what your impact looks like: you run scoping conversations with Marketing especially, but also Product and Finance independently – no pre-framing needed from your Head of Data. You own the fact tables and models behind your recurring reporting. You've proactively fixed or flagged at least one foundational data issue – because you saw it, not because someone asked. Stakeholders treat you as a go-to resource, not a ticket-taker.What you'll doOwn first-line scoping conversations with Marketing, Product, and Finance: ask the right clarifying questions, push back on vague or over-scoped requests, and land on a defined problem plus a good-enough solution.Come up with your own solution after aligned with stakeholders, maximizing the impact and keeping the development time as short as possible.Build and maintain the dashboards and reports (Tableau today, tool-agnostic long term) that Marketing, Product, and Finance can actually act on.Build and manage data in dbt: create and maintain the fact tables and models that support your recurring reporting and analyses, with our Analytics Engineer supporting the underlying infrastructure.Own the day-to-day reliability of what you build: catch issues, flag or fix them – so no one ever has to ask »which number is right«.Question the status quo at the working level. If something's »always been done that way« and it's slowing a team down, we want you to say so and to work with your Head of Data on what's worth fixing.What you bring3+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytics role: you can work independently on well-scoped problems and know when to ask for help on ambiguous ones.Proven stakeholder-facing judgment. You've sat in front of a non-technical stakeholder with a vague ask, asked the right questions, and resisted both over-engineering the answer and under-scoping it.You frame problems clearly, communicate directly, and challenge assumptions.Solid SQL, dbt, and hands-on comfort with a BI tool: you build and maintain your models yourself, from raw data to fact table to dashboard. Our Analytics Engineer supports you on infrastructure, but day-to-day dbt work is yours to own.Comfortable moving across domains. You won't own one fixed area – you will support Marketing and other stakeholders when needed.Opinionated but coachable. You're willing to challenge »it's always been like that«, and open to direct feedback.Fluent in English.A strong plus, not a mustYou've worked with Marketing before (at least one real marketing project)You've experienced a startup environmentYou already use AI tools in your day-to-day analysisThis role is hybrid, based in or around Berlin. We're in the office together every Tuesday and Wednesday, with flexibility on the remaining days.This is NOT for you if…You want every request fully pre-scoped before you touch it, rather than asking the clarifying questions yourself.You'd rather just execute the ticket than sit with a stakeholder and challenge whether it's the right ask.You reach for a dashboard or a data pull before you've actually understood the business problem behind it.You're not comfortable owning your models end-to-end in dbt, from raw data to the fact table to the final report.You see yourself as a data service desk instead of creating your own tickets after aligning with stakeholders.What we offer🌟 Impact & purpose. The chance to join a huge mission around female empowerment and gender equality.🦸 Female-led and women-centric. A female-centric product, a female CEO & Founder, and over 90% of our whole team identifies as women+.🤝 Inspiring, performance-oriented culture. A progressive team culture based on transparency, open feedback, ownership, and collaboration. Check out »radical candor« if you want to learn more about how we work.🤖 AI-first by default. A company-paid AI subscription of your choice, and a team that automates everything worth automating so you can focus on the work that matters.📈 Personal and professional growth. Team learning sessions, learning & development budgets, and internal trainings. Every team member, from junior to C-level, has access to personal 1:1 sessions with a professional business coach.🔄 Healthy approach to taking a break. 26 holidays plus unlimited recharging time on top for when you really need it.📍 Flexibility. Flexible working hours, hybrid setup with our Berlin office as home base.🎉 (Really cool) events & benefits like an Urban Sports membership (or alternative offerings), snacks & lunches, mobility and retirement plans, and our famous femtasy parties and team events. We also cook and eat together twice a month and have a big office garden for the best BBQs in Berlin.💪 Package. A compensation package that fairly mirrors what's expected from you and the impact you'll have on femtasy. Exact range shared in the first call.femtasy offers equal opportunities for all and encourages applicants of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religious backgrounds, gender identities, and people with disabilities to apply.Our Recruiting ProcessShort application questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes)30 min Get-to-know-each-other call with one of our recruiters30 min with our Head of Data1h 30 min working session with our Head of Data: a live scoping exercise, not a take-home test45 min interview with one of your future stakeholders (Marketing, Product or Finance)1h interview with our CEOFinal offerWe are looking to fill this position as soon as possible und usually respond within three days.

title: Data Analyst:in Product & Business Intelligence (d/m/w)

BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift oder Databricks) und Erfahrung mit einem BI-Werkzeug, bei uns Power BIFundierte Erfahrung mit Web- und Produktanalytik, inklusive GA4 auf Rohdatenebene. Erfahrung im Entwurf eigener Tracking-Konzepte ist von VorteilDu definierst, erklärst und vertrittst Kennzahlen sicher, ordnest ein, was eine Zahl aussagt und was nicht, und leitest daraus nächste Schritte abDu arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und beharrlich. Beim Tagesspiegel schätzen wir die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter und sind fest davon überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven unsere Arbeit bereichern. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und fördern einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. title: Data Analyst (all genders)
description: Jede Entscheidung bei MUVN hängt an einer Zahl. Niemand soll sie suchen müssen.MUVN verbindet Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Kein neuer Fuhrpark, keine neue Logistik. Bessere Nutzung von dem, was ohnehin unterwegs ist. Unser Marktplatz wächst über Korridore, also über einzelne Strecken, die dicht genug werden, um von selbst zu tragen. Ob eine Strecke trägt, ist keine Meinungsfrage, sondern eine Messung.Dafür bauen wir das MUVN Brain: eine verbundene Schicht über unseren Systemen, in der Kennzahlen einmal definiert sind und Menschen wie AI-Agents dieselbe Antwort bekommen. Es wird immer mehr als ein System geben. Der Unterschied liegt darin, ob sie miteinander reden. Du baust das.Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Datenstelle, berichtest an unseren CFO und arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, Marketing und Operations. Du erbst keine Datenplattform, du entscheidest, was sie wird. Und du beantwortest die Fragen, an denen bei uns Geld hängt: Welcher Korridor kippt als Nächstes. Wo verlieren wir Nachfrage. Welcher Kanal bringt Matches statt Downloads.Du arbeitest dabei AI-First: AI übernimmt die Ausführung, dir gehören Intention, logisches Denken und Korrektheit.Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Vollzeit 🚀AufgabenEine Wahrheit, nicht fünfDu definierst unsere Kernkennzahlen über den gesamten Funnel, einmal verbindlich, mit klarer Namenskonvention und einer Definition pro Metrik. Teile davon existieren bereits, sie sind nur nirgends operationalisiert. Du gleichst die Quellen ab, erklärst Abweichungen und sorgst dafür, dass eine Frage genau eine Antwort hat, egal wer sie stellt.Den Marktplatz messbar machenUnsere Analyseeinheit ist der Korridor, nicht die Stadt und nicht das Land. Du machst Angebot, Nachfrage, Fill Rate und Time-to-Match auf dieser Ebene sichtbar, inklusive der Fälle, die in keinem Standard-Funnel auftauchen. Ein Fahrer, der nichts findet, ist bei uns ein Signal, kein fehlender Datenpunkt.Das MUVN Brain bauenHeute: direktes SQL, Python-Skripte, API-Pulls. Du überführst das in einen leichtgewichtigen, verbundenen Stack und entscheidest über Architektur und Tools, vom Warehouse über den Transformations-Layer bis zum BI-Tool. Jedes Werkzeug kommt an dem Punkt rein, an dem es seine Kosten verdient, nicht früher. Lieber fünf verlässliche Modelle als fünfzig halb vertraute.Pipelines, denen man vertrautDu integrierst unsere Quellen mit Pipelines, die idempotent, testbar und dokumentiert sind. Du baust Validierung zwischen den Quellen und fängst Diskrepanzen ab, bevor sie ein Meeting erreichen. Wenn etwas bricht, findest du die Ursache statt das Symptom und planst Backfills mit Prüfung davor und danach.Analysen, die Entscheidungen tragenWiederkehrendes Management-Reporting, Kohorten, Retention, Pricing, Funnel, Marketing-Performance Ende zu Ende. Ad-hoc-Fragen beantwortest du schnell. Die, die immer wiederkommen, überführst du in Self-Serve-Reports, damit das Team sich selbst bedient.Das Team unabhängig von dir machenDu nimmst Anforderungen von Gründern, Marketing und Operations auf und übersetzt sie in Modelle, die wiederverwendbar sind. Du dokumentierst Definitionen, Annahmen und Sonderfälle dort, wo sie hingehören, im Code und in der Doku, nicht in deinem Kopf. Datenfragen sollen nicht bei dir enden.AI-Agents als Teil des SystemsDu baust und iterierst Agents für klar umrissene Aufgaben: wiederkehrende Reports, Dokumentation, Datenqualitätschecks. Du pflegst die maschinenlesbaren Kontextdateien, die unser Brain überhaupt erst nutzbar machen, mit unseren Konventionen, Definitionen und Domänenregeln. Du prüfst, was AI produziert, bevor es zählt. Die Korrektheit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.QualifikationDu hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst:in, Analytics Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und schon einmal ein Reporting von null aufgebaut, nicht nur eines gepflegt. SQL ist für dich Handwerk, nicht Hürde: Window Functions, CTEs, Query-Optimierung, und genug Tiefe, um einen Execution Plan zu lesen und ein Performanceproblem selbst zu finden. Python nutzt du für Analysen und Pipeline-Arbeit.Was diese Rolle von klassischer Analyse unterscheidet: Du bekommst keine Tickets. Du bekommst Entscheidungen, die anstehen, und findest selbst heraus, welche Zahl sie tragen muss, wer sie liest und was es dazu schon gibt.Was bei uns funktioniert:Du fragst zuerst, welche Entscheidung an der Zahl hängt, bevor du die erste Query schreibst.Du formulierst eine Hypothese, bevor du sie prüfst, und änderst sie, wenn die Daten etwas anderes sagen.Du merkst, wenn eine Zahl zu gut ist, um wahr zu sein, und gehst ihr nach, bevor sie in ein Meeting kommt.Du arbeitest eigenständig und meldest dich, wenn etwas klemmt, nicht erst im Wochenmeeting.Du misst dich selbst an Ergebnissen, bevor es jemand anderes tut.Du dokumentierst so, dass die nächste Person dich nicht fragen muss.Du denkst in Kosten, bei Compute, Speicherung und Pipeline-Design, und handelst danach.Du teilst, was du weißt. Wissen, das nur bei dir liegt, ist bei uns ein Risiko, kein Vorteil.Solides Analytics-Fundament: Kohorten, Funnels, Unit Economics und statistisches Grundverständnis. Praxiserfahrung mit Produkt- und Marketing-Analytics-Tools wie Mixpanel, GA4, Mobile Attribution oder Vergleichbarem. Engineering-Grundprinzipien auf Datenarbeit angewendet: Modularität, Idempotenz, Testbarkeit als Default. Datenschutzbewusste Modellierung ist für dich selbstverständlich, wir arbeiten mit Zahlungs- und Personendaten. AI-gestützte Workflows sind dein Alltag, mit voller Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.Ein Plus, kein Muss: dbt oder ein Modern Data Stack, den du selbst eingeführt hast. Erfahrung mit Payments-Daten. Marktplatz- oder Plattformhintergrund, also Liquidität, Take Rate, Angebots- und Nachfragedynamik. Early-Stage-Erfahrung, du hast schon ohne Playbook gearbeitet.Deutsch und Englisch fließend.Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.BenefitsDein Marktplatz, deine Zahlen: echte Ownership von Tag 1Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Arbeite, wann es für dich am besten passtDirekter Draht zu den Gründern: kein HR-Filter, keine Hierarchie dazwischenKarriereperspektive: baue langfristig dein eigenes Team auf, in DACH und EuropaHybrides Arbeiten & Remote: Flexibilität ist bei uns ProgrammOffsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehrFree MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei NutzungsgebührenCorporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten OnlineshopsMehr Infos zu unseren Benefits und unseren Firmenwerten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.Schick uns deinen CV und zwei, drei Sätze dazu: Welche Kennzahl würdest du bei uns als Erstes verbindlich definieren, und warum ausgerechnet die?So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit unserem CFO, dann eine fachliche Session an einem anonymisierten Fall aus unserem Marktplatz, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team.Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.Let's get it muvn. 🚀

Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
description: Your MissionThis is a company built for growth, not comfort.When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability.What You'll OwnPartner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.What Success Looks LikeProduct, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.What You BringExperienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.How We WinSpeed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. Not my job isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!About UsAt exmox, we are building the next European tech challenger in the user acquisition space.We operate a scalable user acquisition platform that enables partners to grow efficiently and at scale. In a highly competitive global market, our ambition is clear: to build a category-leading company through strong execution, continuous improvement, and a relentless focus on performance.This is not a company built for comfort. We are building for growth, impact, and long-term success.Equal opportunity, accessibility and data protectionexmox is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, just let us know, we are happy to help.Your personal data will be processed in line with our Data privacy statement, which explains how we collect, use, and protect your information during the hiring process.

title: Commercial Strategy & Data Analyst
description: About Smartbox We exist to be the go-to companion, empowering everyone to transform their free time into experiences. At Smartbox Group, we believe that real-life experiences help us thrive, connect, and become the best versions of ourselves. With nearly 15,000 different products across leisure themes — Stays, Wellness, Adventure, Gastronomy — we allow people to enrich their lives with moments of sharing, emotions, and unforgettable memories. Present in 11 countries, Smartbox Group employs over 700 people across Europe and works with more than 40,000 trusted partners, including hotels, restaurants, wellness centres, and outdoor activity providers. Living more than owning, sharing more than having — this is more than ever a fundamental trend in our society, and it’s exactly what Smartbox offers. Our Culture At Smartbox, we’re on a mission to unbox our world and unbox the potential of our People. We’re not just building a workplace - we’re cultivating a movement where bold ideas, authentic connections, and real-world experiences redefine what work can be. As our teams’ trusted companion on this journey, we empower our people to take ownership, break boundaries, and dive headfirst into challenges that spark growth and impact. Together, we’re creating a culture of daring curiosity, relentless ambition and transformative purpose - where every team member is driven to experience life, potential and growth to shape their future, and leave a lasting mark on the world around us. The Role:As a Commercial Strategy & Data Analyst, you will support the GTM Strategy and Sales teams by producing reliable analyses, reports and dashboards that help monitor partner performance and commercial activity. This is an execution‑focused analytical role. You will work on clearly defined topics and priorities, contribute to recurring reporting and analyses, and help ensure that commercial teams have access to accurate and consistent data to support decision‑making. You will collaborate closely with GTM Strategy, RevOps and Sales, and interact regularly with Product, Tech and Finance to provide data inputs and insights. Key Responsibilities Data Analysis & Partner Performance:Produce recurring reports and analyses on partner performance across predefined dimensions such as partner tier, product category and geography. Monitor key performance indicators (e.g. revenue contribution, availability, catalog quality, NPS) and highlight notable variations or data issues. Prepare structured analyses to support reviews of partner performance, under the guidance of GTM Strategy. Support quarterly and monthly business reviews by preparing data extracts, charts and summaries. Track sales performance against targets for Account Managers and BDMs, and prepare standard reports for review by GTM leadership. Pricing & Commercial Analysis Support:Support pricing and margin analyses by preparing data inputs, simulations and comparison reports. Assist in modelling the commercial impact of predefined pricing or incentive scenarios. Help monitor pricing consistency across markets and categories and flag anomalies to relevant stakeholders. Provide analytical support for new commercial initiatives (e.g. new offer types or partner models), based on clearly defined scopes. Dashboards & Reporting:Maintain and update existing GTM dashboards used by GTM Strategy, Sales teams and country stakeholders. Ensure data accuracy and consistency across reports and dashboards. Implement dashboard changes and updates based on documented business requirements. Support the adoption of dashboards by commercial teams by helping explain metrics and reports. Marketplace & Product Data Support:Develop a good understanding of Smartbox’s marketplace and catalog performance metrics. Track predefined catalog health indicators and prepare reports for Product and Operations teams. Provide data and analysis to support cross‑functional discussions on marketplace performance when requested. Assist in compiling competitor and market data to support GTM analyses. Requirements for the Role:2–4 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical role. Good working knowledge of SQL and at least one BI or data visualisation tool (e.g. Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Power BI). Basic understanding of commercial, sales or marketplace environments. Ability to work with structured datasets and follow established analytical frameworks. Comfortable collaborating with multiple teams (Sales, GTM Strategy, RevOps, Product, Finance). Strong attention to detail and data quality. Skills:Ability to execute data analyses accurately and on time. Structured and methodical approach to problem solving. Ability to summarise data and findings clearly. Good communication skills, with the ability to explain metrics and reports to non‑technical stakeholders. Willingness to learn and develop analytical and commercial skills. Adaptability in a dynamic business environment. What we value:Reliability: you deliver high‑quality analyses that teams can trust. Curiosity: you are eager to understand the business and how data supports it. Collaboration: you work effectively with different teams and functions. Growth mindset: you are motivated to develop your skills and take on increasing responsibility over time.

title: Confirmed Product Analyst - Demand
description: About BlaBlaCarBlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. title: KERING Data Scientist
description: SummaryGroupe de luxe mondial né d’une histoire familiale et entrepreneuriale, Kering réunit un ensemble de Maisons reconnues pour leur créativité en matière de couture et de prêt-à porter, de maroquinerie, de joaillerie, de lunetterie et de beauté : Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin, Ginori 1735, ainsi que Kering Eyewear. Inspirées par leur histoire et par leur patrimoine, les Maisons du Groupe conçoivent et façonnent des produits et des expériences d'exception qui reflètent l’engagement de Kering pour l’excellence, le développement durable et la culture. Cette vision s’incarne dans la signature du Groupe : Creativity is our Legacy. Comptant 44 000 collaborateurs, Kering a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 14,7 milliards d’euros en 2025.Job DescriptionNous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) Data Scientist pour intégrer notre équipe.Votre opportunitéRejoindre l’équipe Data & IA de Kering, c’est intégrer un collectif d’experts dont la mission est d’accompagner le Groupe et ses Maisons dans la valorisation de leurs données afin d’éclairer les décisions stratégiques et de renforcer la création de valeur grâce à des solutions avancées d'Analytics et d’Intelligence Artificielle.Au sein de cet environnement, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data & AI avec un rattachement hiérarchique au Head of Advanced Analytics et un management fonctionnel assuré par le Head of Marketing Effectiveness au sein de Kering Media. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la structuration, l’internalisation et le développement des capacités de mesure de l’efficacité marketing du Groupe, notamment autour du Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) et des autres leviers d’analyse de la performance marketing.En étroite collaboration avec les équipes Média du Groupe et des Maisons, vous contribuerez au développement d’une expertise durable et réutilisable permettant de mieux comprendre l’impact des investissements marketing, qu’il s’agisse des médias, des événements, des célébrités ou du CRM. Vous participerez à l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis la collecte et la validation des données jusqu’à l’analyse des résultats et la formulation de recommandations à forte valeur ajoutée pour les parties prenantes.En tant que Data Scientist, vous contribuerez activement à la conception, au développement et à l’amélioration continue des modèles de mesure de l’efficacité marketing. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la transformation d’analyses complexes en recommandations concrètes, afin d’éclairer les décisions d’investissement et de soutenir les ambitions de performance du Groupe et de ses Maisons.Comment vous allez contribuerVous rejoindrez l’équipe Data & IA et, en collaboration avec Kering Media, les équipes Marketing, CRM et les Maisons, vous contribuerez à l'internalisation et au développement des capacités de mesure de l’efficacité marketing du Groupe, dont le Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).Vos principales missions seront :Piloter de bout en bout des projets de mesure de l’efficacité marketing pour différentes Maisons et marchés, en couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de vie des analyses, depuis le cadrage et la collecte des données jusqu’à la modélisation, l’interprétation des résultats et la formulation de recommandations activables.Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des modèles statistiques, économétriques et de Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) afin de mesurer l’impact et la contribution incrémentale des différents leviers marketing sur les ventes, le trafic, l’engagement et les principaux indicateurs business.Produire des analyses et des indicateurs directement exploitables par les équipes Média, Marketing et CRM, notamment en matière de ROAS, de contribution par levier, de courbes de saturation, de scénarios d’investissement et de recommandations d’allocation des budgets.Développer des méthodologies robustes et réutilisables à l’échelle du Groupe, tout en tenant compte des spécificités des Maisons, des marchés et de la disponibilité des données afin de garantir la pertinence et la cohérence des analyses.Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Kering Media, Marketing, CRM, Data, les Maisons et les partenaires externes afin de garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et l’exploitabilité des données nécessaires aux différents modèles et analyses.Assurer la qualité et la robustesse des résultats en challengeant les données, en réalisant des analyses de sensibilité et en évaluant les niveaux d’incertitude associés aux modèles développés.Présenter les résultats et recommandations aux parties prenantes techniques et métier, faciliter la prise de décision et accompagner l’appropriation des analyses afin de maximiser leur impact business.Vos objectifs à 12 moisMaîtriser les méthodologies, les processus et les modèles de Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) existants, en garantissant leur documentation, leur maintenabilité et leur réutilisabilité à l’échelle du Groupe.Déployer avec succès plusieurs analyses de marketing effectiveness pour différentes Maisons et différents marchés, couvrant le MMM ainsi que les problématiques liées aux événements, aux célébrités, aux contenus et au CRM.Développer des modèles robustes, reproductibles et compris par les équipes Média, Marketing et CRM, avec une documentation claire des hypothèses, des limites et des niveaux d’incertitude associés.Produire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée permettant d’orienter des décisions concrètes d’optimisation des investissements média, des activations CRM, des contenus, des événements et des partenariats avec les célébrités.Devenir un(e) interlocuteur(rice) reconnu(e) auprès de Kering Media, des équipes Marketing et CRM, des Maisons, des équipes Data et des partenaires externes grâce à votre expertise, votre fiabilité et votre capacité à transformer les données en recommandations actionnables.Qui êtes-vous ?Vous disposez de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en Data Science, Économétrie ou Marketing Analytics, et avez développé une solide expertise dans la mesure de l’efficacité marketing, notamment à travers des projets de Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) et d’analyse de la contribution des différents leviers marketing. Reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur analytique et votre compréhension des enjeux business, vous savez transformer des données complexes en recommandations claires et actionnables.Sur le plan technique, vous connaissez les fondamentaux :Master ou équivalent (Bac+5) en Data Science, Statistiques, Économétrie, Mathématiques Appliquées, Économie Quantitative ou dans un domaine connexe.Solides connaissances en modélisation statistique et économétrique, incluant les régressions, les séries temporelles, les approches bayésiennes, la validation des modèles et la quantification de l’incertitude.Maîtrise des concepts clés du Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), tels que l’adstock, la saturation, la décomposition du baseline, les variables de contrôle, le ROAS et les courbes de réponse.Excellente maîtrise de Python, SQL et Git pour développer, industrialiser et maintenir des analyses et modèles robustes.Capacité à collecter, explorer et fiabiliser des données issues de sources multiples, à identifier les anomalies et à challenger la cohérence des résultats produits.Utilisation courante des outils et pratiques d'intelligence artificielle appliqués à l’analyse de données, avec la capacité à les utiliser de manière pertinente pour gagner en efficacité et améliorer la qualité des livrables.Sur le plan humain, vous vous reconnaissez dans ces qualités :Capacité à comprendre, challenger et accompagner les besoins métier dans des environnements complexes, internationaux et multidisciplinaires.Communication claire et collaborative, avec une aptitude à interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques.Rigueur, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, permettant d’identifier les enjeux clés et de proposer des solutions pertinentes.Curiosité, sens de l’initiative et volonté d’apprendre en continu, avec l’envie de partager vos connaissances et de contribuer à la réussite collective.Anglais courant indispensable. Le français est un plus ; si votre niveau n’est pas encore totalement opérationnel, nous vous accompagnerons pour l’atteindre sou 6 à 12 mois. L’italien est également un plus.Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Rejoindre l’équipe Data & IA de Kering, c’est contribuer à la construction d’une capacité stratégique de Marketing Effectiveness qui éclaire directement les décisions d’investissement du Groupe et de ses Maisons. Vous participerez au développement de méthodologies avancées de mesure de la performance marketing, couvrant notamment le Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), les événements, le CRM et d’autres leviers clés de création de valeur.Vous évoluerez dans un environnement à forte visibilité, au carrefour de la Data, du Marketing et du Business. En tant que premier profil dédié à ce périmètre, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la structuration d’une expertise durable, l’évolution des méthodes et des standards du Groupe, ainsi que dans l’accompagnement des décisions stratégiques de plusieurs Maisons et marchés. Au sein d’équipes expertes et collaboratives, vous contribuerez à des initiatives à fort impact, combinant excellence analytique, innovation et proximité avec les enjeux métier.Si ce poste vous enthousiasme, mais que votre profil ne coche pas encore l’ensemble des critères, nous vous encourageons à candidater. Au-delà de l’expérience, nous valorisons des talents capables d’apprendre rapidement, d’évoluer dans des environnements en transformation et d’apporter des perspectives nouvelles.Le poste offre également de réelles opportunités de développement professionnel : montée en compétences, certifications techniques, participation aux communautés internes et exposition à des projets variés, internationaux et à forte valeur ajoutée. L’équipe encourage l’autonomie, la collaboration, la curiosité et la prise d’initiative.Kering s'engage en faveur de la diversité. Nous croyons que la diversité sous toutes ses formes - genre, âge, nationalité, culture, handicap, croyances religieuses et orientation sexuelle - enrichit le lieu de travail. Nos collaborateurs ont ainsi des opportunités pour exprimer leurs talents, à la fois individuellement et collectivement, et cela contribue à renforcer notre capacité d'adaptation à un monde en mutation. En tant qu'employeur de l'égalité des chances, nous accueillons et considérons les candidatures de tous les candidats qualifiés, indépendamment de leurs antécédents.English VersionKering is a global, family-led luxury group, home to people whose passion and expertise nurture creative Houses across couture and ready-to-wear, leather goods, jewelry, eyewear and beauty: Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin, Ginori 1735, as well as Kering Eyewear. Inspired by their creative heritage, Kering Houses design and craft exceptional products and experiences that reflect the Group’s commitment to excellence, sustainability and culture. This vision is expressed in our signature: Creativity is our Legacy. In 2025, Kering employed 44,000 people and generated revenue of €14.7 billion.We are currently seeking a Data Scientist to join our team.Your opportunity Joining Kering’s Data & AI team means becoming part of a community of experts whose mission is to help the Group and its Houses unlock the full value of their data to support strategic decision-making and drive value creation through advanced Analytics and Artificial Intelligence solutions.Within this environment, you will join the Data & AI team, reporting directly to the Head of Advanced Analytics and functionally to the Head of Marketing Effectiveness within Kering Media. You will play a key role in structuring, internalizing, and expanding the Group’s marketing effectiveness measurement capabilities, with a particular focus on Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and other marketing performance analytics frameworks.Working closely with both Group and House Media teams, you will help build a sustainable and reusable expertise that enables a deeper understanding of the impact of marketing investments across media, events, celebrity partnerships, and CRM initiatives. You will contribute across the entire value chain, from data collection and validation to insights generation and the delivery of high-value recommendations to stakeholders.As a Data Scientist, you will actively contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of marketing effectiveness measurement models. You will play a central role in transforming complex analyses into actionable recommendations, helping guide investment decisions and support the performance ambitions of the Group and its Houses.How you will contribute You will join the Data & AI team and, in close collaboration with Kering Media, Marketing, CRM teams, and the Houses, contribute to the internalization and development of the Group’s marketing effectiveness measurement capabilities, including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).Your main responsibilities will include:Lead end-to-end marketing effectiveness measurement projects across different Houses and markets, covering the full analytics lifecycle from scoping and data collection to modeling, interpretation of results, and delivery of actionable recommendations.Design, develop, and enhance statistical, econometric, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) models to measure the impact and incremental contribution of various marketing levers on sales, traffic, engagement, and key business KPIs.Produce analyses and insights directly actionable by Media, Marketing, and CRM teams, including ROAS measurement, channel contribution analysis, saturation curves, investment scenarios, and budget allocation recommendations.Develop robust and scalable methodologies that can be applied across the Group while accounting for House-specific, market-specific, and data availability constraints to ensure consistency and relevance.Collaborate closely with Kering Media, Marketing, CRM, Data teams, the Houses, and external partners to ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of data used within analytical models and frameworks.Ensure the quality and robustness of analytical output by challenging source data, conducting sensitivity analyses, and assessing uncertainty levels associated with developed models.Present findings and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders, facilitate decision-making processes, and drive the adoption of insights to maximize business impact.What Success Looks Like After 12 MonthsMaster the existing Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) methodologies, processes, and models while ensuring appropriate documentation, maintainability, and reusability across the Group.Successfully deliver multiple marketing effectiveness analyses across different Houses and markets, covering MMM as well as topics related to events, celebrity partnerships, content performance, and CRM effectiveness.Develop robust, reproducible, and well-understood models, supported by clear documentation of assumptions, limitations, and associated uncertainty levels for Media, Marketing, and CRM stakeholders.Deliver high-value analyses that drive tangible optimization decisions across media investments, CRM activations, content strategies, events, and celebrity partnerships.Become a trusted business partner for Kering Media, Marketing and CRM teams, the Houses, Data teams, and external partners through your expertise, reliability, and ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.Who you areYou have 3 to 5 years of experience in Data Science, Econometrics, or Marketing Analytics, and have developed strong expertise in marketing effectiveness measurement through Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and contribution analysis of marketing channels. Recognized for your analytical rigor and strong business acumen, you can transform complex datasets into clear and actionable recommendations.From a technical standpoint, you master the fundamentals: Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Quantitative Economics, or a related field.Strong knowledge of statistical and econometric modeling, including regression techniques, time-series analysis, Bayesian methods, model validation, and uncertainty quantification.Solid understanding of key Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) concepts, including adstock, saturation effects, baseline decomposition, control variables, ROAS, and response curves.Excellent proficiency in Python, SQL, and Git to develop, industrialize, and maintain robust analytical models and solutions.Ability to collect, explore, validate, and reconcile data from multiple sources, identify anomalies, and critically assess model outputs.Experience using Artificial Intelligence tools and practices to enhance analytical workflows, improve productivity, and increase the quality of deliverables.On the human side, you identify with the following qualities:Ability to understand, challenge, and support business needs within complex, international, and multidisciplinary environments.Clear and collaborative communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Strong analytical and synthesis skills, combined with rigor and attention to detail, enabling you to identify key challenges and propose relevant solutions.Curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset, with a willingness to share knowledge and contribute to collective success.Full proficiency in English is mandatory. French is a plus; if your French is not yet fully operational, we will support you in reaching a working proficiency level within 6 to 12 months. title: Graduate growth manager
description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.A few examples of your responsibilitiesUnderstand. Build deep knowledge of your product, its business model, and the key levers driving growth.Analyze. Use AI, automation, and advanced analytics to explore high-performing campaigns, identify patterns in user and product data, and generate actionable insights.Ideate. Turn insights, experiment results, competitor research, and AI-assisted exploration into hypotheses and identify opportunities to improve growth and monetization.Test. Design and run rigorous experiments with real users, partnering closely with designers, engineers, and analysts to bring ideas to life and iterate quickly based on results.Scale. Roll out winning ideas broadly, and use learnings from each experiment to shape the next cycle of discovery and testing.What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.Commitment & contractPermanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.LocationMilan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.The selection processIn our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.Before you applyIf you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

We need someone to make it measurable.The roleYou’re the structured, data-driven half of a small marketing team. Right now that team is a handful of strong specialists: someone driving campaigns and positioning with deep product and market knowledge, part-time SEO, and product marketing. Each is excellent in their lane, but no one owns making the whole thing measurable and coordinated. That’s the gap you fill.You’ll partner most closely with the person who owns campaigns and messaging. They bring deep product knowledge, a sharp read on the market, and no shortage of ideas. You bring the structure and rigor to turn the best of those ideas into experiments you can actually measure.Your job comes down to one number: the count of sales-qualified leads, the people who fill out our Contact Sales form. Everything you own points back to it.This is a hands-on role. You’re not here to manage people; you’re the one in the data, the tag manager, and the dashboards, doing the work yourself. You also bring order to how the team runs: what’s in flight, who’s on it, and whether it’s moving the number.What you’ll doGrow qualified sales leads. Own the one metric that matters (SQLs from our Contact Sales funnel) and treat every step of the journey as something you can measure and improve.Own the funnel end to end. Know it cold: where leads come from, where they stall, and where they convert. Make sure tracking, data collection, and attribution are correct and trustworthy at every touchpoint.Keep the plumbing clean, and keep it that way. Tag manager, analytics, attribution, naming conventions: set them up properly once, with a consistent scheme, and hold the line so they don’t drift back into chaos.Turn data into insight. Collect it, understand it, find the signal, then turn that into hypotheses worth testing.Run experiments. Design the test, ship it, measure it, and let the data decide. Kill what doesn’t work; double down on what does.Own the paid acquisition funnel. Monitor Google Ads, dig into keyword ROI and fine-tune conversions, and source prospect lists to run ABM campaigns to them on LinkedIn.Report to leadership. Lean on it for analysis, reporting, automation, and quick internal tooling, while keeping a critical eye on what to trust.What a typical project looks likeSay we’re launching a new server-side video renderer. Here’s the shape of your week:You start with the inputs, not the ad account. You work through recent customer interviews, map the jobs-to-be-done, and scan the competitive landscape, and that seeds your keyword research. You forecast keyword volume, build out the ad groups, and define a new proxy conversion for prospects requesting trial credits, wiring it up through Google Tag Manager. You launch, then watch: monitoring campaign performance and standing up an A/B test to see whether the marketing page or the docs converts better for this audience.The next day, you vibe-code an extension to the reporting dashboard adding LLM-visibility metrics that track brand mentions and our key terms across AI assistants. We care that you use AI well and critically: it multiplies what one structured operator can ship, and you keep judgment over what to trust.What we’re looking forGenuinely data-driven and structured. Comfortable owning outcomes in a small team, or on your own, without a big team to delegate to.A low tolerance for mess. When you inherit a tangled tag manager, analytics, or attribution setup, you can’t leave it alone; you rebuild it clean, name things consistently, and keep it that way.Fluent across the funnel. description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Nous offrons un développement accéléré grâce à des expériences d'apprentissage immersives, des missions mondiales et un engagement culturel.Pourquoi rejoindre Roche dans le cadre de ce rôle / initiative ?Impact stratégique : Jouez un rôle crucial dans la formulation de stratégies financières et de décisions qui propulsent notre entreprise vers l'avant ;Opportunités globales : Participez à des missions offrant une exposition internationale, élargissant ainsi votre réseau professionnel et votre expérience. Strategic Impact: Play a critical role in shaping financial strategies and decisions that drive our business forward;Global Opportunities: Engage in assignments that offer international exposure, broadening your professional network and experience. title: Client Data Analyst (H/F)
description: Correspondez-vous au profil ?Vous avec une première expérience de data analyst appliquée à la connaissance clients.Une expertise au sein d’un environnement retail en lien avec des enjeux clients est un plus.Vous cherchez à travailler dans un environnement analytique.Votre relationnel et votre pédagogie vous permettent d’échanger avec des interlocuteurs divers et de vulgariser facilement les informations.Rigoureux(se), vous disposez d’un grand sens de l’organisation.Orienté(e) projet, vous êtes en capacité de gérer les aléas et risques associés.Force de proposition, vous donnez vos recommandations et développez de nouvelles pistes d’analyses.Vous maitrisez parfaitement SQL et Python.Vous êtes à l’aise en anglais.Si tel est le cas, n’hésitez pas à postuler !Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Au sein du département Client Insight & Data, vous êtes en charge de structurer et monitorer les KPI’s clients, de proposer des analyses clients pour soutenir les équipes et de développer un nouvel écosystème de dashboards clients.Dans Le Cadre De Vos FonctionsVous définissez, structurez et suivez les KPI’s clients en fonction de nos enjeux business.Vous documentez efficacement la définition des KPI’s et les méthodologies associées afin d’assurer une harmonisation globale, notamment entre le siège et nos marchés.Vous réalisez des analyses clients approfondies pour répondre aux enjeux clients de la Maison. Vous traduisez les questions métiers en résultats analytiques structurés et en insights exploitables.Vous exploiter Google Cloud Platform, SQL et Python pour extraire les données adéquates. Vous définissez une stratégie claire pour l’établissement des dashboards clients, afin d’assurer une réelle homogénéité de nos analyses.Vous partagez vos insights avec des rapports et présentations efficaces et pertinents.Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière !Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition.Vous bénéficierez d’une intégration complète avec des formations sur notre histoire, nos savoir-faire et créations, et un accompagnement au quotidien.Le processus de recrutementPostulez directement en ligneSi votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l’équipe RH pour un entretien.Vous rencontrez ensuite par étape, la Client Insight Manager puis la Responsable Client Insight & Satisfaction.Le cas échéant, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature.

title: User Acquisition - International F/M
description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology.WHY JOIN US? 🚀At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us:💡 An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate📈 Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day🏡 A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us.🌟 A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in BordeauxAre you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gamingENTER THE GAME 🎮As a User Acquisition, you will join the Social & Display/Search team in Bordeaux (France), whose mission is to acquire new players profitably for our applications and websites, and you will be responsible for the acquisition campaigns on the Polish market.YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥In this role, your missions will include:Implementing the user acquisition strategy in Poland for our portfolio of apps/websites Launching and optimizing mobile acquisition campaigns on major social networks and display channels Launching and optimizing Search acquisition campaigns (Apple Search Ads and SEA) Planning monthly/weekly advertising investments in line with the sports calendar specific to your assigned markets and the performance of your campaigns Producing reports on key performance metrics (ROI, CPA, conversion rate, etc.) Working closely with our internal Studio to create assets that drive the best performance Providing ad-hoc analyses and recommendations to optimize performance through data analysis and A/B testing iterations Collaborating continuously with the local marketing teams in Poland WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍We value teammates with a good sense of humor, respect, kindness, enthusiasm, and a genuine passion for their job!This job is made for you if: You are passionate about sportsYou have 1–2 years of experience in app promotion or digital marketing (internships included) You have experience managing paid mobile campaigns on Facebook / Meta You have already worked on paid Search campaigns (SEA and/or Apple Search Ads)Previous experience (internship included) in gaming or with a sports betting operator is a strong plus You are a team player but also able to work independently and take initiative You are organized and disciplined, capable of managing multiple projects/campaigns simultaneously You have strong skills in Excel (pivot tables hold no secrets for you!) and PowerPointAnd finally, you are fluent in English. Polish is a strong plus.WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝If your application is selected, you will be contacted by Benoit within a week for an HR prequalification.We will then ask you to complete the AssessFirst Test (personality, motivations, and reasoning).You will then meet Michael, UA Manager, your future manager, and Etienne, Head of User Acquisition.You will work on a use case to test you UA skills, then meet some stakeholders.Finally, Benoit will conduct a final HR interview, and you will discuss your AssessFirst Test together.To provide an ideal candidate experience, the Betclic recruitment process typically takes 4 to 6 weeks.WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic)🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport)🏡 Hybrid work model📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…)Permanent contract available immediately.📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

Support markets in implementing best practices that improve commercial execution and customer engagement.Cross-functional Leadership Collaborate closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, Revenue Growth Management and Category teams to align commercial priorities. title: マーケティングディビジョン：データ＆インサイトグループ - データアナリスト
description: Job DescriptionJob Description:楽天・事業について私たちは、楽天グループが展開する国内外70以上のサービスを横断的に支えるマーケティングの中核組織です。GMSDの多面的な役割と強み私たちの活動は、数値面でのクロスユース拡大だけにとどまりません。「楽天グループ」のブランド価値最大化し熱量を高め、ユーザーと楽天の絆を強固にするために、私たちは以下の領域を統合的にリードしています。 ブランド・アイデンティティの体現: 楽天独自の強力なアセットを、ブランド戦略の文脈で再構築。グループ全体で統一されたブランドコミュニケーションとブランドエクスペリエンスを設計しています。 クロスユースを加速させるユーザー体験: データに基づいた分析に加え、各事業と連携しながら「楽天のサービスを使い続けることの情緒的価値」を可視化し、クロスユースの拡大をブランドの力で後押しします。 ”楽天らしい”デザイン基盤の構築: ユーザーがどのサービスに触れても「楽天らしさ」を感じられるよう、デザインシステムやUI/UXのスタンダードを構築するクリエイティブ集団が、ブランドの世界観を視覚・体験レベルで社会に浸透させています。 グループマーケティング: すべてのマーケティングチャネル戦略をグループ視点で統括し、ユーザーとの接点すべてにおいて最適な体験を設計をリードしています。私たちは、データドリブンな戦略と、ブランドへの情熱を掛け合わせ、ユーザーにとって「楽天」がなくてはならない存在であり続けるためのブランド戦略を日々進化させています。この巨大なエコシステムというキャンバスに、マーケティングの力で新しいブランドの価値を刻み込んでいく、そんな挑戦を共にできる仲間を募集しています。部署・サービスについてデータ＆インサイトグループでは楽天グループの各データを用いて、 各マーケティング施策の費用対効果（ROI）を厳密に測定し、予算配分の最適化を提言することで、グループ全体の収益性向上を牽引しています。また、単なる属性データだけでなく、行動履歴や購買意欲を掛け合わせた精緻なセグメントを作成し、顧客一人ひとりに最適な体験を提供するためのマーケティング施策を設計しグループ横断でノウハウをヨコテンするなど、今後の楽天グループのマーケティング強化において必要不可欠な機能を担っています。ポジション：募集背景グループ全体のマーケティング体制における「攻め」と「守り」両面での組織強化のための増員採用です。これまでの分析経験を活かし、楽天の展開する様々なサービスを俯瞰する規模感でキャリアを重ね、その後も横断組織での更なるステップアップや各事業への様々な可能性があるポジションです。業務内容本ポジションでは、下記のような業務を行っていただきます。 データ集計・分析を通じた課題解決 楽天グループが持つ膨大なユーザーデータや行動ログ、充実したデータ分析環境（BigQuery・Databricks・BIツールなど）を活用したデータ分析 新規サービス導入における効果試算や効果検証（外部調査にかかわっていただくこともあります。） ダッシュボードの設計・構築・運用 BigQuery/BI（DOMO Tableau, Lookerなど）を用いたデータ加工、ダッシュボードの設計、構築、自動化、KPIモニタリング基盤の開発 分析結果の提言と意思決定支援 アドホックなデータ抽出や仮説検証をサポート 分析結果をストーリーとして構造的に整理し、資料やプレゼンテーションを通じて提案と報告を実施 多様なステークホルダー（マーケティング担当者、開発チームなど）と連携し、定量的なインサイトに基づいた提案や意思決定支援魅力Data/AI活用の最前線：全社的にAI活用を推進しており、楽天が持つ豊富なデータを組み合わせえた業務経験を積むことができます。事業貢献へのインパクト：自身が導き出したインサイトが、楽天エコシステムの成長にインパクトを与え、その成果を実感できるやりがいのあるポジションです。専門家との連携：社内にはデータサイエンスやAIの専門家が多数在籍しており、彼らとの連携を通じて自身のスキルアップを図ることができます。必須要件： SQLを用いたデータ抽出、加工、集計の３年以上の実務経験。 BigQuery上でのデータ加工、およびBIツール（Tableau, Looker, DOMOなど）を用いたデータ加工、データ分析、ダッシュボード構築の３年以上の実務経験。 ビジネス課題を解決するために、仮説設計、分析の構造化、分析設計を自律的に行った経験。 分析結果をストーリーとして構造化し、資料やプレゼンテーションで表現した経験。 多様なステークホルダーと連携し、定量的なインサイトに基づいた提案や意思決定支援を行った経験。歓迎要件： マーケティング部署におけるデータ分析の実務経験（マーケティング施策の効果測定、デジタル広告の最適化、CRM施策のデータ分析など）。 ビジネスレベルの英語力 Cookieやトラッキング技術に関する理解。 生成AI、機械学習、深層学習に関する概念理解、実務経験、またはツール利用経験。 PythonまたはRを用いたデータ分析、可視化、機械学習の実務経験。 基本的な統計知識（平均、分散、母集団/標本、仮説検定など）を活用した実務経験。 統計モデル（ロジスティック回帰、クラスタリング、因子分析など）の知識と実装経験。 ダッシュボードの利用促進や、ユーザー部門でのデータ活用支援（データリテラシー教育、説明会など）の経験。LanguagesEnglish (総合 - 3 - 上級), Japanese (総合 - 4 - 流暢)

「キャッシュレス・消費者還元事業」の決済事業者として本登録されました。キャッシュレス・消費者還元事業とは2019年10月1日の消費税率引上げに伴い、需要平準化対策として、キャッシュレス対応による生産性向上や消費者の利便性向上の観点も含め、消費税率引上げ後の9カ月間に限り、中小・小規模事業者によるキャッシュレス手段を使ったポイント還元を支援する事業です。登録が完了したことで、2019年10月以降、還元対象となる店で「アプリ決済（QR決済）・クレジットカード決済・電子マネー決済」を利用した顧客に還元を実施することや、還元対象となる加盟店様においてはキャッシュレス決済の導入支援として、決済端末の無償貸与や決済手数料を1/3引き下げをすることが可能となります。■サービスの特徴：顧客の利用シーンに応じた、幅広い決済サービスを提案します。・楽天ペイ…楽天IDに登録したクレジットカードで、街の店でもスマホひとつでスピーディに支払いができ、 title: マーケティング部 データアナリスト（UX改善）
description: ■仕事内容無印良品のMUJIアプリを中心としたプロダクトの成長・改善に関わる分析業務を担当していただきます。【具体的には】・アクセスログの解析を中心とした、ユーザーの利用状況・動向の調査・分析、レポーティング・プロダクト全体・各種施策における効果測定、課題分析および効率改善・KPIの考案と予実管理・各種モニタリングに必要なBIダッシュボード作成など専門性に合わせた業務■募集要件【必須】・BtoCのWebサービスまたはアプリの分析経験・SQLを用いたデータ分析の実務経験(1年以上)・データ分析でアクションを自ら提案し、サービスの改善をした経験・ABテストの実施経験、関連する統計知識【歓迎】・OMO観点の分析、サービス改善のご経験該当部署 マーケティング部■募集背景「感じ良い暮らしと社会」を実現するために自ら考え挑戦する個店経営の集団となり、世界中で無印良品の思想に基づいた暮らし方を提案できるよう、「新しい良品計画をつくる」という強い想いを掲げています。過去の「無印」のあらゆる取り組みを見直し、枠にとらわれずお客様に無印良品を更に好きになっていただける仕組み作りを一緒に担ってくださる方を募集しております。■部門の中期計画・商品マーケティング強化：機能的便益・独自性を両立した商品群の360度のマーケティングプランニング・実行・生活者マーケティング強化:顧客化コミュニケーション(顧客育成コンテンツ、顧客化コンテンツ、SNSやWeb広告、共創による情報浸透度の向上)の充実と、顧客分析/CRM施策推進による継続顧客化シナリオの発見と実行・ESG観点のマーケティングコミュニケーション強化：「環境課題の解決に貢献する」「社会課題の解決に貢献する」取り組みを一気通貫したコンセプトで 無印良品の活動そのものとしてコミュニケーションし広く認知を獲得する・オンライン・オフラインメディアの効果的・効率的活用：実査実施検証で見えたチャンスと課題をもとに、「選択と集中」で効率的なマーケティング活動を行う■求める人物像・無印良品の世界観に強い共感をお持ちで、サービスを良くする思いが強い方・能動的になるのではなく主体的に行動できる方・周りの人を巻き込み、自身のアイデアを磨いて実現に向けて行動ができる方・新しいことにチャレンジし、チャレンジを楽しめる方■ポジションの魅力良品計画が掲げている第二創業の中で、マーケティング部門は「商品・サービスの価値を最大化させる」ことをミッションとしています。・他チームからの分析依頼をベースとした社内コンサルティング型の案件と、自らがトリガーとなり課題設定から企画立案遂行まで行うマーケター型の案件どちらも経験ができるポジションです。

title: Consumer Experience Analytics Executive - Japan and Korea
description: Why BAT JapanTwo markets, real consumer data, and a marketing organisation small enough that your analysis reaches the people who set the budget.A market-leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility) Health cover, transport support and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives English and Japanese language training, delivered on company time A published capability framework for every role and grade — so you know precisely what the next grade requires, not just that progression exists — plus online learning and structured leadership programmes Global Top Employer for the ninth consecutive year — certified across five regions and a record 44 countries Tokyo, Japan Full-time Junior ExecutiveDecide which consumer campaigns deserve next year's budget — with the data to prove it. description: description: Company DescriptionPublicis Groupe is not just a company you work for; it’s a platform for you to take your talent to the world. If you want to help change the world, ideas alone are not enough. Real impact can only come from having meaningful access to a world of knowledge, people, and resources. At Publicis Groupe, you are connected to our global network, intelligence, tools, clients, brands and 90,000+ brilliant minds with expertise in data, technology, media, strategy, creativity, and business transformation, all literally at your fingertips.Publicis Groupe is the first largest communications group in the world. Founded in Paris in 1926, we are present in more than 100 countries as leaders in marketing, communication, and digital business transformation.Over the past three years our Japan Media team has won numerous pieces of business, making us the one of the fastest growing agencies in Japan and we are now looking to expand the team. This represents a great opportunity to join a fast moving, award winning media team, that offers massive potential for career growth, the opportunity to work overseas via our Work Your World programme, a leading SGD programme and many more career and life expanding programmes.OverviewAs an Associate Data Analyst, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the largest user and SKU-level datasets in Japan.
