We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.Job Summary:Toptal is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to provide marketing leaders with crucial insights and recommendations for improvement. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where Analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. This role will specifically work with our Marketing organization—spanning paid search (SEM), organic search (SEO), and emerging Generative AI channels—from structuring the underlying data infrastructure to developing reports that support marketing leaders in making data-driven decisions. This role will play a critical role as a strategic advisor to marketing functions and leaders. This person will use data, create and define metrics, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand the business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between data analysis, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. We are looking for someone who is excited about seeing the bigger picture to make cross-functional connections in marketing channels, financial performance, and data. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not. The Senior Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.Responsibilities:The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders.Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives.Measure and diagnose the performance of SEM, SEO, and Generative AI channels—analyzing spend efficiency, keyword and query performance, organic visibility and share of voice, funnel conversion, and lead value/ROAS—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.Work closely with marketing stakeholders, data analysts, and business process owners to empower data-backed decision making, balancing and prioritizing competing requests across teams.Leverage Generative AI tools (such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting workflows, and evaluate the growing impact of AI-driven search and referral channels on marketing performance.Build and maintain marketing data infrastructure from lead acquisition to revenue generation, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads as required.Qualifications and Job Requirements:Bachelor’s degree is required.5+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.2+ years of experience within general consulting or an analytical operations function is required.Demonstrated experience analyzing SEM (paid search), SEO (organic search), and Generative AI / AI-driven search channels is required.Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Analyste Opérations Marketing (RevOps) - ShareGate
description: À propos de WorkleapWorkleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.Ton rôleShareGate, c'est une business de près de 100 M$ d'ARR qui croît grâce à deux moteurs bien différents : l'inbound et le canal partenaires. On vient de terminer notre migration CRM et de verrouiller notre architecture de revenus, ce qui veut dire que, pour la première fois, les données sont assez propres pour répondre à la question qu'on n'a jamais pu trancher correctement : quel marketing génère réellement du revenu, et où devrait aller le prochain dollar ? Ce rôle existe pour porter cette réponse. Tu seras le pendant analytique de notre responsable des opérations marketing, en travaillant côte à côte avec la directrice marketing de ShareGate pour transformer les données de campagnes et d'attribution en décisions sur lesquelles l'équipe marketing et la direction peuvent agir.Ton impact:Prendre en charge l'architecture d'attribution marketing de ShareGate, entre HubSpot et HockeyStack, et traduire les données du funnel en récits prêts pour la direction, pour que les questions d'attribution obtiennent une seule réponse claire ;Propulser la performance marketing en diagnostiquant ce qui fonctionne et ce qui ne fonctionne pas, en inbound comme en canal, pour que le budget se déplace vers les programmes au meilleur rendement chaque trimestre plutôt qu'une fois par année financière ;Construire la couche de reporting et de diagnostic du marketing ShareGate — performance des campagnes, conversion du funnel, qualité des sources — pour que l'équipe planifie à partir de taux de conversion mesurés, pas d'hypothèses ;Intégrer l'IA à ton flux d'analyse — on carbure à Claude — pour faire passer le délai entre la question et la réponse de quelques jours à quelques heures, et faire de l'analyse en profondeur une habitude hebdomadaire plutôt qu'un projet trimestriel. Ton équipeLes 6 à 12 prochains mois, c'est de la construction. Ce rôle n'a jamais existé chez Workleap, et tu hérites d'une business qui vient tout juste de finir de nettoyer ses fondations : la migration CRM est terminée, l'architecture de revenus est fixée, et la visibilité sur l'attribution est encore éparpillée entre deux systèmes. Ton premier mandat : rendre cette architecture cohérente et lisible — puis t'en servir pour dire à l'équipe marketing de ShareGate où investir et où lever le pied.Le RevOps chez Workleap se divise en deux volets. Le premier, Systems & Operations, possède l'automatisation, l'architecture CRM et l'outillage IA pour le GTM. Le second — le tien — regroupe des partenaires d'affaires GTM intégré.es aux unités qu'ils.elles servent, imputables de la performance de leurs parties prenantes : prévisions, conversion du funnel, atteinte des quotas, vélocité. Tu relèveras du directeur RevOps et tu feras équipe serrée avec notre gestionnaire des opérations marketing, qui possède les systèmes et l'exécution des campagnes, pendant que toi, tu possèdes les données et leur interprétation.Ce que tu apportes3 ans et plus en opérations marketing ou en analytique marketing dans une entreprise SaaS B2B, logicielle ou fintech ;Une expertise HubSpot pratique et approfondie — non négociable. Tu y as bâti, cassé et rebâti des logiques de campagnes, de cycle de vie et de reporting ;Une vraie maîtrise des modèles d'attribution — premier touchpoint, dernier touchpoint, multi-touch — et le jugement de savoir lequel répond à quelle question ;De l'aisance avec la mécanique en dessous : gouvernance des UTM, routage des leads et round robins, étapes de cycle de vie, taxonomie des sources et des canaux ;Un instinct d'analyste : tu cherches le « pourquoi » derrière un chiffre avant même qu'on te le demande ;La capacité de prendre un jeu de données brouillon et d'en tirer une réponse en deux diapositives sur laquelle un.e CRO peut agir ;Un usage quotidien et délibéré de l'IA pour accélérer tes propres analyses — pas seulement pour rédiger du texte ;Atout : expérience avec HockeyStack ou une plateforme d'attribution comparable. La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.Ce que le poste inclutSalaire de base : 100 000$ à 130 000$ / OTE : 110 000$ – 140 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local. Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap. REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel. Politique de vacances flexible. Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal. Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an. Claude accessible à tous. Ce qui nous animeChez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.Comment on recruteLa transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.On a hâte de te rencontrer.En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

description: Who We Are:Taiv is a fast-growing tech startup located in Winnipeg, Canada. You'll also go find the data we don't have yet: industry stats, audience research, and original studies our sellers can cite in every pitch.Advertisers are getting more rigorous about what they'll believe, and the companies that can show real results win the budget. That work does not exist at Taiv in one dedicated seat yet, so you'll be building it. You'll present findings back to advertisers yourself, and you'll become the person everyone here goes to when they need a number they can defend.What You'll Be Doing:Manage post-campaign measurement studies from start to finish. Work with measurement vendors to design each study properly, keep it on schedule, and ingest the results when they land.Turn study results into case studies and sales narratives. You can take a study result and turn it into a reason for a media buyer to spend.You write clearly. You make complicated results easy for a busy seller or client to understand.You manage vendors and projects well. You can keep multiple studies with multiple measurement companies on track at once.You are deeply curious and self-directed. This is the storytelling half of the job and it's the harder half.A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent evidence that you can handle research methodology.Nice To Have:Ad measurement experience: brand lift, foot traffic, attribution, or tune-in studies. Useful on the ingestion side, and teachable if you don't have it yet.Media or advertising industry exposure of any kind, even at the agency internship level. description: Role SummaryJob Description SummaryWe are seeking a Data Analyst to join the Analytics Architecture team within McAfee’s Analytics Platform & Enablement organization. In this role you will build, validate, and maintain the analytical logic behind McAfee’s most critical consumer business metrics — retention rate, trial conversion, bookings, subscriber counts, and marketing effectiveness. You will work directly in Databricks writing SQL and Python to transform raw data into certified KPIs that drive decisions at the VP and C-level.This is a hands-on, high-output role. You will own end-to-end analysis cycles: receiving business questions from leadership, translating them into data logic, validating results against source-of-truth systems, and delivering findings that directly influence how McAfee measures and optimizes its subscription business. You will partner closely with Data Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Product teams on a daily basis.This position reports to the Senior Manager of Analytics Architecture and works alongside 2–3 peer analysts who collectively own the analytical foundations for McAfee’s consumer business.This is a Hybrid Position located in either Waterloo or Toronto, Canada. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to either location. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office.Position DetailsAbout The RoleBuild and validate the data logic behind core business KPIs — translating business definitions into certified analytical models across multiple dimensions. Perform end-to-end data reconciliation — validating analytical datasets against finance and operational source-of-truth systems, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy of reported metrics. Conduct customer lifecycle analysis — defining and measuring customer populations, segmenting behavior across acquisition, engagement, and renewal stages, and identifying drivers of key business outcomes. Build waterfall and funnel analyses — decomposing aggregate metric movements into contributing factors, quantifying the impact of each, and presenting findings to leadership in a clear and actionable format. Build and maintain data models and transformation logic — working in Databricks to create, migrate, and backfill analytical tables, validate data transformations, and ensure consistency between raw and curated data layers. Produce and maintain automated dashboards and reports — building executive-facing visualizations that track business performance across multiple data sources with automated refresh pipelines. Conduct root cause analysis on metric anomalies — investigating unexpected movements in KPIs, tracing issues through multiple data layers, and producing actionable findings for business stakeholders. Analyze digital customer journeys and web funnels across acquisition, engagement, trial, purchase, and renewal touchpoints, using web analytics data to identify conversion drivers, drop-offs, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.Deliver ad-hoc analysis for senior leadership — responding to executive requests with data-driven insights on topics such as customer sizing, audience segmentation, and business performance deep dives. Document data lineage and business logic — mapping how metrics flow from source systems through transformation layers to final reporting, ensuring traceability and auditability of all certified KPIs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Finance, and Data Stewards to certify data logic before it enters production reporting, and flag data quality issues proactively. About YouYou have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related quantitative field. You have deep expertise in subscription or SaaS business metrics — including retention rate, churn, auto-renewal, trial conversion, LTV, and bookings — ideally in a consumer technology or eCommerce context. description: Aimez votre emploi!Êtes-vous à la recherche d'une nouvelle opportunité excitante?DAVIDsTEA est un détaillant chef de file et un grossiste en pleine croissance de thé en feuilles de spécialité offrant une sélection de mélanges signature, de thés d’origine unique et de cadeaux et accessoires liés au thé vendus par l’entremise de notre plateforme de commerce en ligne et de 23 boutiques au Canada. Établis à Montréal, nous privilégions des saveurs innovatrices, des ingrédients mieux-être et des thés biologiques. Nous rendons le thé tendance et amusant, et nous sommes fiers d’offrir à la fois le meilleur service possible à nos clients et un environnement de travail positif à nos employés!AperçuNous sommes à la recherche d’un Responsable, marketing du cycle de vie et analytique consommateur pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing! Ce poste combine analytique de données, connaissance du consommateur et stratégie de marketing du cycle de vie.Vous transformerez des données complexes en informations exploitables afin de favoriser l’acquisition, l’engagement, la fidélisation et la croissance de la clientèle sur plusieurs canaux marketing, y compris le courriel, le SMS, la publicité payante et plus encore. En utilisant nos applications et plateformes marketing, vous concevrez et exécuterez des campagnes, des parcours client et des événements déclenchés afin d’assurer l’acquisition, l’engagement et la fidélisation des clients de manière mesurable et basée sur les données. Cela comprend la définition des indicateurs de performance (KPI), la construction de cadres d’attribution, la réalisation d’analyses de cohortes et d’entonnoirs, ainsi que la mise à l’essai et l’amélioration continues des programmes afin d’améliorer la conversion, la fidélisation et le rendement du capital investi (ROI).Si vous êtes passionné par l’analyse des tendances, la découverte des facteurs qui influencent le comportement des consommateurs et la traduction de ces informations en programmes marketing rigoureusement mesurables et à fort impact, ce poste est pour vous.ResponsabilitésÉlaborer et exécuter des stratégies de marketing du cycle de vie basées sur les données à travers le courriel, le SMS et d’autres canaux possédés et payants, avec des cibles de performance claires liées à l’acquisition, l’engagement et la fidélisation (AER).Analyser de grands ensembles de données à l’aide de SQL et d’outils analytiques afin de dégager des informations sur le comportement des consommateurs, les tendances et les occasions de croissance.Traduire les informations analytiques en campagnes marketing concrètes, y compris des parcours client automatisés, la segmentation et la personnalisation.Assumer la responsabilité des rapports quotidiens, hebdomadaires et mensuels sur l’activité des consommateurs sur tous les canaux possédés et payants, en élaborant un tableau de bord répétable qui suit les indicateurs clés appuyant l’atteinte des objectifs AER.Assurer le suivi, le rapport et l’optimisation de la performance des campagnes sur tous les canaux, et créer les tableaux de bord et rapports pertinents pour assurer l’atteinte des objectifs AER.Servir de pont entre les données et l’exécution marketing, en veillant à ce que les informations soient appliquées aux initiatives d’acquisition, d’engagement, de fidélisation et d’expansion.Développer, maintenir et optimiser les tableaux de bord Shopify, les flux Klaviyo et d’autres outils d’automatisation marketing.Diriger des stratégies de tests et des programmes d’optimisation afin d’améliorer les taux d’ouverture, la conversion et le ROI.Assurer la conformité aux réglementations, aux meilleures pratiques de délivrabilité et à l’intégrité des données dans toutes les campagnes.Collaborer de manière transversale avec les équipes de marketing, des réseaux sociaux, de création et de produit afin d’assurer un message cohérent et des parcours client harmonieux.Demeurer à l’affût des tendances de l’industrie et des technologies marketing émergentes afin de favoriser l’innovation.Alors, êtes-vous notre prochain Responsable, marketing du cycle de vie et analytique consommateur?ExigencesBaccalauréat en marketing, administration des affaires, analytique, statistiques ou domaine connexe.5 à 8 ans d’expérience ou plus en marketing du cycle de vie, en marketing courriel/SMS ou en analytique de données, de préférence dans un environnement de commerce de détail numérique ou de vente directe au consommateur (DTC).Solides compétences techniques : maîtrise de SQL, outils de visualisation de données (Power BI, Google Data Studio, Looker, etc.) et maîtrise de Shopify/Klaviyo ou de plateformes similaires.Expérience en segmentation de la clientèle, personnalisation et automatisation pour les programmes de marketing du cycle de vie.Capacité démontrée à analyser des ensembles de données complexes, à générer des informations et à traduire les constats en stratégies marketing concrètes.Connaissance des outils de marketing numérique, de la publicité payante et des plateformes analytiques (Google Analytics, tests A/B, etc.).Excellentes compétences en communication, en gestion de projet et en gestion de plusieurs tâches à la fois; capacité à présenter des données complexes de manière claire et exploitable.Expérience avec le suivi des campagnes, la gouvernance des données et les tableaux de bord de rapports.À l’aise de travailler dans un environnement rapide et collaboratif, et de gérer plusieurs priorités.Une expérience en commerce de détail ou en commerce électronique est un atout de taille.Bilingue anglais/français.Travail sur place à notre bureau de Montréal, 5 jours par semaine.Ça vous plaît? Joignez-vous à nous pour poursuivre notre mission, qui vise à faire sourire le monde… une tasse à la fois.DAVIDsTEA valorise la diversité et l’inclusion et s’engage à bâtir une culture de travail inclusive et positive qui favorise la diversité, l’inclusion et l’accessibilité.Veuillez nous informer si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation durant le processus de recrutement.Note : Dans la présente offre, la forme masculine est utilisée sans discrimination et dans le seul but d’alléger la formulation du texte.

title: Global Market and Competitive Intelligence Manager
description: AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably.We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies.If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at AVEVA Careers.For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our Privacy Policy.Market & Competitive Intelligence Manager (GTM Programs)Location: Calgary - (Hybrid)AVEVA is seeking a Market & Competitive Intelligence Manager to power larger-scale growth programs with high-quality market, customer, and competitive intelligence across key industrial sectors including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Power, EPC, Metals/Mining/Minerals (MMM), CPG, Life Sciences, and Marine. This is an Individual Contributor role and does not include people management.We are looking for a hands-on, execution-focused and highly analytical researcher and data storyteller who can translate diverse intelligence sources (internal and external) into clear, campaign-ready insights and recommendations that strengthen regional GTM, industry campaigns, targeted account demand generation (1: many), and sales pursuits. You will act as the “program intelligence lead” for priority initiatives—clarifying what intelligence is needed, where to source it, how to keep it current, and how to package it so marketing and sales teams can confidently use it. You will also play a key quality-control role for intelligence outputs (including AI-assisted outputs) to ensure accuracy, relevance, and on-message execution.Principal Accountabilities / Key ResponsibilitiesProgram intelligence Provide market and competitive intelligence and recommendations that powers larger-scale programs (regional market planning, industry campaigns, and targeted account demand generation/ABM at 1:many scale). Build “program-ready” deliverables such as campaign insight packs, segment/industry snapshots, competitor POVs, messaging proof points, and pursuit/deal-context briefs. Intelligence Requirements & PrioritizationPartner with regional marketing, digital, sales leaders, and portfolio/industry stakeholders to define what intelligence each program needs to perform (questions to answer, markets/accounts to target, competitors to track, claims/proof points required). Maintain a prioritized research backlog and ensure responsive turnaround on high-impact requests. Program development (repeatable intelligence products + awareness programs)Develop and continuously improve repeatable intelligence “products” aligned to GTM workflows (e.g., segment fit assessments, competitive battlecards, industry trend briefs, quarterly competitor updates, campaign insight kits). Plan and run intelligence awareness programs to increase understanding and usage of AVEVA intelligence across marketing and sales (e.g., onboarding sessions, monthly “what changed” briefings, internal newsletters/digests, enablement moments tied to campaigns and launches). Standardize templates and guidance so stakeholders can quickly apply insights and reuse content consistently. Intelligence distribution & adoptionEmbed intelligence into GTM workflows (campaign planning, enablement, pursuit support, QBRs) so teams can easily find and apply insights at the point of need. Drive ongoing adoption in partnership with regional marketing, digital, sales leadership and enablement—ensuring intelligence is understood, used consistently, and translated into action. Market & competitive analysis (hands-on research + synthesis)Design and execute secondary research and insight synthesis on industry trends, customer pain points, buying dynamics, and competitor positioning/moves. Deliver market and competitive analysis across priority industrial sectors, including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Power, EPC, MMM, CPG, Life Sciences, and Marine, tailoring insights to regional GTM programs, campaigns, ABM motions, and sales pursuits. Contribute to competitive battlecards, competitive dashboards, pursuit support/RFP inputs, and periodic competitor summaries. Quality assurance (outputs, including AI-assisted)Review intelligence and AI-assisted outputs before they reach programs/teams/sellers—ensuring they are accurate, current, well-sourced, and aligned with AVEVA messaging and positioning. Maintain “source-of-truth” references and clarity on confidence levels (what is known vs. inferred). Tools & database management (power user expectations)Become a power user of market intelligence tools and databases (e.g., Crayon, EIC, IIR, Demandbase, Salesforce, Power BI as applicable). Advice on required data hygiene and usability (tagging, organizing, maintaining dashboards/views, and making insights easy to access for stakeholders) to support programs. Important working relationshipsCorporate and Regional Marketing Teams Digital Marketing / ABM Teams Regional Sales (Director-level) & Regional Marketing (Director-level) Portfolio and Industry Marketing Marketing and Sales Operations / Enablement Senior Intelligence & Strategy Leadership Performance and Content Studio Teams Required Skills:5+ years of experience in market research, competitive intelligence, customer insights, customer marketing, or a related analytical role, preferably within B2B technology/software (industrial/engineering/energy/manufacturing markets strongly preferred). Demonstrated experience operating as a hands-on Individual Contributor supporting GTM programs (campaigns, ABM/targeting, regional planning, enablement, pursuit support) with minimal oversight. Market research & intelligence: Strong hands-on experience conducting primary and/or secondary research, synthesizing findings, and translating insights into actions for marketing and sales. Industry knowledge: Experience supporting or researching industrial B2B markets (ideally including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Power, EPC, MMM, CPG, Life Sciences, and/or Marine) and the ability to quickly build credible domain context and customer understanding. Databases and tools:Hands-on experience with CRM, intelligence tools, and/or analytics platforms. Familiarity with Crayon, IIR, EIC, Salesforce, Demandbase, Gainsight, and Power BI is advantageous. Analytical acumen:Strong quantitative and qualitative analysis skills; able to connect the dots across disparate sources and craft a cohesive narrative. Communication & storytelling:Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build clear, concise PowerPoint presentations and stakeholder-ready summaries. Highly organised self-starter with strong project management skills; comfortable handling multiple requests simultaneously with strong attention to detail. Sound judgment and quality orientation, including the ability to validate and improve AI-assisted outputs. EducationBachelor’s degree in marketing, business, economics, engineering, science, data analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience). If you are in ETAP or RIB, please delete the below and this line.Marketing at AVEVAAt AVEVA Marketing, you’ll be part of a diverse global group of creative, strategic and digitally savvy thinkers and builders. Through integrated reputation, demand, engagement and enablement programs, we are at the very heart of advancing AVEVA’s mission to spark industrial ingenuity and drive responsible use of the world’s resources.Whether you’re crafting world-class events and experiences or defining the go-to-market strategy for a particular region, industry or solution, you’ll be driving the success of AVEVA and our remarkable community of sellers, partners and customers.Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.Come and join AVEVA to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Champion the adoption of digital-first, user-centric practices within the organization. title: Marketing Analytics Lead
description: Who We Are 🌍Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.Who We're Looking For 🌟We're looking for a sharp, senior analytics leader to own Marketing Analytics and partner closely with the CMO and Marketing leadership in Austin and across the globe. It's a player-coach role that works through a small team: you'll guide a couple of analysts, but management is the lighter part of the job — you stay hands-on and in the game. Most of your time goes to setting priorities, keeping stakeholders aligned, and partnering on strategy — while still diving into the projects that need you. You're practical about rigor — you know when a question needs hard proof and when a directional read is enough to move fast. And you don't see marketing analytics in isolation: you keep it tied to the bigger picture of the business, working across teams to keep that view connected.You bring 8+ years in Data Analytics or Data Science, deep experience in the Marketing domain, and a track record of leading people and projects. You're fluent in the craft and exceptional at stakeholder management, influence, and storytelling.What You'll Do 🚀Guide a team of marketing analysts. Set direction, prioritize across competing demands, and coach a couple of analysts to do their best work — raising the bar on how the team thinks and operates, while keeping management lightweight so you stay close to the work yourself.Be the analytics partner that shapes and lands decisions. Sit with the CMO and the marketing team — Brand, Lifecycle, Performance, Growth — to frame the right questions, challenge assumptions, and shape strategy with data before decisions are made. Then close the loop with clear narratives, dashboards and self-serve tools that cut noise, and insights that actually change how Marketing operates.Connect Marketing to the bigger picture — and look ahead. Don't run analytics as a silo. Partner across analytics so channel metrics, growth, and company outcomes tell one coherent story, anticipate what the business will need to measure next, and surface the opportunities the data is pointing to before anyone asks.Keep stakeholders and priorities aligned. Translate a steady stream of requests into a clear set of priorities, keep Marketing and analytics partners updated on progress, and drive technical alignment so everyone works from the same definitions, methods, and source of truth.Jump in hands-on where it counts. On the important, high-stakes projects you get involved directly — sometimes building part of it yourself, more often guiding, unblocking, and brainstorming alongside the team — staying close enough to the craft to lead it credibly.Shape the measurement and experimentation framework. Help set the direction for how Marketing measures what's working — attribution, incrementality, CAC and payback, LTV — so the numbers people rely on are sound and actually drive decisions.Balance rigor with pragmatism. Know when a question needs airtight causal proof and when it doesn't. More often you move directionally — forming sharp hypotheses, reading the signal in imperfect data, and making a confident recommendation or telling a clear story without waiting for perfect certainty. You'd rather point the business in the right direction now than be exactly right too late.TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥Experience: 8+ years in Data Analytics, Data Science, or a similar role with substantial hands-on work, with at least 3+ years in the marketing domain. Experience in SaaS and/or PLG background is a plus.Hands-on technical leadership: 2+ years of experience guiding and mentoring a team of analysts while remaining a strong practitioner yourself — still able to dive into important projects and guide the team's technical work, not just direct it.Stakeholder partnership: direct experience working with senior leaders; able to translate strategy into measurement and execution, and to partner across functions to keep a connected, business-wide view.Technical toolkit: advanced SQL on large datasets, strong BI and visualization skills, solid statistics and experimentation fundamentals, and familiarity with causal inference. Comfortable with the tactical underpinnings — data integrations, attribution logic, conversion loops, and LTV modeling. Experience with Python or R is a plus.Ways of working: proactive, structured, and comfortable with ambiguity; able to operate with autonomy and high standards across both strategic and tactical work.What We Offer 🤗Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Tools like Claude and OpenAI are available by default, and we genuinely back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. It's a toolkit that's well ahead of the market, and you'll have it from day one.Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Creating clear narratives around artist performance, audience behaviour and campaign opportunities to help guide business decisions. Advising on data related topics to ensure strategic projects, products and reporting are aligned to label needs. Identifying opportunities for new datasets, dashboards, features or insight products that become integral to how the business operates. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.SkillsSkills & ExperienceStrong ability to turn data into clear insight, narratives and recommendations. Strong stakeholder management skills, with confidence working directly with label teams. Ability to gather requirements and translate business questions into clear analytical briefs. Experience wrangling data using SQL and BigQuery. Comfortable working with partner, platform and internal data sources. Good understanding of artist, audience, campaign and market performance metrics. Ability to turn strategic priorities into actionable analysis, recommendations and next steps. Ability to present insight clearly to senior, creative and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working with analysts and technical teams to shape reporting, dashboards and research. Strong project management skills, with the ability to guide strategic work from brief to delivery. Commercially minded, curious and creative approach to problem-solving. Good understanding of data, AI and modern analytics tools. Experience working within music, media, entertainment or a related creative industry is advantageous. ExperienceExperience in analytics, insight, data strategy, audience research or a related role. Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or strategic capacity. Experience working closely with label, marketing, artist, media or creative teams is advantageous. Experience turning data and insight into clear recommendations that inform business decisions. Experience leading analysis that supports artist strategy, campaign planning, audience development or product development. Experience working with analysts, data scientists, engineering or product teams to turn business questions into reporting, tools or data products. EducationDegree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience. A background in analytics, marketing, business, economics, music, media or a related discipline would be advantageous, particularly where it has involved data-led decision making. title: Graduate Marketing Scientist
description: Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.About The RoleWe're looking for a Graduate Marketing Scientist to join Fospha's Marketing Science team in London.Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Marketing Science owns the applied end of that: designing and delivering incrementality tests and MMM engagements for clients, and standing behind the numbers when a client challenges them.This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work on live test and MMM delivery under supervision from the start, and you'll be the first person looking at a client's data when a number doesn't behave the way it should. It's a role for someone who wants to learn causal measurement properly, in a business where it's the product rather than a side project.Team: Marketing ScienceLevel: Graduate — Entry (Data Science Career Development Framework)Location: LondonWhat you'll doMarketing mix modelling (MMM) & Testing ServicesAssemble and validate test data — geo-level spend and conversion series, checking pre-period parity between treatment and control, spotting the coverage gaps that invalidate a design before it launchesSupport test design under review — market matching and control selection, power and minimum detectable effect sanity checks, and identifying contamination risks such as geo-targeting settings that don't behave the way the platform's documentation claimsRun analysis and read the results honestly — pre-treatment fit diagnostics, lift estimates with their intervals, and what a null result does and doesn't tell youQualify client data for MMM — spend coverage across channels, whether there's enough variation in spend to identify an effect at all, series length and granularity, collinearity between channels, and gaps that will bias the resultAssemble and validate model input datasets, and investigate the discrepancies that surface when you doSupport model runs and read the diagnostics — fit, residuals, convergence, and whether a channel's estimated contribution is plausibleContribute to output-extension work under review — building on an existing MMM result, for example forecasting or budget scenario work derived from itCompare results across methods — where MMM, incrementality, and platform-reported figures disagree, understanding why is the interesting part of the jobModel trust and diagnosticsFirst and second line on client trust queries — investigating why a number changed, working in SQL against client data to isolate the causeDistinguish a bug from a methodology change — attribution window changes, model recalibration, data feed gaps, and platform reporting shifts all look similar from the outside and have very different signatures underneathTriage PSPs on model trust, resolve what you can, and escalate what turns out to be a genuine model problem with a clear diagnosis attachedReconcile platform-reported figures against our measurement — why walled-garden ROAS disagrees with ours is the hardest recurring question in the business, and you'll be learning it from the insideLog and tag incidents consistently, so recurring failure patterns become visible and can be automated away rather than repeatedly handledClient communication and enablementRun templated explainer sessions under review, walking clients through how our measurement worksDraft documentation and presentations above the core explainer content, and feed recurring query themes back into the source materialFact-check methodology claims in product marketing collateral before it goes outWhat we're looking forWe’re looking for someone with a strong foundation in maths and stats with clear communication who is looking to growth their skillset.TechnicalWorking proficiency in SQL — you can investigate a discrepancy yourself rather than asking someone else to pull the dataPython, or a demonstrated ability to pick it up quickly. Most of our analysis tooling sits there. Grounding in inferential statistics — hypothesis testing, uncertainty, statistical power, and what a null result meansSome exposure to experimental design — randomisation, control groups, confounding, and why a badly designed test is worse than no testStrong AI fluency — you use AI tools to get moving on unfamiliar problems and plug gaps in your own knowledge, and you QA the output before you rely on itCommunicationClear, concise written communication — a large share of this job is explaining something technical to someone who isn'tComposure in client-facing conversation, including when the client is unhappy with a numberReal attention to detail, and the discipline to log things consistently even when it's dullHigh agency — you'll be given ownership as fast as you demonstrate you can hold itNice to haveExposure to marketing, ecommerce, or advertising dataFamiliarity with Bayesian methods and/or modellingExperience with cloud data toolingExperience presenting to or supporting external stakeholdersHow you'll growLevel doesn't gate what you're allowed to attempt. It scales how much support you get doing it. A Graduate can work on MMM output-extension work; it just carries heavier review than it would for a Mid.Incrementality delivery: Triages test type and routes to Product where self-serve applies. Prepares and validates test data. Supports design and analysis under review.MMM delivery: Qualifies client data. Assembles model inputs. Contributes to output-extension work under heavy review.Model trust & PSPs: First and second line on trust queries. Triages PSPs, attempts resolution, escalates genuine model problems with a diagnosis.Client sessions: Runs templated explainer sessions under review.Documentation & enablement: Drafts documentation and presentations above the core explainer. Feeds recurring query themes back into explainer content. Fact-checks methodology claims in product marketing collateral.Automated trust workflows: Logs and tags trust incidents consistently so recurring failure patterns are visible. Surfaces themes from the query queue into workflow design.Supervision: Detailed instruction; works closely with senior colleagues. Development time protected against product and consultancy workload.Upskilling is funded, not assumed. A named share of entry-tier capacity is held for development work and protected against the support queue. Nobody upskills in the gaps between tickets, so we don't pretend otherwise.The step to Junior is independence: running templated sessions and first-line triage unaccompanied, and resolving the full range of inbound queries with only moderate senior input.The step to Mid runs through one of two routes — owning a piece of MMM output-extension work, or taking a recurring trust problem you already handle manually and turning it into automated monitoring that alerts an account manager before the client notices. Both are genuinely technical, and both are allocated deliberately rather than first-come-first-served. From Mid, you own MMM and incrementality delivery with senior sign-off.Why FosphaCausal measurement is the product. Geo experiments, MMM, difference-in-differences, and Bayesian attribution are what the business sells. You'll be working on them, not adjacent to them. Live client work early. You'll be on real test and MMM delivery in your first months, with review rather than distance. Structured support, not sink-or-swim. Session allocation rules, a maintained escalation list, and protected development time exist so that being new isn't a liability. A published ladder. You'll know what the next level requires and what evidences readiness for it from your first week.

Strong working knowledge of creative, production, and media datasets, and how they interconnect. title: Senior Strategist
description: About R/GAR/GA is an independent creative innovation company built for the intelligence age. We harness the power of design and technology to create more valuable experiences for people and brands. From architecting adaptive brand experiences with AI to optimising complex systems for real-world impact, we help organisations anticipate change and shape what comes next. Our teams combine craft, curiosity and technology to deliver work that drives both business and human impact.About the RoleThis is a strategic, hands-on role at the intersection of product and experience strategy, audience research, measurement, evaluation, and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) - spanning both traditional digital products (websites, apps) and generative, AI-driven experiences. You will be responsible for shaping how users experience the brand, anchoring those experiences in deep audience insights, and setting the strategy that makes digital and adaptive AI systems measurable, testable, and continuously improvable.Beyond just evaluating performance, you will actively help ideate solutions and shape product strategy, ensuring that as brands communicate across channels and intelligent interfaces, their outputs are resonant, accurate, and rigorously optimised. The remit involves translating audience research, brand intent, and experience strategy into actionable product features, evaluation frameworks, and measurement systems that prove (and improve) real-world performance.You'll help guide projects from audience discovery and solution ideation through to deployment and evaluation, bridging the gap between human-centric design, technical rigour, and strategic accountability. We are seeking a practitioner who values the craft of rigorous testing across both established digital products and emerging generative experiences.This role defines the next generation of strategy and analytics. We are transitioning from retrospective reporting towards real-time, evaluation-driven orchestration. You will architect the brand's measurement and evaluation layer across websites, apps, and an increasingly agentic landscape - building the testing infrastructure and AEO discipline that ensures brand experiences are visible to answer engines, verifiably accurate, and continuously validated at scale.On any given day, you might:Contribute to Product & Experience Strategy: Translate audience research and user insights into actionable product strategies, actively helping teams ideate new features, user journeys, and AI-driven solutions across channels.Synthesise Audience Research: Leverage market research and user insights to build audience personas, uncover user intent, and ensure product ideation is grounded in real human needs.Run AEO Audits: Conduct Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) audits to identify where brand content is missed, misread, or misrepresented by AI systems and answer engines.Set Evaluation Strategy: Define the frameworks and rubrics used to score AI outputs for accuracy, brand alignment, and intent-fulfilment.Scope Testing: Set the strategy and criteria for synthetic test scenarios (1,000+ simulated paths), then interpret the results to surface resilience issues, edge cases, and failure modes.Set Data Strategy: Define the semantic data models and JSON-LD schema approach that make brand content and user intent machine-readable and measurable by AI/answer engines.Interpret Economics: Report on operational metrics (latency, cost, accuracy, hallucination rate), interpreting trends against evaluation benchmarks to guide decisions.Interpret Performance: Build evaluation dashboards and scorecards, turning results into clear findings and recommendations for teams and leadership.Validate Behaviour: Review system prompts and intervention protocols against evaluation results to confirm brand strategy is being encoded correctly.Narrate Strategy: Translate technical performance data and audience insights into high-level strategic narratives and reporting for executive stakeholders.Collaborate Broadly: Partner with data engineering, creative, and technology teams to ideate solutions, define what good looks like, and report on when it's being achieved.You'd be the right fit if you:Prioritise Audience Needs & Intent: Have experience grounding digital products and experiences-from websites and apps to generative, AI-driven interfaces-in deep audience research and user intent.Are Evaluation-Minded: You're fascinated by how AI systems succeed and fail, and see rigorous testing as a core discipline, not an afterthought.Think in AEO: Understand how content and brand signals are discovered, parsed, and surfaced by AI and answer engines - and how to measure that visibility.Ideate & Solve Systemically: Bring a structured, hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving; you actively help ideate strategic solutions rather than just reporting on isolated metrics.Translate Strategy into Metrics: Can turn abstract brand strategy and audience insights into traceable, measurable evaluation criteria.Thrive in Agile: Are comfortable working in a fast-moving, iterative testing and product-development environment.Value Rigour: Take pride in continuous improvement, statistical soundness, and the fine details of a measurement framework.Guard the Brand: Understand the tension between dynamic personalisation and brand consistency, and know how to test for and catch AI 'hallucinations' before they reach users.You bring:Experience: 4–6 years in Product/Experience Strategy, Evaluation, Measurement/Analytics, AI Operations, or Marketing Sciences with a strong measurement focus, spanning both traditional digital products and generative AI experiences.Experience Strategy POV: Background in product strategy, CX/UX strategy, or customer journey design, with a track record of using audience research to ideate solutions and bringing that lens to how AI systems are evaluated and measured.Audience & Market Research Literacy: Familiarity with qualitative and quantitative market research platforms and methods, and how they're used to build personas, uncover intent, and inform product ideation.Channel & Comms Strategy: Experience using audience and channel research to help teams determine which channels, platforms, and AI interfaces are the right fit for reaching a given audience.Technical Foundation: Proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and building evaluation pipelines.Evaluation Tooling: Working familiarity with AI evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Arize, or equivalent, and the ability to interpret their outputs.Agentic Systems: Familiarity with agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar), including how to evaluate and test multi-step, autonomous AI behaviour.AEO Literacy: Practical understanding of how answer engines and LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) surface, cite, and rank content - and how to audit and improve that visibility.Data Comfort: Comfortable working with data in various forms (structured, unstructured, qualitative, quantitative, including JSON / JSON-LD) and translating it into visualisations that make findings engaging and accessible to non-technical audiences.Testing Frameworks: Experience designing test suites, golden datasets, rubrics, or scoring frameworks for evaluating AI outputs at scale.Visual Mapping: Working knowledge of workflow and diagramming tools (Figma, Lucidchart, Miro) for documenting evaluation logic, user journeys, and decision trees.Technical Intuition: A strong understanding of how digital systems work (and fail), and how to design measurements that catch failure early.Cross-Functional Track Record: Demonstrated experience proactively communicating research findings and technical evaluation results to technical, creative, and business audiences alike to spark ideation.Bonus:Prompt Engineering: Familiarity with advanced prompting techniques (Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) and how they affect evaluation outcomes.Structured Data: Experience building or working with databases, vector stores, or knowledge graphs used in retrieval and citation by AI systems.Statistical Methods: Background in experiment design, A/B testing, or statistical significance testing applied to AI system performance.Economic Awareness: Understanding of AI operational costs and performance trade-offs (latency vs. accuracy vs. cost).AEO/SEO Crossover: Experience with traditional SEO or content strategy, adapted to how answer engines discover and cite content.This role is based in London and requires in-office collaboration three days per week: Wednesday, Thursday, and one additional day of your choice. Candidates must be located in the London area or willing to relocate before their start date.

Kleines, eigenständiges Team; deine Tests landen sofort im Business.Skalierung im Rücken. Durchbrich Engpässe, finde Abkürzungen und beseitige Reibungsverluste.Handle wie ein Owner — Mutige Wetten, schnelles HandelnDas ist dein Unternehmen. Übernimm Verantwortung für die Mission und die Ergebnisse. Ergreife Initiative, mach mutige Wetten, die den Fortschritt beschleunigen, und handle entschlossen. title: Director, Demand Generation & ABM
description: DescriptionAbout PaylianceFounded in 2007, Payliance is a trusted leader in payment processing — processing more than $63 billion annually, supporting 40,000+ merchant locations, and serving over 350 lending clients. Lending is core to who we are — our clients span the full spectrum of consumer and commercial lending, from prime and near-prime installment lenders to subprime consumer lenders. Backed by Serent Capital, we're expanding our capabilities and delivering measurable results for clients across lending, e-commerce, and collections.About The RolePayliance is combining Demand Generation and Account-Based Marketing into a single, unified pipeline function. We're seeking one hands-on, revenue-obsessed marketer to own a single pipeline strategy that flexes investment and channel mix by account value: scaled, always-on demand generation for the long tail, and focused, account-based programs for the highest-value strategic accounts.This role owns go-to-market strategy against a lending ICP of roughly 1,300 target accounts, tiered from broad-based demand gen to 1:1 ABM. PayYield is the priority product within that lending ICP, and the ABM infrastructure this role builds is designed around it. Pay by Bank is a separate motion entirely — sold into merchant channels through a partner (Spire), not to lenders directly. This role owns the partnership strategy and coordination on that side, not a parallel ABM build.This is a strategy, account-ownership, and management role. You'll lead a two-person team (Digital Marketing Manager and GTM Engineer) and partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps to define one pipeline engine spanning top-of-funnel awareness through sales-qualified opportunities and closed revenue. This is a high-visibility role in a PE-backed environment where metrics, accountability, and efficient growth matter.What You'll DoUnified Pipeline Strategy: Demand Gen + ABM Own one pipeline strategy: design a tiered go-to-market motion that matches investment to account value — scaled always-on demand generation for the long tail, light-touch (1:many) ABM for mid-tier accounts, and hands-on (1:1/1:few) ABM for named strategic accounts. Optimize the shared target account list with Sales: keep account scoring, selection criteria, and account data current across the ~1,300-account lending ICP, leveraging Clay and 6Sense (via the GTM Engineer) to continuously refresh and validate it. Set the campaign strategy and calendar in collaboration with the CMO (email, paid media, SEO/content syndication, webinars, direct mail, events) and brief the Digital Marketing Manager to build and launch it. Direct paid digital strategy (LinkedIn, Google Ads, industry publications/programmatic) with a clear eye on CAC and pipeline efficiency, layering account-level targeting where it improves ROI on strategic accounts. Identify and test new channels, partners, and tactics (industry associations, payments/lending events, co-marketing, intent-triggered plays) to diversify pipeline sources. Align tiering and messaging to Payliance's core lending segments — subprime consumer and prime/near-prime installment lending — using segment-specific pain points (delinquency and recovery, real-time funding, compliance burden) rather than generic fintech messaging. Own partner-enablement strategy for Pay by Bank through the Spire partnership: set the co-marketing and partner-enablement approach, executed by the Digital Marketing Manager and Marketing & Events Coordinator within existing capacity.Pipeline & Revenue Ownership Own pipeline targets end to end: define, track, and report on MQL-to-SQL-to-opportunity conversion for scaled demand gen and account engagement-to-opportunity conversion for ABM accounts, under one dashboard. Partner with Sales leadership to align on lead and account handoff criteria, SLAs, and feedback loops across both motions, continuously improving lead and account quality. Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate positioning and messaging into campaign assets, landing pages, and account-specific 1:1 content for top-tier accounts. Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure campaign messaging and lead-generation practices meet financial-services advertising requirements.Team Management Manage the Digital Marketing Manager, who owns hands-on execution: HubSpot marketing automation workflows (lead scoring, nurture tracks, segmentation), campaign builds, asset production, list hygiene, paid media execution, and reporting. Your ExperienceWe are looking for candidates who bring:Strong understanding of financial markets, including drivers of return, risk and portfolio construction techniques. Relevant experience at Associate level, typically three to five years, in an analytical, research, strategy or consulting role, including experience working with or analysing portfolios and using data to generate clear, actionable insights. Ability to interpret quantitative analysis and communicate technical concepts clearly and in a commercially relevant manner. Proven ability to engage confidently with clients and communicate portfolio analytics, investment strategy and market insights in a client-facing environment. Flexibility and openness to new challenges, with the ability to work effectively across multiple projects in a dynamic and evolving environment while maintaining strong attention to detail. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset and team-first approach. You will contribute positively to team culture and work effectively across a broad range of stakeholders. Exposure to financial data platforms such as Aladdin, Bloomberg, Morningstar or FactSet, or experience with similar analytical tools. Fluency in English and German. Additionally, You May BringPrior experience with risk management or portfolio construction systems such as Barra, Axioma or Aladdin. Strong understanding of investment management data and experience accessing and analysing data to support research and portfolio insights. Prior experience in macroeconomics, investment strategy or portfolio management. Programming skills in Python, R, MATLAB or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA). Experience producing investment research, thematic content or portfolio insight materials. Additional language skills, such as French or Italian An Investment Management Certificate (IMC), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Financial Risk Manager (FRM), Certificate in Quantitative Finance (CQF), Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA) qualification, or progress towards one of these qualifications. title: Senior AI/ML Data Scientist
description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Operating across the Science of Medicines and Operations, DEPCS is responsible for embedding patient-centered and AI-enabled digital solutions into the fabric of clinical research. Collaborating across clinical, data science, and engineering teams, the role is anchored primarily in wearable sensor data analysis and machine learning. You will act as a key technical and operational anchor, driving sensor data analytics activities to maximize the portfolio impact of measures derived from digital health technologies (DHT).You transform raw sensor data from varied wearable platforms into interpretable digital measures through robust signal processing, feature engineering, and algorithm developmentYou design and execute tailored analytical frameworks to extract clear evidence from continuous sensor streams enabling data-driven clinical decision-makingYou design and implement advanced machine learning algorithms tailored to clinical trial data supporting robust evidence generation and decision-making, ensuring adherence to best software engineering practices, comprehensive documentation, and validation protocols to safeguard scientific rigor. You collaborate cross-functionally with teams including, but not limited to, clinical scientists, digital business leads, biostatisticians, and biomarker leaders, to integrate machine learning models into Roche platforms and clinical workflowsYou present technical insights to both scientific and non-technical audiencesYou contribute to the publication of findings and to internal knowledge development efforts and maintain awareness of trends in ML, digital biomarkers, and clinical AIWho you are:You hold an MSc or PhD (preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and have 6+ years of experience in signal processing or machine learning in biomedical, pharma, or healthcare innovation settingsYou have expertise in sensor data analysis and signal processing developing algorithms or digital measures for healthcare or clinical researchYou have experience in bridging advanced sensor analytics with rigorous statistical frameworks, including the evaluation of psychometric properties to ensure valid evidence generation and bring excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills. You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and the ability to make decisions based upon sound principlesYou are committed to the principles of reproducible research, ensuring that sensor-derived datasets are harmonized, documented, and audit-readyYou are proficient with scientific programming languages and familiar with high-performance computing infrastructure and machine learning experiment monitoring workflowsYou have expertise in best software engineering practices and production infrastructure, including MLOps frameworks and Agile, with exposure to regulated software development as a plusYou demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace. Preferred:Preferred experience with wearable device data and preferred skills include Python, R, Git, Scrum, GitLab or Jira, Docker, shell scripting, and Slurm/LSFExperience developing or validating ML models for regulated environments or real-world datasets with the ability to deliver validation reports, quality assurance protocols, and technical documentation for submission-ready analytics datasetsFamiliarity with high-performance computing or ML experiment management frameworks and contributions to scientific publications or open-source projects in healthcare AIThis position is based in Basel and relocation assistance is not availableReady to make your next big move? title: Director Applied AI for Marketing and Commerce
description: Who We AreArtefact is an applied AI company. We build systems that run in production, in our clients' own cloud, and keep running after we leave. 2,500+ people across 27 countries and 1,000 clients, including some of the largest consumer brands in the world. Not a strategy house that discovered AI eighteen months ago, and not a prototype shop that hands you something you will rebuild from scratch.Three ingredients make that possible, and very few firms have all three: the data, real and messy and at enterprise scale; an applied AI team that can put a model into a governed production environment; and the transformation muscle to make people actually use it.Agentic AI lands on marketing and commerce before it lands anywhere else. Agents browse, compare and buy; clicks stop meaning what they meant; the shelf turns into an API. Every CMO and CCO we talk to is asking the same two questions – am I still visible, and can I still prove what worked – and almost nobody can answer them.What You Will Be DoingYou will own the hardest question in marketing: what actually caused the sales. Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality testing, geo-lift, attribution – for brands where a three percent reallocation of budget is worth more than most consulting engagements.And the question is getting stranger. Alongside the media work, you will sit close to three things we build: synthetic brand personas, designed end to end from character bible and voice through to the generative video and avatar pipeline that produces them, running in the client's own cloud with human authorship and copyright chain documented; AI creative studios that generate brand-consistent product imagery and video at retail scale; and trend intelligence engines that detect a movement, predict where it goes, and explain why it matters commercially – early enough to change what a business actually makes.None of this has a settled measurement stack. Proving it works is the same discipline as proving a television budget worked, applied to something nobody has measured before. That is also you. You will do it as a hands-on scientist and as a trusted advisor to the CMO – both, not either.What That Looks Like Day To DayDirect access to the frontier labs. We work with Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and Mistral as partners, not vendors on a procurement list – early access, joint bets, and the freedom to build with what shipped this quarter rather than what was safe two years ago.You own the outcome, not the deliverable. We are in the client's environment from day zero and still there after launch. No prototype handoffs. When something breaks in production, you are close enough to see it and fix it.Problems worth your brain. Bayesian MMM at group and geo level. Calibrating models against live experiments. Privacy-constrained measurement where the easy signal has disappeared. Working through identification assumptions with people who care as much as you do about getting them right.A direct line to the CMO. Not a workstream lead reporting up through three layers. You present the method, you defend it, you own the recommendation – and you're in the room during qualification, before anything is signed.Room to shape the offer. Measurement is not a finished product. You will help decide what we productise next, what we stop doing, and how we take it to market.People who make you better. You will work alongside scientists, engineers, creatives and strategists who will pick your models apart and then help you fix it. Nobody here ships alone, and nobody is left to fail quietly.What We Are Looking ForSeven things. The first four are non-negotiable – if you don't tick every box but the problem interests you, write to us anyway.Deep marketing measurement expertise. Around eight years of building, not just presenting, MMM, incrementality and attribution work, or the depth to match. You have shipped models that changed how a real budget was spent, and you can talk about the ones that failed.Genuine marketing fluency. You know how retail media behaves differently from paid social, why brand-building resists short-term measurement, and what a media planner is actually going to do with your output on Monday morning. Measurement without marketing intuition produces confident nonsense.Serious data science. Causal inference and Bayesian methods as a working craft, not vocabulary. Comfortable across the wider toolkit – forecasting, optimisation, applied GenAI – and still writing code. You would rather debug it than delegate it.CMO-grade communication. You can hold a technical audience for an hour on the identification strategy and a CMO for ninety seconds on what to do about it, and be trusted by both. This includes saying the result is inconclusive when it is.Production instincts. MLOps and cloud industrialisation. A model living in a notebook is a hobby, not a deliverable.Presence before the contract. You are in the room during qualification and solution design, not handed a signed scope. Buyers judge us on the calibre of the person in front of them – often that is the whole evaluation.AI-native ways of working. You use AI on your own work daily. If you would rather keep the ways of working you already know, ours will frustrate you.You'll thrive here if you'd rather be wrong in production than right in a slide, you use AI to do your own work rather than just talk about it, you care more about the client's problem than your method, you want feedback more than agreement, and you'd take the harder question.Would be nice, not required: exposure to the Nordics, published work or conference speaking on measurement, experience blending data science with GenAI content production, a background in optimisation or supply-chain problems alongside marketing, or a master's/PhD in a quantitative field (or a body of work that makes the question irrelevant).Why You Should Join UsLearning and Development: Join a team of passionate Consultants always ready to help each other, providing opportunities to learn and collaborate with some of the best in the field.Culture of Celebration: We pride ourselves on creating a collaborative and fun work environment with regular team events and activities.Competitive Rewards: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including a competitive salary, phone & travel reimbursements, remote work allowance, and a Onefit membership discount.Work-Life Balance: We offer flexibility with a hybrid working environment that lets you balance personal and professional commitments.Fuel Your Day: Enjoy a healthy and delicious daily lunch from our extensive organic buffet.Weekly Unwind: Take advantage of our weekly massage sessions to de-stress and relax.Centrally Located: Our office is conveniently situated near the station for easy commuting.Career Growth Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional development, offering continuous learning and internal promotion opportunities.Join Us Now and Be Part of the Future:Artefact is experiencing exciting growth, and this is the perfect time to join our dynamic team and contribute to our success story.Come join us!

Zo bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie datagedreven besluitvorming binnen Nederlandse Loterij.Je scoort in deze rol door:complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar slimme analysevraagstukken; analyses uit te voeren die verder gaan dan beschrijvende rapportages;samen met collega's AI-toepassingen te onderzoeken en toe te passen, bijvoorbeeld met LLM's, Agentic AI of adaptive AI; nieuwe en/of geavanceerde analysetechnieken actief naar het team te brengen; collega’s te stimuleren om meer datagedreven te werken.Je wordt onderdeel van een ambitieus Business Intelligence team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Geen eis; affiniteit met of ervaring in een adviserende rol, waarbij je complexe analyses vertaalt naar heldere inzichten voor de business; nieuwsgierigheid naar de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen AI en de motivatie om deze praktisch toe te passen. title: Webanalist
