Build frameworks, dashboards, models, and decision-support tools that help leaders monitor performance, diagnose issues, and make better planning, resourcing, and prioritization decisions. Connect sales and marketing performance into a unified view of acquisition economics, helping Jobber understand how demand, channel mix, sales motion, and customer quality translate into durable revenue growth. Executive Influence & StorytellingBring an analytical perspective to growth strategy, planning, investment decisions, and operating reviews with Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders. Translate complex analytical work into clear narratives, trade-offs, and recommendations that senior leaders can act on. Analytics 2.0 & AI-Powered Decision SupportContribute to Jobber’s Analytics 2.0 roadmap by identifying where AI, ML, automation, and agentic analytics can accelerate Sales and Marketing measurement, forecasting, diagnostics, storytelling, and self-serve decision support. Partner with Analytics Engineering, BI, Data Science, and Data Engineering to operationalize AI-assisted workflows and analytics agents for anomaly detection, campaign diagnostics, forecasting, attribution, causal inference, narrative generation, documentation, and QA. Champion governed self-serve analytics and trusted metrics so Sales and Marketing leaders can answer recurring performance questions without routing every request through an analyst, while preserving analytical quality and clear ownership. Help analysts adopt AI responsibly, validating outputs, understanding limitations, documenting methods, and using automation to create more capacity for strategic modelling and business influence. What You BringSales & Marketing Analytics ExpertiseDeep experience in Sales, Marketing, Growth, Revenue, Demand Generation, Performance Marketing, Channels, Partnerships, or GTM analytics, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or subscription business. Strong understanding of customer acquisition economics, including CAC, LTV, payback period, funnel conversion, pipeline quality, channel performance, sales efficiency, partner/referral performance, and subscription revenue growth. Deep, hands-on experience with marketing and GTM measurement approaches, including attribution, incrementality testing, experimentation, forecasting, budget allocation, and the practical limitations of each method. Experience helping senior Sales and Marketing leaders define success metrics, evaluate performance, diagnose growth opportunities, and make better decisions across the go-to-market funnel. Familiarity with marketing, sales, CRM, ad platform, lifecycle, partnerships, and revenue funnel data, including paid search, paid social, organic, referral, brand, partnerships, lifecycle marketing, and platform-specific measurement constraints from tools such as Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic ad platforms. Hands-on experience building or significantly contributing to advanced marketing measurement approaches such as Marketing Mix Modelling, Multi-Touch Attribution, incrementality experiments, geo or matched-market tests, synthetic control, spend efficiency curves, or causal inference methods, with the judgment to evaluate, challenge, and improve vendor or platform-reported outputs. Technical & Methodological SkillsExpert-level SQL skills, with the ability to work across complex data structures, build analytical datasets, and review analytical logic with confidence. Strong hands-on analytical skills, including performance measurement, exploratory analysis, cohort analysis, impact evaluation, experimentation, forecasting, scenario analysis, segmentation, predictive modelling, and causal inference techniques such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity score matching, or regression discontinuity. Strong proficiency in Python or R for modelling, automation, statistical analysis, and productionized analytics workflows; experience with MMM libraries or statistical modelling frameworks such as Robyn, Meridian, PyMC-Marketing, Bayesian modelling frameworks, or equivalent tools is a strong asset. Strong statistical judgment, including comfort with confidence intervals, effect size estimation, variance, seasonality, bias, model uncertainty, and balancing analytical rigour with pragmatic business decision-making. Experience with modern data stacks and BI tools such as dbt, Snowflake, Redshift, Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms, with a strong ability to build scalable, trusted reporting and decision-support assets. Business & Leadership SkillsProven experience as a people leader in analytics, with a strong track record of developing, coaching, and empowering high-performing analysts. Strong strategic judgment, with the ability to shape priorities, influence senior leaders, and connect analytical work to company-level growth outcomes. Experience owning an analytics roadmap in a fast-moving environment with competing stakeholder needs and high-impact business decisions. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, clarify ambiguous asks, manage trade-offs, and influence Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders through data-backed recommendations. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis, uncertainty, and trade-offs into clear executive-ready narratives. Demonstrated ability to lead AI-assisted analytics adoption across a team, including identifying high-value use cases, setting QA and governance expectations, validating outputs, improving documentation, accelerating analysis, and helping analysts use AI to deliver better decision support without compromising quality. Who You AreYou are a strategic analytics leader who can operate at multiple altitudes. You can zoom into technical details when needed, but you always connect the work back to business decisions and outcomes. You are a strong people leader who creates clarity, raises the bar, and helps analysts do the best work of their careers. You are proactive and resourceful. You do not wait to be handed perfectly formed questions; you identify the highest-value problems, frame the trade-offs, and guide stakeholders toward better decisions. You want to understand what drives acquisition, conversion, channel effectiveness, sales efficiency, partnership growth, and long-term customer value. You hold a high bar for analytical quality and measurement rigour, while staying pragmatic about what is useful, deployable, and decision-relevant in a real business environment. You communicate with clarity and confidence, especially when explaining uncertainty, trade-offs, and imperfect evidence to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable making trade-offs visible. You know how to say yes to the highest-impact work while helping stakeholders understand what must be deprioritized. You are excited by Analytics 2.0. You see emerging tools and operating models as ways to redesign how analytics teams deliver trusted, scalable decision support, not just as productivity shortcuts. LocationWe believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.CompensationAt Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200, a midpoint of $177,900, and a maximum salary of $204,500, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. title: Manager, eCommerce Analytics & Insights
description: Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!Nature & Scope → Your Role at RootsYou'll play a key analytical role behind Roots' digital business — turning ecommerce data into the insights that drive strategy, sharpen investment decisions, and support growth online. You're not just tracking what happened; you're helping the business understand why, and what to do next. Sitting at the intersection of Ecommerce, Marketing, and Analytics, you'll own the reporting rhythms, build the forecasts, and surface the opportunities that keep Roots' digital channel moving forward. This is a high-visibility role for someone who is commercially sharp, deeply curious, and passionate about connecting data to real business outcomes.Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An ImpactAct as a key analytics partner for the Ecommerce and digital leadership team — proactively identifying trends, flagging risks, and providing insights to support decision-making. Deliver the ecommerce performance reporting rhythm — including weekly trading dashboards, channel health reporting, and monthly and quarterly recaps — to support leadership visibility into the digital business. Define, track, and evolve the KPI framework for ecommerce — including traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, and customer acquisition metrics — and translate performance into clear commercial narratives. Develop and maintain ecommerce forecasts to support planning cycles and investment discussions, including weekly, monthly, and seasonal demand forecasts by channel, category, and key business driver. Own the hindsighting process for ecommerce — conducting structured post-period reviews that compare actuals to plan, identify what drove variance, and translate learnings into sharper forecasts and better commercial decisions going forward. Analyze the full digital funnel — from traffic source through to purchase — identifying drop-off points, conversion opportunities, and UX issues that can be acted on by the Ecom and product teams. Partner with Paid Media, CRM, and Brand Marketing to evaluate campaign and channel effectiveness, connecting marketing spend to revenue outcomes and helping teams optimize where investment is deployed. Monitor and interpret customer behaviour on-site — including search performance, product page engagement, wishlist trends, and mobile vs. desktop patterns — to surface assortment and experience insights. Support the A/B testing and experimentation program — helping teams design tests, measure results rigorously, and build a culture of evidence-based iteration. Answer the hard business questions through ad-hoc analysis — whether it's diagnosing a conversion drop, sizing a new market opportunity, or understanding the true ROI of a promotional event. Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that give the Ecom and Marketing teams self-serve visibility into their most important KPIs — without needing to pull a report themselves. Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve the speed, accuracy, and depth of insight generation — and bring a forward-looking perspective on where automation and machine learning can strengthen our ecommerce analytics capability. RequiredQualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring6+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, or a closely related field, ideally within retail or a consumer brand environment. Deep understanding of ecommerce performance drivers — traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, customer acquisition, and retention — and proven ability to connect metrics to commercial outcomes. Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) building dashboards and reports that stakeholders use consistently. Proficiency with web analytics platforms (GA4 preferred) and the ability to interpret customer journey data across the full digital funnel. Experience building and maintaining ecommerce forecasts and sales planning models, including seasonal and weekly demand forecasting. Comfort with hindsighting and post-period analysis — able to close the loop between plan and actuals and turn variance analysis into forward-looking recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to commercial and executive audiences. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready narratives for non-technical stakeholders. Nice to HaveSQL or Python experience for self-serve data exploration and more complex analyses. Familiarity with paid media platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok) and experience evaluating their performance holistically — beyond platform-reported metrics. Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms. Background in omnichannel retail — understanding how digital behaviour connects to in-store and loyalty outcomes. You AreA storyteller first — you know that a great insight is only as valuable as how well it's communicated. Proactive and commercially minded, always connecting data back to business outcomes and growth opportunities. Naturally curious and relentlessly diagnostic — you're never satisfied with what happened and always dig into the why to uncover the insight behind the number. Organized and delivery-focused, able to manage a reporting cadence, a forecast cycle, and ad-hoc requests at the same time without dropping the ball. Comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at prioritizing the questions that matter most in a fast-moving retail environment. At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.Please note: Roots uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process. The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.

description: Who We AreAt Plus Company Media, we thrive at the crossroads of creativity, strategy, and innovation. You will act as a senior leader, serving as the crucial bridge who translates complex statistical outputs (like MMM, MTA, and lift studies) into high-level strategic narratives and multi-million-dollar budget optimization recommendations for modern CMOs and CFOs.Location: TorontoCore Focus: 70% Attribution Methodology & Experimental Design; 30% Client Consulting, Narrative Strategy & Team Mentorship. Unified Measurement Strategy: Champion a Unified Measurement approach, combining macro-level MMM econometric trends with micro-level digital attribution signals to give clients a singular source of truth. New Business & Growth: Serve as the measurement subject matter expert during high-profile agency pitches, articulating our advanced attribution capabilities to prospective client stakeholders. Team Mentorship: Direct and mentor a growing team of media analysts and marketing scientists, cultivating deep methodological expertise and client-ready presentation skills. title: Director, AI & Data Science (Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness)
description: Who We AreArtefact is an applied AI company. Not a strategy house that discovered AI eighteen months ago, and not a prototype shop that hands you something you will rebuild from scratch.Three ingredients make that possible, and very few firms have all three: the data, real and messy and at enterprise scale; an applied AI team that can put a model into a governed production environment; and the transformation muscle to make people actually use it.Agentic AI lands on marketing before it lands anywhere else. You will also help us productize what we build — turning measurement work into reusable accelerators and points of view that scale across accounts.You should be able to step into a live, complex measurement program quickly and earn credibility with senior client stakeholders in the first weeks, not the first quarter.What You'll DoYou will own the hardest question in marketing: what actually caused the sales. Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, geo-lift, attribution — for a brand where a few points of budget reallocation is worth more than most consulting engagements. You will do it as a hands-on scientist and as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders — both, not either.Lead measurement programsOwn the design, execution and interpretation of marketing measurement programs: MMM, geo and incrementality testing, attribution, experimentation and marketing optimization.Own the statistical modeling architecture and the scientific rigor behind it — model specification, validation, calibration against live experimental results, honest treatment of uncertainty, and identification assumptions worked through with people who care as much as you do about getting them right.Adapt frameworks to messy commercial reality: long consideration cycles, CRM-driven demand, short flights, campaign overlap, brand and long-term effects, channel and regional constraints, and privacy-constrained measurement where the easy signal has disappeared.Translate model output into media investment, budget allocation and scenario-planning decisions the client can act on.Own the outcome, not just the deliverableWork in the client's environment from day zero and stay there after launch — no prototype handoffs. When something breaks in production, you're close enough to see it and fix it.Build and deploy GenAI and agentic applications into production that change how measurement gets done and consumed: automated model diagnostics, insight generation, analyst copilots, conversational access to measurement results.Contribute to Artefact's reusable measurement offerings, accelerators and IP.Get direct access to the frontier labs — we work with Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and Mistral as partners, not vendors on a procurement list, with early access and the freedom to build with what shipped this quarter.Build and lead the teamLead and develop data scientists and analysts across parallel workstreams; grow senior talent.Set the delivery standards — reproducibility, documentation, QA and validation of analytical deliverables.Work alongside scientists, engineers, creatives and strategists who will pick your models apart and then help you fix them — nobody here ships alone.Grow the accountShape solutions, support proposals and scope new work; expand the relationship beyond the initial mandate.Represent Artefact externally — white papers, conference talks, published methodologies.Help decide what we productize next, what we stop doing, and how we take it to market — measurement is not a finished product.Get direct access to senior client stakeholders, not a workstream lead reporting up through three layers: you present the method, defend it, own the recommendation, and you're in the room during qualification, before anything is signed.What We're Looking ForDeep marketing measurement expertise. Approximately 10+ years building — not just presenting — Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality and attribution work, applied statistics, causal inference, experimentation and marketing optimization, or the depth to match. You have shipped models that changed how a real budget was spent, and you can talk about the ones that failed.Genuine marketing fluency. You know how retail media behaves differently from paid social, why brand-building resists short-term measurement, and what a media planner is actually going to do with your output on Monday morning. Measurement without marketing intuition produces confident nonsense.Serious data science. Causal inference and Bayesian methods as a working craft, not vocabulary — comfortable across the wider toolkit: forecasting, optimization, experimentation platforms, and applied GenAI, with experience shipping generative AI or agentic AI applications into production for marketing, analytics and decision-making. You're still writing code yourself — you'd rather debug it than delegate it.Executive-grade communication. Strong client-facing and executive communication skills — able to make rigorous methodology legible to executives and business stakeholders, and to defend analytical approaches with skeptical senior stakeholders. You can hold a technical audience for an hour on the identification strategy and a senior client stakeholder for ninety seconds on what to do about it, and be trusted by both — including saying the result is inconclusive when it is.Hands-on program leadership. The ability to lead complex and ambiguous measurement programs while remaining close enough to the work to challenge methodologies, review models and solve difficult technical problems yourself.Team leadership. Experience leading and developing data-science teams across multiple workstreams. A consulting and commercial mindset — shaping solutions, supporting proposals and expanding client relationships, and being in the room during qualification and solution design, not handed a signed scope.Production instincts. MLOps and cloud industrialization — a model living in a notebook is a hobby, not a deliverable. AI-native ways of working. You use AI on your own work daily. If you would rather keep the ways of working you already know, ours will frustrate you.Master's degree (or higher) in computer science, engineering, statistics/mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent research/industry experience.PreferredFinancial-services experience, ideally in banking, wealth management, asset management, credit cards or insurance — this is domain depth we do not have internally and it transfers across accounts, so it's a priority filter, but we will trade it against exceptional measurement and AI strength.Consulting, agency, measurement-vendor or platform background across data-intensive industries such as retail, CPG, healthcare or financial services (e.g., MMM/measurement providers, media agencies, or in-house measurement functions).Experience with brand and long-term marketing measurement (brand tracking, brand equity, long-term effects alongside short-term performance).Experience with major media platforms and ecosystems (Google, Meta, retail media, CTV) and their measurement products.Evidence of external thought leadership: white papers, published methodologies, conference participation, or development of reusable measurement offerings.Visualization and delivery tooling: Looker, Tableau, Power BI or equivalent; cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks).Why Join UsWe are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Analyser les ventes, les parts de marché, les prix, la rentabilité et la performance des produits. Soutenir les équipes Marketing et Ventes dans l’élaboration de stratégies commerciales et de mise en marché. Préparer des analyses, présentations et recommandations stratégiques destinées à la direction. Collaborer avec les équipes internes afin d’assurer la qualité, l’intégrité et la cohérence des données utilisées pour les analyses. Contribuer aux initiatives d’amélioration continue et à l’évolution des outils d’intelligence de marché. Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe. Facteurs de succèsBaccalauréat en administration des affaires, marketing, économie, statistique, analytique ou domaine connexe. 5 à 7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, idéalement dans les domaines des ventes, de l’expérience client (CX) ou de l’intelligence de marché. Excellente capacité à interpréter des données complexes et à les transformer en recommandations d’affaires. Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et expérience avec Power BI ou d’autres outils de visualisation de données. Connaissance de SQL, Power Query ou d’autres outils analytiques constitue un atout. Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes. Solides habiletés en communication et aptitude à présenter des résultats à différents niveaux de l’organisation. Esprit d’initiative, autonomie et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément. Cette langue est utilisée fréquemment dans le cadre des communications écrites et orales. Un niveau avancé est requis. Ce que nous offronsSalaire compétitif et gamme complète d’avantages sociaux. Opportunités de développement professionnel et d’évolution. Environnement de travail dynamique, collaboratif et en transformation. By transforming data into actionable insights, the incumbent helps identify growth opportunities, optimize commercial performance, and support go-to-market strategies.Reporting to the CX team, this role works closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Leadership to provide meaningful insights that drive business decisions.Keys ResponsibilitiesAnalyze market trends, customer behavior, and competitive activity to identify business opportunities. Perform quantitative and qualitative analyses using internal and external data sources. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Analyze sales performance, market share, pricing, profitability, and product performance. Support Marketing and Sales teams in developing commercial and go-to-market strategies. Prepare executive presentations, analyses, and strategic recommendations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and the evolution of market intelligence tools. Perform other related duties as required. Success FactorsBachelor's degree in business administration, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, or a related field. 5–7 years of experience in data analytics, ideally supporting Sales, Customer Experience (CX), or Market Insights. Strong ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable business recommendations. Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools. Knowledge of SQL, Power Query, or other analytical tools is considered an asset. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders. Self-motivated, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This language is frequently used in both written and verbal communications. An advanced level is required. What We OfferCompetitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional development and career growth. A dynamic, collaborative, and evolving work environment. Interviewed candidates will receive an update within 45 days following their final interview.AI-assisted tools may be used at certain stages of the recruitment process; all final decisions are made by our recruitment team.

Design a useful reporting approach, document it as standard, and train strategists and account managers to run it without you. Success here means the process outlives your involvement. Build BI reporting and dashboards clients actually use. In the tools each client already relies on, built so stakeholders bookmark them and share them internally. You'll have a chance to define hypotheses, measurement approaches, and the read of the data. Enable client-side teams. Some of our largest accounts want us to level up their internal teams, not just deliver to them. If sold, you’ll run assessments, workshops, and training that make their people better at measurement. Dreamdata and HockeyStack experience is a bonus. You've also worked with GA4 or comparable web analytics platforms, and with product analytics tools like Amplitude. You can run an analytics audit end to end: find the gaps, prioritize them, and fix the implementation yourself. You can hold your own with a client's engineering team. You know what you're asking for when you request a data layer change; you can read an existing implementation, and you can scope work with the people who will ship it. You think in segments and cohorts, not just aggregates, and you know when an average is hiding the real story. You're a careful, meticulous reader of both data and instructions (the passcode is measurewhatmatters2026). You can explain a finding to a client's VP as clearly as you'd explain it to a fellow analyst, and you're comfortable being challenged on it. Data visualization skills are a strong plus. You know how to make a chart do the explaining. Experience in AEO, SEO, or organic growth marketing is a plus. Real impact: Your analysis directly shapes what clients decide to do next, and what we decide to build as a business. You're not producing reports that sit in a folder. description: Primary Work Address: 4000 Jones Bridge Road, Chevy Chase, MD, 20815Current HHMI Employees, click here to apply via your Workday account.HHMI is focused on supporting and moving science forward in a variety of different ways ranging from conducting basic biomedical research, empowering educators, inspiring students, developing the next generation of scientists – even stretching into film and media production. That work runs across web, email, social, paid media, and in-person channels. Today the team can track performance across each of those channels, but is missing deep visibility and insight into how audiences move between them, and how effectively content and strategy decisions are paying off.You are the person who builds that view, from the ground up. You own the data systems, the analytics infrastructure, and the measurement architecture that show how audiences find, experience, and move through HHMI's digital ecosystem. That means standing up systems that don't exist yet: leading the CRM and CDP implementation from vendor evaluation through integration, designing the cross-channel measurement architecture, governing UTM taxonomy and analytics configuration, tracking search and AI visibility, and building the audience segmentation and dashboards that keep the full team oriented. You work in close partnership with the Director and Content and Digital Experience Senior Manager, turning what the data shows into decisions the team can act on.This is not a pure analytics role or a pure systems role. It takes deep, career-level expertise and comfort operating on both sides at once: the build capability sets the floor, and the analytics fluency builds on it.What You Will Actually DoBuild and own the analytics infrastructure. Design, stand up, and evolve HHMI's digital analytics, including conversion event tracking, journey dashboards, and UTM taxonomy governance, building what is not there yet rather than inheriting a finished stack. This is single ownership with active enforcement, not shared stewardship. Architect the whole ecosystem, not the channels. Design and build the cross-channel measurement and event-tracking architecture, a single view of how audiences move across web, email, social, paid media, and events together. Find the handoffs, the drop-off points, and the channels that are over- or under-leveraged relative to what audiences actually need, and use that to steer where investment and content strategy go next. Run search and AI visibility. Own the program that monitors how HHMI and its programs show up across traditional search and AI platforms. Layer the findings to spot patterns, opportunities, and risks, and flag shifts that change what the team should do about content and experience. Architect and stand up the CRM and CDP. Lead HHMI's CRM and CDP from the ground up, evaluate and select vendors, design the data model and identity resolution, and own the integration patterns that tie them to the rest of the stack. Stand up the platform from scratch, then serve as its primary day-to-day administrator. Partner with the Marketing Manager on list architecture, segmentation, intake forms, and data governance. Own the integration architecture. Connect CRM, CDP, analytics, email, and the website into one coherent, well-governed stack, with clean data flowing between systems by design rather than held together by manual exports. Build measurement into the website redesign. Serve as the measurement and discoverability architect inside HHMI's ongoing website redesign, so tracking, attribution, and AI discoverability are built into the foundation rather than bolted on afterward. Run email as real infrastructure. Manage and evolve the underlying infrastructure of HHMI's email marketing in Mailchimp, including attribution, list management, and integration with the CRM as that system matures. Build the reporting the team runs on. Give the full team a clear view of how audiences find and move through HHMI's channels, including a real comparison of paid and organic performance across sources. Present findings regularly and translate them into plain insight for non-technical people. Lay the groundwork for audience modeling. As the CRM and analytics mature, build the segmentation models that reflect how different groups find, evaluate, and act on HHMI opportunities. Audit the behavioral data HHMI already has, and build the collection infrastructure that future audience modeling will require. What We Are Looking ForBoth sides of the house. Brings 8 to 10 years across digital analytics and marketing operations inside a matrixed organization, and is as comfortable configuring a system as reading what it produces. Insight, not report-pulling. Turns data into decisions people can act on. Anyone can export a dashboard. Knows which number matters this week and why. Builder first, operator second. Has stood up CRM and CDP platforms, not just administered them, and ideally led an implementation end to end: vendor selection, data model, integration. Running an existing stack is table stakes here; building one is the point. Thinks in systems. Data models, integration patterns, identity resolution, and governance are how this role approaches a problem. Builds for maintainability, not one-off fixes. Fluent where search is going. Knows SEO and AEO and search performance analysis, and understands how search visibility and AI discoverability are converging into one discipline. Tagging is second nature. UTM taxonomy, campaign tracking, and pixel tracking (Meta Pixel, Reddit Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag) are familiar ground, and this role is comfortable owning data governance without being told how. Fluent across audiences. Works across content, marketing, and technology teams, driving standards and change across groups not directly managed, and can explain a data finding to a non-technical stakeholder without losing the substance. Education and experience. HHMI is ultimately looking for depth rather than a fixed number of years: what matters is genuine command of building and owning marketing technology systems, digital analytics, and the search and AI visibility landscape. What This Role Is NotA pure analytics role. This role builds and owns the systems, not just reports on them. A pure systems role. Standing up the platform is half the job. The other half is telling the team what the data means. An administrator's seat. This is not inheriting a finished stack to keep running. This role is here to build what is not there yet, then own it. A report-runner's seat. The point is not simply to produce dashboards on request. It is to own the intelligence function and push it forward. A single-channel specialist role. The job is to see the whole ecosystem at once, not to go deep on one channel in isolation. title: Performance Analyst
description: Together we are Trusted to Serve Scotland.Performance Analyst As a Performance Analyst, you'll play a key role in monitoring, analysing and reporting on business performance and KPIs. You'll investigate performance issues to identify root causes, trends and opportunities for improvement, transforming complex data into clear and actionable insights that support effective decision-making across the business.What You'll Be DoingYou'll develop and maintain management information, dashboards, reports, data models and reporting solutions using Power BI and other analytical tools. Working closely with stakeholders, you'll understand reporting requirements, provide insight-led recommendations and support governance and performance review processes through accurate and timely reporting. You'll also ensure the quality, integrity and consistency of data while identifying opportunities to automate and streamline reporting processes.What We're Looking ForYou'll be a highly analytical and proactive individual with experience working with large datasets and complex information to deliver meaningful business insights. That’s why we make sure you have everything you need to find a good work-life balance.You’ll get plenty of time to recharge with 38 days (Pro-rata) of holiday every year (including public holidays). And you can even buy five more if you need a little extra time. You can also take time off to volunteer in your community.When it comes to major life events we have family-friendly policies around adoption, maternity, and parental leave. And for the everyday? We embrace flexible working.For your future, there’s our pension (the ‘know-what-you’ll-get-when-you-retire’ kind), and life assurance.As for some nice extras? You will participate in a company bonus scheme. Not to mention access to SW Splash – handy rewards that can save you money on holidays, bills, and shopping. The not-so-small print  This role will be a Grade 6. If you’re new to Scottish Water, you’ll join us on a starting salary of £37,815. Performance-driven pay progression would then allow you to move through the range to a maximum of £48,395.If you’re interested in this role – or know someone else who might be - we’ll be accepting applications until midnight on 4th September 2026.We operate Balanced Hybrid working at Scottish Water and we encourage people to work half their time in a Scottish Water location. Job offers at Scottish Water are conditional, and will be confirmed on completion of our pre-employment screening, e.g. referencing, criminal record checks, license checks, etc. Screening is conducted on our behalf by a third party, and must be completed before your start date. Don’t worry - we’ll only start these checks once you’ve accepted an offer. A few final things worth knowing…Research shows that some people avoid applying for jobs unless they can meet every single criteria. If you’re interested in this job, but don’t tick all the boxes, apply anyway! We hardly ever hire people who can do every part of a job from Day One. Everyone has a learning curve. So don’t rule yourself out!Let us know if there are any changes we can make to our recruitment process to help you perform at your best. Lots of our people have disabilities or neurodiverse conditions (including some of our recruiters!). We're also aware that some people might be experiencing temporary challenges because of life events, like menopause. We’re very used to making adjustments, so please don’t be afraid to ask.As part of our commitment to developing a flourishing Scotland, it’s important that all our employees are Scottish taxpayers. If you join us, your home address will need to be in Scotland. If you don’t already live here, you'll need to commit to moving here within your first three months.Candidates should be aware that a valid UK driving licence is required for driving on Scottish Water business and claiming business mileage expenses.Please note, Scottish Water takes the safety, health and wellbeing of our employees, colleagues and customers very seriously and as such you may be subject to Drug & Alcohol testing in line with our policy.Finally (finally!), candidates who haven’t submitted an application in the last 12 months will have their records removed from our recruitment database. You won’t need to do anything. Your data will be automatically deleted.We’re here to help. Ask us anything at SWRecruitment@ScottishWater.co.uk

title: Senior Product Analyst - Stumble Guys!

For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. title: Director Reporting
description: Reporting DirectorAmsterdam | Analytics, Measurement & Business IntelligenceVoor een groot internationaal mediabureau in Amsterdam zoeken wij een Reporting Director.Een titel die misschien doet vermoeden dat je vooral met dashboards en rapportages bezig bent. De vraag is niet alleen hoe heeft deze campagne gepresteerd? maar vooral:Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat we marketing structureel op de juiste manier meten en de juiste inzichten gebruiken om betere beslissingen te nemen?Media, marketing én dataVoor deze rol is het belangrijk dat je begrijpt hoe marketing- en mediaprestaties worden gemeten.Je bent bijvoorbeeld bekend met KPI's rondom bereik, performance, conversie en brand health en begrijpt hoe verschillende mediakanalen en databronnen uiteindelijk samenkomen in reporting en analyse.Tegelijkertijd kun je inhoudelijk meepraten over de technische kant van BI en data.Denk aan:Power BISQLDatawarehousingETL-processenBI-architectuurMicrosoft Azure / Azure SQL / Data Factory / Data LakeJe hoeft niet degene te zijn die iedere pipeline of ieder dashboard zelf bouwt. title: Senior Data Analyst Advertising
description: How do you help bol make better decisions?Bol.com continuously advances its platform to create a better tomorrow for over 13 million customers and 50,000+ trading partners. Our advertising business plays an increasingly important role in that ambition — and increasingly, so does the clarity with which we can explain how it's performing. As a Senior Data Analyst, you're the person leadership and key stakeholders turn to when they need to understand not just what the numbers say, but what to do about it.The biggest challengeAdvertising via bol keeps growing, and so does the complexity of explaining why. Revenue moves, but the story behind the movement often doesn't move with it. Is display underperforming, or is the market shifting? Is a driver structural, or a one-off? As a senior analyst you own that story end-to-end: framing the right question, building the analysis that answers it, and staying in the room until the answer actually changes how the business acts. AI is fast taking over the repetitive parts of this work like dashboarding or descriptive questions, freeing you to spend more time on the analysis and the room, not less.What you'll do as a Senior Data Analyst – Business AnalyticsYou'll join 20+ analysts in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working closely with internal stakeholders — Leadership, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development. Within the Business Analytics sub-team, we aim to be the steering model of the advertising via bol department. We shape the strategy, explain performance and guide execution of core initiatives.In practice:Own analyses end-to-end: from framing an ambiguous business question with a stakeholder to shipping the analysis and staying involved until it changes a decisionBuild and maintain driver trees and financial narratives that explain how advertising revenue moves, and whyDive deep into the performance of our advertising propositions, developing domain expertise stakeholders come to rely onApply causal inference, statistical, or econometric methods where correlation isn't good enough — and recognize when it isn't neededUse AI to eliminate the low-value repetitive parts of your work, and reinvest that time into deeper analysis and stakeholder engagementCoach junior analysts on problem framing, technical craft, and operating as a genuine analytical partner rather than an order-takerWrite clean, reusable SQL and Python that scales and solves genuine problemsWhy you can make a differenceYou have 4+ years of hands-on analytics experience, SQL and Python are second nature, and you know how to turn a messy question into a shipped answer. Here's the thing: we're looking for a rounded profile. Some analysts are tech-savy; comfortable with causal inference, econometrics and our full tech stack. Others are strongest on the domain and ownership side: real retail media domain knowledge, end-to-end ownership, staying until insights actually land, coaching junior analysts, and using AI to buy back capacity for higher-value work. You can have a spike on one of them, but we want a minimum level for both.Where you'll be workingYou'll join an international group of 20+ analytics professionals in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working with key stakeholders across leadership, finance, sales, marketing and business development. You will be part of the Business Analytics team. We are the internal-facing arm. You won’t talk to advertisers directly, but you will collaborate with colleagues that decide where our advertising business will go next. Your goal is to help our Retail Media business make sharper decisions. You'll find a mix of colleagues that share a low tolerance for dashboard-and-move-on work: everyone here is expected to own the question, not just answer it. We all bring something special to the table and expect the same of you.Something for you?Story finder: You don't stop at revenue is down. You keep digging until you can say why, and what to do about it.Insight activator: Your definition of done isn't a dashboard or a deck. It's the moment a stakeholder makes a better decision because of something you surfaced.Driven mentor: You make the analysts around you sharper. Not by telling them what to do, but by teaching them how to think.Nothing for you?Dashboard deliverer: You've built some visually stunning dashboards in your career. Which is how you measure their impact.Lone analyst: Stakeholder management distracts from the real work. You'd rather just interact with data.Comfort zone cartographer: You've mastered a solid analytics stack and see no compelling reason to stretch into causal thinking or deeper stakeholder ownership.We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all.Perks of having a blue heart29 days: to rechargeTravel costs: Public transport, car, parking & charging coveredPension plan: 75% premium coveredAnnual bonus: Based on sustainability goals

title: Digital Marketing Manager, Netherlands - MarTech Specialist

What we offer: Competitive Salary Performance-based bonus scheme Global profit share scheme 25 days Annual Leave + Holiday Allowance 30% staff Discount Private Pension Scheme Lunch and Commuting Allowance Hybrid working model: 2 days remote, 3 days office-based Volunteer Day – Twice a year Commitment to Inclusion and Data ProtectionUNIQLO is an inclusive employer, and welcomes applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability or other characteristics.We are dedicated to safeguarding your privacy and personal information; please refer to our privacy policy for details on our recruitment process.Recruitment Security NoticeAll official UNIQLO job postings will redirect you to our official careers page on Workday for application submission. title: eCommerce Lead
description: Working for a good company company.Do you get excited about improving digital journeys and turning website visitors into bookers? Are you analytical, commercially minded and equally comfortable with strategy and hands-on execution? Then keep reading!Zoku provides a home for business travelers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We're a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize across Europe. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.TELL ME MOREAs our eCommerce Lead, you own conversion. Specifically: Zoku's online booking journey, our conversion rate optimization and experimentation program and the growth of direct revenue across all four locations.This is the single biggest value-creation opportunity in our commercial plan. Every visitor who books with us directly instead of through an OTA is margin we keep, a guest relationship we own, and data we can act on. You're the person accountable for moving that number, through disciplined testing, sharp digital merchandising and a booking journey that stops getting in people's way.You'll own the performance of our website and booking engine, using data, experimentation and merchandising to help guests find the right path to book a stay, coworking space, meeting or event, restaurant table and more. Working closely with the Head of Marketing & eCommerce, Revenue, Commercial, CRM and SEO teams, as well as external agency partners, you'll turn digital opportunities into measurable improvements.One day, you might be investigating a drop in conversion; the next, you could be shipping a landing page, designing an A/B test, or rethinking how an offer is presented at the exact moment someone is deciding.WHAT WILL YOU DO?No day looks the same as an eCommerce Lead… but here's a glimpse of what you can expect:Own Conversion Rate Optimization: CRO is yours end to end, across the website and booking engine, for every product we sell online. You own the conversion rate, the roadmap that improves it and the reporting behind it.Build & Run the Experimentation Program: Design and run a continuous testing program: maintain the hypothesis backlog, prioritize by expected impact, run clean A/B and multivariate tests, call the results honestly and roll the winners out across locations. You own the program, not just individual tests.Grow Direct Bookings: Own the direct booking target. Develop and execute the initiatives that shift share away from OTAs and grow online revenue across stays, coworking, meetings and events, food and beverage and other commercial offerings.Improve the Customer Journey: Find the friction across Zoku's booking paths and remove it, making it easier for guests to discover, compare and book the right product or experience.Lead eCommerce Campaigns: Plan and launch website campaigns, landing pages and promotional journeys together with Marketing, Revenue and local teams.Manage Digital Merchandising: Ensure rooms, workspaces, meeting packages, restaurant experiences, offers and direct-booking benefits are presented clearly, accurately and persuasively online.Coordinate Website Content: Work with Marketing and local teams to keep website content relevant, consistent and commercially effective across all locations.Analyze Performance: Monitor performance across the website, booking engine, meeting and event enquiries, restaurant reservations and digital campaigns. Turn data into clear insights and practical recommendations that improve conversion and revenue.Work Smart with AI: Use AI throughout the cycle, analyzing session and funnel data, generating and pressure-testing hypotheses, drafting landing page and merchandising copy variants for testing, and speeding up reporting, so you can run more experiments than a team this size normally could.Connect Digital Channels: Coordinate with SEO, paid media and CRM activities so traffic lands on relevant, high-performing digital experiences.Manage Digital Projects: Coordinate website, booking-engine and tracking projects with agencies, technology partners and internal stakeholders.Support Commercial Priorities: Help locations bring new rooms, packages and offers online while ensuring quality and consistency across the portfolio.WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?A bonus system based on your team's collective goals.Cool benefits like discounts, friends & family rates at all Zoku locations and plenty of reasons to visit our hotels.A fun, international company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with.Exciting on-the-job learning opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.Full ownership of CRO, experimentation and direct booking growth, one of the clearest value-creation opportunities in the business.A blank page: you build the testing program, choose the tooling and set the standards, rather than inherit them.A role at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.JOB REQUIREMENTSWE LOVE PEOPLE WHOHave 3-6 years of experience in eCommerce, digital marketing, website management or conversion optimization.Have run a structured experimentation or CRO program, not just occasional tests, and can talk through hypotheses that failed as easily as ones that won.Have a strong understanding of website performance, booking journeys and digital customer experience.Have experience working with CMS platforms, booking engines, analytics tools and digital campaigns.Are commercially minded and focused on direct revenue, conversion and measurable results.Are analytical and comfortable translating data into practical improvements.Use AI tools daily to move faster on analysis, copy variants and reporting.Are strong project managers who can coordinate multiple stakeholders, agencies and technology partners.Are hands-on, structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to move from analysis to execution.Have experience in hospitality, travel, serviced apartments or multi-location businesses. This is considered a big plus.Have previously worked with WordPress to manage a website, and PostHog to analyze e-commerce data.A FEW MUST HAVESYou have experience managing or improving websites, booking journeys or digital conversion.You have hands-on experience with conversion optimization, A/B testing and digital performance reporting, including designing tests and interpreting results.You are confident working with CMS platforms, analytics tools, booking engines and digital agencies.You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work.You can coordinate website content, campaigns and commercial priorities across multiple locations.You have strong stakeholder management skills and can work closely with Marketing, Revenue, CRM, SEO and local teams.You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English.You are an EU resident or have a valid working and residence permit for The Netherlands.You love to work, because we'll need you full-time.

Where there isn't enough data, be pragmatic: apply market best-practices and decide based on the information you have. Partner with wider Digital team to align landing pages with paid and lifecycle campaigns. Continuously benchmark our website against best-in-class B2B experiences. Familiarity with a modern CMS (Webflow) and analytics tooling (e.g. GA4, Search Console, HockeyStack, SemRush or similar). Detail-oriented and structured - you can run multiple pages and projects in parallel without losing sight of the strategy. Excellent command of English; any additional languages are a real bonus (i.e. Dutch, German, Spanish). Based in or willing to commute to Eindhoven 2–3 days per week. You see what AI and automation are doing to web and digital experience - and you want to be at the front of it, not catching up.  Nice to have: UX/UI design experience, you’ve been in a specialist role on this domain before. Voor samenwerking met collega's kan het incidenteel prettig zijn om in Amstelveen aanwezig te zijn.Startdatum: per directWerklocatie: voornamelijk thuis, incidenteel AmstelveenNiveau: GCM4, maximaal GCM5Jouw rolAls Software Reporting & Analytics Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, verbeteren en beheren van rapportages, dashboards en KPI's rondom software engineering.Je vertaalt data uit verschillende systemen naar duidelijke inzichten voor teams, management en andere stakeholders. Daarbij kijk je onder andere naar prestaties, kosten, compliance, lifecycle en mogelijke risico's.Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder meer uit:ontwikkelen en onderhouden van dashboards en rapportages;definiëren en monitoren van KPI's en software metrics;analyseren van trends, risico's en verbetermogelijkheden;werken met systemen zoals Jira, Azure DevOps, SonarQube en CAST;bewaken van datakwaliteit en integriteit;combineren van data uit verschillende bronnen;verbeteren en automatiseren van reportingprocessen;toepassen van Function Point Analysis;presenteren van analyses en aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en management.Wie ben jij?We zoeken een ervaren medior/senior professional die analytisch sterk is en goed kan schakelen tussen techniek, data en de business.Je beschikt over:HBO-niveau, bij voorkeur richting Software Engineering;aantoonbare ervaring met software metrics, reporting en analytics;ervaring met Function Point Analysis;ervaring met Jira en/of Azure DevOps;goede kennis van reporting- en visualisatietools;sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden;het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken en meerdere prioriteiten te managen.Ervaring met predictive analytics, lifecycle modelling en reportingautomatisering is een pré.Certificeringen zoals PSM1, DASA, ITIL, PRINCE2 of CFPS zijn mooi meegenomen.Waarom deze rol?Een mooie kans voor een ervaren specialist die niet alleen rapportages wil maken, maar ook wil bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en verdere professionalisering van software engineering.Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid, werkt met verschillende stakeholders en hebt de ruimte om reporting en metrics verder te verbeteren. Bovendien kan de functie vrijwel volledig vanuit huis worden uitgevoerd.

title: Business intelligence specialist
description: Als business intelligence specialist bij de gemeente Amsterdam maak je ingewikkelde data begrijpelijk. Je maakt dashboards die helpen om de stad goed te sturen. Je werkt aan verschillende vragen over data in de openbare ruimte en gebouwen. Bijvoorbeeld dashboards voor storingsmeldingen en interne werkprocessen. Je doet dit samen met het scrumteam van Amsterdam Connect. Je werkt onder begeleiding van de Product Owner en de Techlead. De functieAmsterdam werkt steeds meer met data. Er is behoefte aan duidelijke informatie die helpt om betere keuzes te maken en de dienstverlening te verbeteren. De vakgroep Business Intelligence speelt hierbij een belangrijke rol. Vooral bij informatie die helpt om te sturen. Dit onderwerp krijgt de komende jaren veel aandacht in Amsterdam.De vakgroep Business Intelligence zet ruwe data om in dashboards en andere informatieproducten. Het team analyseert data en gebruikt de inzichten om de organisatie te verbeteren. Ook werkt het team met BI-tools en maakt het standaarden en voorbeelden voor dashboards en rapportages. De vakgroep bestaat uit ongeveer 25 BI-professionals. Zij werken in verschillende datateams binnen de gemeente.Als business intelligence specialist vertaal je de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie naar duidelijke informatieproducten. Je onderzoekt welke gegevens en technische oplossingen nodig zijn. Ook zorg je dat de oplossing past bij de vraag. Bij datagedreven werken in Amsterdam staat de menselijke maat altijd voorop.Dit doe je op een gemiddelde dagJe vertaalt vragen van de organisatie naar dashboards en duidelijke inzichten. Je werkt samen met data-engineers en data-analisten. In elke sprint leveren jullie zoveel mogelijk waarde. Veel agile overleggen zijn op locatie. Je maakt gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards in Power BI. Gebruikers begrijpen deze makkelijk. De dashboards helpen bij operationele keuzes en beleidskeuzes. Je helpt de datakwaliteit te verbeteren. Zo zijn beslissingen betrouwbaarder en passen ze bij de waarden van Amsterdam. Je helpt de stad beter te sturen. Dit doe je door informatie op de juiste plek en op de juiste manier beschikbaar te maken. Hier ga je aan de slagWe willen een goede werkgever zijn die ervoor zorgt dat alle collega’s zich gezien en gewaardeerd voelen. We koesteren verschillen tussen collega’s, al die verschillen zorgen voor betere resultaten voor onze organisatie én onze stad. We streven daarbij naar een personeelsbestand dat een afspiegeling is van de beroepsbevolking van Amsterdam. Dus wie jij ook bent: bij ons ben je van harte welkom!Digitalisering bij gemeente AmsterdamBewoners, ondernemers en bezoekers van de stad Amsterdam verwachten een optimaal functionerende stad die aansluit bij de digitale toekomst. Dat betekent dat wij als gemeente moeten blijven innoveren om een steeds sneller transformerende stad goed te kunnen coördineren en bedienen. Daarom digitaliseert het i-domein, het IT-, Innovatie- en Dataonderdeel van de gemeente Amsterdam, de dienstverlening aan de stad in rap tempo.Door een vooruitziende blik en een goede inrichting van diensten vormt de gemeenteAmsterdam daarnaast een solide organisatie die bestand is tegen de toenemende dreiging van buitenaf voor ons digitale netwerk. Digitaliseren betekent vooral dat we de komende jaren fors investeren in de benodigde kennis en vaardigheden van onze medewerkers, dat we gemeentebrede omscholingstrajecten organiseren voor banen van de toekomst en dat agile werken de norm is binnen IT, Innovatie en Data.Werken bij de gemeente Amsterdam betekent daardoor leren en kennis delen in een vooruitstrevende organisatie die de digitale maatschappij van nu en de toekomst succesvol bedient.De directie DataHelpt de gemeente Amsterdam om beter met data te werken en datagedreven beslissingen te nemen. We brengen kennis over data samen en zorgen voor een sterk fundament en duidelijke afspraken over het gebruik van data. Met 250 collega’s maken we betrouwbare en schaalbare dataproducten en bewaken we de kwaliteit van data en het gebruik ervan.Dit breng je meeVoor deze functie Business Intelligence specialist beschik je over:In de afgelopen 7 jaar, minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring opgedaan in een rol als business intelligence specialist, waarbij je verantwoordelijk was voor het ontwikkelen en opleveren van dashboards.Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring met Power BI en het werken volgens de Agile werkwijze.Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in het werken binnen een complex stakeholderveld.Je hebt aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van dataverwerking, datakwaliteit, datamodellering en datamanagement.Aan competenties breng je mee:Samenwerken: Levert een constructieve bijdrage aan een gezamenlijk resultaat, in het bijzonder aan de sfeer en de relaties binnen de groep of het team.Relatiebeheer: Bouwt persoonlijke relaties op met klanten en andere contactpersonen, onderhoudt en benut ze.Initiatief: Onderneemt zelfstandig actie. Signaleert kansen en zet deze om in verbeterings- en vernieuwingsacties, die bijdragen aan betere organisatieprestaties.Resultaatgerichtheid: Concrete doelen als uitgangspunt nemen voor het eigen gedrag en hieraan vasthouden totdat het doel bereikt is.Dit bieden we jouAls Business Intelligence specialist kom je ons minimaal 32 en maximaal 36 uren per week versterken en kun je rekenen op onderstaande arbeidsvoorwaarden.Een brutomaandsalaris tussen € 4.520,- tot € 6.422,- (schaal 11) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Het exacte salaris wordt afgestemd op de opleiding, kennis en ervaring die je meebrengt. Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd voor de duur van 12 maanden, als je op dit moment nog geen, of een tijdelijke, arbeidsovereenkomst hebt bij de gemeente Amsterdam. Verlenging met een jaar behoort tot de mogelijkheid en na 2 jaar zou het een vast contract kunnen worden. Als je al een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd hebt bij de gemeente Amsterdam, dan behoud je deze en word je uitgeleend middels een overeenkomst tijdelijke inzet. Ontwikkel- en opleidingsmogelijkheden. Ons interne opleidingscentrum, de Amsterdamse School, biedt verschillende opleidingen, ontwikkeltrajecten en begeleiding in het werk waardoor je jezelf kan blijven uitdagen.Een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% van jouw salaris dat je kunt gebruiken voor bijvoorbeeld extra pensioenopbouw of extra verlofdagen.Een pensioenregeling via ABP, het pensioenfonds voor overheid en onderwijs. Wij betalen 70% van jouw pensioenpremie.Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,10 per kilometer voor reizen met de auto, € 0,15 per kilometer voor reizen met de fiets en € 0,21 per kilometer voor reizen met het OV. Dit geldt tot 45 kilometer enkele reis woon-werkafstand en voor het aantal dagen dat je op kantoor werkt. Voor thuiswerkdagen ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 3,25 netto per werkdag dat je thuis werkt.Een maandelijkse bijdrage in de ziektekostenverzekering.Hybride werken: in deze functie kun je deels thuis en deels op kantoor werken. We bieden (thuis)werkmiddelen aan om je werkplek veilig en gezond in te richten. Een mobiele telefoon en/of laptop. Nieuwsgierig naar al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Bekijk de Personeelsregelingen Gemeente Amsterdam (PGA).Solliciteren naar deze baanSpreekt deze vacature je aan, dan ontvangen we jouw sollicitatie graag uiterlijk woensdag 16 september 2026 via de ‘direct solliciteren’ button.Deze vacature staat gelijktijdig intern en extern uit. Medewerkers van de gemeente Amsterdam hebben voorrang in de procedure. Wij ontvangen graag je motivatie, waarin je in maximaal 1 A4 pagina toelicht waarom jouw werkervaring en competenties aansluiten bij deze functie. Je motivatie wordt meegewogen tijdens de selectieprocedureVoor de eerste gesprekken hebben we een selectiecommissie samengesteld bestaande uit de teamleider van de vakgroep Business Intelligence samen met de productowner en de techlead van het team. Voor de tweede gesprekken hebben we een selectiecommissie samengesteld bestaande uit de vakgroepmanager Business Intelligence en een BI-specialist. Sluit jouw cv aan bij de functie-eisen, dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek.De eerste gesprekken vinden fysiek plaats, op maandag 21 september 2026 en donderdag 24 september 2026 op onze kantoorlocatie aan de Weesperplein 8 te Amsterdam. De tweede gesprekken vinden fysiek plaats, op vrijdag 2 oktober 2026 op onze kantoorlocatie aan de President Kennedylaan 923 te Amsterdam. Van elke collega die ons komt versterken vragen wij een recente Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).Ongevraagde acquisitie door bemiddelingsbureaus stellen we niet op prijs en kan leiden tot uitsluiting bij onze andere wervingsacties. Ook het ongevraagd sturen van cv’s door bureaus aan onze medewerkers zien we als acquisitie. Deze cv’s nemen we niet in behandeling.

title: BI Developer
description: Job DescriptionWhy we are hereTony’s Chocolonely is committed to ending exploitation in cocoa. We are an impact company that makes chocolate, not a chocolate company that makes impact. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example, demonstrating that ethical practices and success can go hand in hand. Through Tony's Open Chain (TOC), mission allies like Albert Heijn, Ben & Jerry's, Jokolade, and Aldi have embraced a fairer, more transparent supply chain for their chocolate too.What You Will DoWe are looking for a BI Developer to help empower teams across Tony's with reliable, accessible, and impactful data insights. As the first point of contact for BI-related questions, you will support colleagues across the business, drive adoption of self-service BI tools, and contribute to the development of datasets and dashboards that help teams make better decisions.Working closely with the Senior BI Developer, Senior Data Engineer, and Operations teams, you will help create scalable reporting solutions, maintain data quality, and ensure Tony's continues to build a strong data-driven culture. If you enjoy solving problems, turning business needs into clear insights, and learning in a fast-paced scale-up environment, we'd love to hear from you.You will be part of the FBI (Finance, Business Intelligence & IT) team and report to the BI Manager.All wrapped upProvide first-line BI support: Act as the go-to contact for BI-related questions, supporting teams with dashboards, reports, data interpretation, and self-service analytics tools.Develop datasets and dashboards: Collaborate with Operations teams to translate business requirements into meaningful datasets, reports, and Power BI dashboards.Ensure data quality: Monitor, validate, and improve data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting solutions before deployment.Drive BI adoption: Facilitate training sessions, create user-friendly documentation, and empower teams to confidently use BI tools and dashboards.Collaborate across teams: Build strong relationships with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, gather feedback, and continuously improve solutions.Support process improvements: Identify opportunities to optimize reporting processes, automate manual tasks, and improve the overall self-service BI experience.Utilize data and insights: Monitor dashboard usage and user feedback to evaluate impact, prioritize enhancements, and support data-driven decision making across Tony's.Deal smoothly with the changes that come with a growing company and contribute positively to the performance of Team Tony's.Jump in, help each other and regularly get coffee or tea for another Tony.Raise the bar. Challenge yourself and Team Tony's to increase our ambition and accomplish our mission. Make mistakes along the way and learn from them.Live our core values: outspoken, in it together, entrepreneurial, raise the bar and makes you smile.Job RequirementsOur new Flavour 2-3 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Reporting, or a similar data-focused role.You have experience working with Power BI and are comfortable creating dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support business decision-making.You possess strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modelling concepts.You are eager to develop your technical expertise and enjoy learning from more experienced colleagues within a collaborative team environment.You demonstrate an analytical mindset and can translate business questions into practical reporting solutions.You are comfortable supporting end-users, explaining data concepts, and providing guidance to colleagues with varying levels of BI knowledge.You proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance reporting efficiency.You have experience working with cloud-based data environments, preferably Microsoft Azure.You are organized and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.You enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across different business functions and building strong working relationships.You thrive in a fast-paced scale-up environment and are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a growing data function.Excellent communication skills in English.We are all about being more in person than apart; this means we offer flexibility but see each other in the office on average 3 days a week. More is fine too!Believe wholeheartedly in Tony’s purpose. You live our core values: outspoken, in it together, entrepreneurial, raise the bar and makes you smile.Our Benefits (the Icing On The Cake)At Tony's you will get the opportunity to be part of something extraordinary; first and foremost, by making real impact in the world but also enjoying the nice benefits we provide as you help us succeed. We are dedicated to enabling all Tonys to grow and develop their careers and therefore we offer training programs, regular feedback cycles, coaching and a generous L&D budget. We also offer a wide range of additional benefits, including a luxurious vega-lunch, company bonus, minimum of 28 holidays, inspirational team updates, unforgettable events and unlimited chocolate. But we also know chocolate won't cover the bills, so we have made sure your salary is just as rewarding. For this role, that means a salary between €55K-€65k on a yearly basis, including holiday pay.

title: Interaction Analyst

title: Teamleider Digitale Diensten & Analyse

De twee grote websites trekken samen ongeveer vier miljoen bezoekers per jaar.Met betrouwbare informatie, praktische adviezen en digitale tools maken we duurzamer leven makkelijker. Jij en je team zorgen dat onze digitale diensten betrouwbaar, gebruiksvriendelijk en toekomstbestendig zijn. Jullie verbeteren continu de vindbaarheid en het bereik, zodat meer mensen onze informatie en tools kunnen vinden en gebruiken bij het maken van duurzamere keuzes.Je bent niet alleen leidinggevende, maar ook degene die overzicht houdt en richting geeft. Je bepaalt de digitaal-technische koers, bewaakt de samenhang tussen onze digitale diensten en vertaalt ontwikkelingen op het gebied van technologie, data, SEO en GEO naar concrete keuzes. Zo help je Milieu Centraal om ook in een snel veranderend digitaal landschap zichtbaar, relevant en betrouwbaar te blijven. Je krijgt veel ruimte om het digitale domein verder vorm te geven. Daarbij kun je bouwen op de kennis van vijf digitale specialisten en verschillende externe partners.Wat ga je doen?In deze functie combineer je leiderschap, digitale strategie en uitvoering. Je:Geeft leiding aan de digitaal specialisten en op termijn ook aan nieuwe teamleden met expertise op het gebied van dataBouwt aan een sterk en zelfstandig team, met duidelijke doelen, rollen en verantwoordelijkheden. Je geeft mensen ruimte om zich professioneel te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemenOntwikkelt en bewaakt de digitaal-technische koers voor onze websites, systemen en toolsVertaalt organisatiedoelen en digitale ontwikkelingen naar heldere prioriteiten en een jaarplanningOntwikkelt onze aanpak voor webdata, SEO en zichtbaarheid in Google en AI-dienstenBepaalt samen met het team welke KPI’s we volgen en hoe we data gebruiken om onze digitale diensten te verbeteren Bewaakt de kwaliteit, veiligheid, toegankelijkheid, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en samenhang van onze digitale dienstenStuurt op capaciteit, planning, budget en resultatenStuurt externe leveranciers aan en maakt keuzes over ontwikkeling, beheer en investeringenWerkt nauw samen met contentspecialisten, communicatieadviseurs, projectleiders en onderzoekersAdviseert op managementniveau en bent inhoudelijk klankbord bij complexe digitale vraagstukkenSignaleert nieuwe digitale kansen en risico’s en vertaalt die naar concrete verbeteringenWe werken onder meer met Prepr, Umbraco, Matomo, Piwik, Surfer SEO, Gaply, Monday en Exact. Je hoeft deze systemen niet al te kennen. Belangrijker is dat je snel begrijpt hoe digitale systemen samenhangen en kunt beoordelen wat de organisatie nodig heeft.Dit zijn je belangrijkste opgavenDe komende jaren werken we aan de digitale uitvoering van de rebranding van Milieu Centraal en de verhuizing van onze websites naar een nieuw domein. We brengen onze content samen in Prepr als centrale bron en bepalen de koers voor onze online tools. Ook willen we onze content beter beschikbaar maken via API’s, onze analyse van data versterken en onze zichtbaarheid in Google en toepassingen van AI verder ontwikkelen.In je eerste jaar werk je toe naar een duidelijke roadmap voor onze digitale diensten, meetbare doelen en een helder beeld van de investeringen die nodig zijn voor onze belangrijkste websites en tools.Wat neem je mee?*Je bent een ervaren digitale professional die het grotere geheel ziet. Je begrijpt hoe systemen, websites, tools, data en leveranciers met elkaar samenhangen en kunt digitale en technologische ontwikkelingen vertalen naar een duidelijke koers.Tegelijk ben je een mensgerichte leidinggevende. Je geeft professionals ruimte en vertrouwen, maar durft ook richting te geven, prioriteiten te stellen en besluiten te nemen. Je creëert een open en professionele teamcultuur waarin mensen zich kunnen ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid nemen.Daarnaast:Heb je meerdere jaren ervaring in een senior digitale functieHeb je ervaring met het aansturen van digitale professionalsOverzie je een digitaal landschap met websites, systemen, tools, data en externe leveranciersKun je strategisch denken én de vertaalslag maken naar uitvoeringVolg je ontwikkelingen rond onder andere data, AI, SEO en GEO en kun je beoordelen welke daarvan relevant zijn voor onze organisatieKun je sturen op capaciteit, planning en budgetBen je communicatief sterk en weet je draagvlak te creërenBlijf je ook bij drukte of complexe vraagstukken rustig, scherp en besluitvaardig* Uit onderzoek blijkt dat sommige mensen pas reageren als ze (bijna) alle criteria hierboven afvinken. We geloven in groei en ontwikkeling.Wat bieden wij?Milieu Centraal is het kenniscentrum voor duurzaam leven. Wij delen betrouwbare en onafhankelijke kennis, adviezen en praktische tips over duurzaam leven. Processen zijn bij ons niet in beton gegoten; zo blijven we wendbaar en innovatief. Vertrouwen, een open communicatie en teamspirit zijn voor ons heel belangrijk. We willen een diverse en inclusieve werkplek zijn waar iedereen welkom is. Bij ons gaan professionaliteit en werkplezier hand in hand. Kortom, kies je voor Milieu Centraal? Dan kies je voor maatschappelijk relevant werk, een prettige werkomgeving en een goede balans tussen werk en privé.En wij bieden nog meer:Een brutosalaris variërend van € 4.668 tot en met € 6.940 per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. We ontvangen je cv en motivatie graag. Stuur ze ons uiterlijk zondag 13 september 2026 onder vermelding van ‘teamleider’Heb je vragen over deze vacature?Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Neem dan contact op met ons hr-team via vacatures@milieucentraal.nl.Iedereen is welkomMilieu Centraal wil een organisatie zijn die de diversiteit van de samenleving weerspiegelt.
