description: In het kortWord Business Analyst Passenger Revenue Data en stap aan boord van een functie waar jouw analytische talent direct bijdraagt aan het succes van een iconisch wereldwijd merk: KLM. In deze rol sta je aan het roer van cruciale inkomstenanalyses en optimaliseer je de passagiersstroom door middel van slimme data-inzichten. Je komt terecht in een innovatieve omgeving waar de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse en luchtvaart samenkomen. Durf jij de uitdaging aan om jezelf en onze processen elke dag te overtreffen?Wat ga je doen?Als Business Analyst combineer je jouw diepgaande proceskennis van de complexe wereld van passagiersvervoer met cutting-edge data skills. Je bent de brug tussen business en data, en een onmisbare schakel in het vinden van scherpe, datagedreven oplossingen voor strategische vraagstukken van diverse stakeholders, binnen én buiten je afdeling.Je duikt in onze omvangrijke databronnen, waaronder core applicaties zoals de Operational Data Store (ODS) en SIRAX, en navigeert behendig door downstream MIS-applicaties als de Financial Data Hub (FDH) en het Joint Revenue Datawarehouse (JRDWH). Ervaring met vergelijkbare complexe data-omgevingen en BI-tools is hierbij essentieel.Concreet ga je de volgende uitdagingen aan:Impactvolle rapportages: Je bent de spil in het tijdig en accuraat opleveren van cruciale rapportages binnen KLM Business Support, die de basis vormen voor belangrijke beslissingen.Innovatie aanjagen: Je signaleert proactief kansen voor optimalisatie en werkt actief mee aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde rapportages en analyse tools.Kennis delen: Je participeert actief in de Air France KLM Data Management Community, waar je kennis deelt en opdoet over de nieuwste trends en best practices.Future-proof: Je blijft scherp op de laatste ontwikkelingen in data analytics en vertaalt deze naar innovatieve oplossingen en kansen voor KLM Business Support.Waar land je?Je landt in het dynamische IMO team van KLM Business Support in Amstelveen. Hier werk je zij aan zij met 6 Business Analysts en 3 Functional Application Managers. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor de innovatie en continuïteit binnen Passenger Revenue Controlling. Dit team biedt een inspirerende omgeving vol kennisdeling en samenwerking.Een deel van de Passenger Revenue Controlling processen is ondergebracht in ons Financial Shared Service Center in Toulouse, waar je, indien nodig, de mogelijkheid hebt om naartoe te reizen voor afstemming en projecten. Een mooie kans om ook internationaal je netwerk uit te breiden!Jouw profielJij bent een analytische denker met een scherp oog voor detail en een brede helicopterview. Je bent intrinsiek gedreven om processen te optimaliseren, kansen te spotten en met vernieuwende, creatieve ideeën te komen om de data-analyse naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Samenwerken met collega's en andere afdelingen is voor jou vanzelfsprekend; je bent een inspirerende teamspeler die graag kennis deelt en successen boekt.Je bent niet alleen oplossingsgericht, maar ook pragmatisch ingesteld: je weet prioriteiten te stellen en overzicht te bewaren, zelfs wanneer je werkt aan complexe projecten en de winkel gewoon open moet blijven.Verder beschik je over:Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Business Analytics, Data Science of een vergelijkbare discipline.Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in data analytics, business intelligence of revenue controlling, bij voorkeur binnen een complexe, internationale organisatie.Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een aantoonbare passie voor data; je ademt een data-driven mindset.Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je kunt complexe analyses helder uitleggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken én te gedijen in een team.Een uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.CompetentiesProbleemanalyseAandacht voor kwaliteitKlant- en servicegerichtheidWerken in teamverbandWat bieden wij?Een uitdagende rol bij een uniek Nederlands bedrijf;Een brutosalaris tussen € 3.796,93 en € 5.424,18 bruto per maand;Volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en mooie doorgroeimogelijkheden;Een uitstekende pensioenregeling;8% vakantiegeld;Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% Een regeling voor winstdeling, tot 20%;25 vakantiedagen en 5 extra vrije dagen;Fikse korting op vliegtickets (als je minimaal 6 maanden in dienst bent);Een duurzaam vervoersbeleid, met o.a. 100% gratis reizen naar het werk met het Openbaar Vervoer (binnen Nederland);Als je functie dit toelaat: thuiswerken en tot 8 weken werken vanuit het buitenland (EU en Caribisch gebied);Korting op je ziektekostenverzekering;Een budget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid.Ready for your next destination?Wacht dan niet langer, en solliciteer voor de ‘final boarding call’ op 17-08-2026!Je hoeft geen motivatiebrief te schrijven; tijdens je online sollicitatie stellen we je enkele gerichte vragen. Je sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken en mogelijk een assessment/capaciteitentest en een veiligheidsonderzoek. Kandidaten die positief worden geselecteerd voor het eerste gesprek ontvangen een e-mail waarin zij zelf een geschikt tijdslot kunnen kiezen voor het interview.Zo houden we het proces snel en overzichtelijk, en heb jij regie over je planning. Binnen twee weken na sluiting van de vacature hoor je van ons.Via je persoonlijke kandidaatprofiel kun je op elk moment inloggen. Hier vind je de vacature waarop je hebt gesolliciteerd - ook nadat deze is gesloten - én een overzichtelijk dashboard met eventuele andere lopende sollicitaties binnen KLM, inclusief statusupdates.Heb jij de drive om in deze rol verder te groeien? Dan kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie.Wist je dat volgens onderzoek vrouwen minder graag solliciteren dan mannen, als ze niet aan alle functie-eisen voldoen? Zonde. Want ‘de perfecte kandidaat’ is wat ons betreft een fabeltje. Dus heb jij de drive om op enkele aspecten in deze rol nog te groeien? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie.Een referentiecheck kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description: Are you driven by data and excited to improve how supply chains perform at scale? Do you enjoy turning insights into real business impact? Then this could be a great opportunity for you!We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst who can optimize our end-to-end supply chain by transforming data into actionable insights that drive smarter decisions, faster execution, and operational excellence. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of analytics, planning, and business performance, partnering with stakeholders to improve forecast accuracy, enhance supply chain resilience, streamline processes, and identify opportunities that fuel sustainable growth and customer satisfaction.Your roleYou will work closely with supply chain leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across markets, translating data into clear insights and actionable improvements.Your Specific Tasks IncludeWork on high-impact initiatives that balance service levels, availability, and working capital, while proactively identifying improvement opportunities and implementing changes that deliver measurable impact.Partner with stakeholders to support better decision-making in S&OP and S&OE processes, translating complex supply chain challenges into clear insights and practical solutions.Drive data-driven analyses to improve supply chain performance, including forecast accuracy, planning adherence, and operational efficiency.Identify trends, risks, and opportunities in demand, inventory, and supply performance to support continuous improvement.Design and build dashboards, models, and analyses that provide transparency and control across the supply chain.Your teamYou'll become part of our Supply Chain Excellence team, reporting to the Manager Supply Chain Excellence. The team consists of three Business Analysts based across the Netherlands and Poland, working closely together to support Supply Chain teams throughout Kramp's international organization.Rather than owning fixed domains, the team works collaboratively, sharing knowledge and supporting each other across different analytical topics, dashboards and improvement initiatives. This means you'll have the opportunity to develop broad expertise while working with stakeholders from multiple countries and business functions.As this is a group function, you'll collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across Europe.Who are you?For This Role, We Have a Few Key RequirementsCompleted Master’s degree with 1–4 years of experience in analytics, supply chain, or a similar roleStrong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into business valueHands-on experience with tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, or Power BICurious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvementClear communicator who can simplify complexity and feels comfortable working with stakeholders and influencing decisions through insights What do we offer?We're an ambitious, fast-growing and financially strong organization. Naturally, you can expect:25 vacation days and 12 ADV days (based on a full-time contract)Flexible working policy in hours and locationTravel and working-from-home allowanceProfit sharing bonusGreat budget for training and developmentAttractive pension planProcedure If this role and its requirements excite you, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply via the application button and submit your CV and motivation letter.Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you're a strong fit, we encourage you to apply and tell us why.About UsThanks to our ambitions we are active throughout Europe: a leading position in the agricultural market for parts. We heavily invest in E-Business and innovations. Our aim is to make it easy for our customers to run their business. Working at Kramp means working with over 3500 international colleagues. The people at Kramp are enthusiastic, professional and involved. We speak our customers' language, understand their challenges and earn their trust to exceed their expectations. Our promise It's that easy is embedded in our culture and DNA.Working At Kramp Means… you belong here! Being part of our open business community… your work makes a difference! Have an impact on what matters… you will develop and realize! Learn and realize your potentialMore about Kramp: https://group.kramp.com/en/careersVarsseveld (NL)Location:Utrecht (NL)

title: Data analist
description: Als Data Analist vertaal je data naar heldere inzichten die organisaties echt verder helpen. title: HR Data Analyst
description: Jouw baanRijen en kolommen? Jij ziet verhalen, verbanden en kansen. Als Data Analyst bij VZ – in het HR Technology & Insights-team – ben jij de codekraker van onze HR-data. Jij vertaalt cijfers naar inzichten waarop collega’s kunnen bouwen. Je bouwt slimme dashboards en rapportages. Deze zijn niet alleen accuraat, maar ook logisch opgebouwd en gebruiksvriendelijk. Van standaardrapportages tot ad-hocvragen: jij zorgt voor automatisering, zodat collega’s steeds vaker zelf met data aan de slag kunnen. Je werkt aan schone, betrouwbare datasets en zorgt ervoor dat we blijven voldoen aan de privacyregels. Kortom: jij maakt van data geen doel, maar een springplank voor betere keuzes.Dit breng jij meeJij houdt van orde in de chaos. Je krijgt er energie van als alles klopt: van de berekeningen en analyses tot de vertaling van inzichten naar duidelijke visualisaties en de logica achter het verhaal. Je begrijpt wat anderen willen weten, ook als zij hun vraag nog niet goed kunnen formuleren. En je weet dat goede data analyse net zo goed over mensen gaat als over getallen.Gaat dit over jouJe bent analytisch Hoofd- of bijzaak? Dat verschil zie jij meteen. Je komt makkelijk tot de kern en houdt tegelijk het overzicht.Je bent in control Doelen zijn er om behaald te worden, daar zorg jij wel voor. Je delegeert, houdt overzicht en plant realistisch.Je spreekt begrijpelijke taal Als je iets zegt, zorg je dat de ander het ook begrijpt. Je spreekt duidelijk en vlot, en kunt goed presenteren.Je wilt presteren Jij weet wat je wilt, en hoe je het wilt bereiken. Daarvoor geef je alles. Je stelt doelen en gaat ervoor.Je zet inzicht om in actie Cijfers en feiten vormen de basis van je beslissingen. Je bent kritisch en maakt slimme keuzes om inzichten om te zetten in actie.Je ziet het grote geheel Jij bent vaak drie stappen verder dan de rest en houdt van snel schakelen. Je ziet overal verbanden en bedenkt inventieve oplossingen.Dit krijg je van onsSalaris dat groeit Bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.800 en €5.900 met individueel groeiperspectief én een collectieve verhoging van 2,8% in januari 2027.Extra flexibel budget Benefit Budget van 14,95% (incl. vakantiegeld) bovenop je brutosalaris. Laat het elke maand uitbetalen, koop extra vakantiedagen of spaar het op.20 vakantiedagen Standaard krijg je 20 vrije dagen. Wil je er meer? Die koop je bij van je Benefit Budget.Je eigen feestdagen Ruil je verlof op Hemelvaartsdag en Tweede Pinksterdag om voor dagen die juist voor jou feestelijk zijn.Leren zoveel je kunt Trainingen om je skills te verbeteren, een eigen job coach en duizenden andere gratis opties om je te blijven ontwikkelen.Vodafone abonnement Je kunt je zakelijke nummer ook privé gebruiken en we sponsoren je nieuwe toestel met €425,-. Elke 2 jaar opnieuw.NS-Business Card naar keuze Altijd eersteklas reizen, ook als je vrij bent. Tram, bus én stallen op rekening zijn natuurlijk inclusief.Nog meer voordeel Elk jaar budget voor je zorgverzekering, sportabonnement of kinderopvang. Bij verduurzaming van je huis krijg je zelfs meer.

title: Data Management Specialist
description: Door jouw analytische aanpak maak je data betrouwbaarder, consistenter en beter toepasbaar in besluitvorming.Met jouw verbindende manier van werken breng je business, processen en data dichter bij elkaar.Door duidelijke definities, standaarden en KPI’s te borgen, creëer je vertrouwen in bedrijfskritische data.Bij Quooker geloven we dat goede data essentieel is voor groei, innovatie en betere besluitvorming. Als Data Management Specialist speel jij een sleutelrol in het verder professionaliseren van ons datalandschap. Je zorgt ervoor dat data betrouwbaar, consistent en bruikbaar is en helpt de organisatie om datagedreven te werken op basis van heldere definities, standaarden en kwaliteitsnormen.Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit verschillende disciplines en vormt de verbindende schakel tussen business, processen en data. Daarbij analyseer je datasets binnen Microsoft Fabric, ontwikkel je meetmethoden voor datakwaliteit en vertaal je inzichten naar concrete verbeterinitiatieven. Je bewaakt de voortgang, maakt resultaten inzichtelijk en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen aantoonbaar bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van onze belangrijkste data-assets.Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van data- en KPI-definities. Je adviseert businessanalisten en andere stakeholders over datastandaarden, governance en kwaliteitsvraagstukken en zorgt ervoor dat beleid, richtlijnen en afspraken actueel blijven. Dankzij jouw expertise ontstaat meer vertrouwen in data en groeit de datavolwassenheid van de organisatie.Je bent niet alleen bezig met het signaleren van verbeterkansen, maar ook met het creëren van draagvlak. Je weet complexe datavraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en helpt teams om datakwaliteit structureel onderdeel te maken van hun manier van werken.Je maakt onderdeel uit van ons Data Competence Center, waar je samenwerkt met ervaren architecten en data & analytics engineers. In deze omgeving krijg je volop ruimte om kennis uit te wisselen, jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van data management binnen Quooker.Wat mag je van ons verwachten?Een cultuur waar jij centraal staat doordat we waardering & feedback durven uit te spreken zodat je precies weet waar je aan toe bent.Investering in jouw ontwikkeling door opleidingen en maatwerk coaching.Hybride werken en dat betekent 4 dagen in Ridderkerk en 1 dag thuis.Een unieke werkomgeving waar je jouw ideeën in de praktijk werkelijkheid ziet worden.Werken met een duurzaam product en het recyclen van oude producten (tip: luister deze aflevering van ‘Op Stoom’ de podcast over onze uitdagingen op het gebied van circulariteit). Elke dag gratis vers fruit en gezonde, betaalbare bites in ons bedrijfsrestaurant.Borrels, uitjes en feesten.Vitaliteitsprogramma en sportvergoeding van €25,- per maand.27 vakantiedagen en een optie om 10 dagen jaarlijks bij te kopen zodat jij vitaal blijft.Een fijne personeelskorting waarmee jij het gemak van een Quooker thuis kunt ervaren.Over jouw teamHet Business Intelligence & Information Management (BI & IM) team bestaat uit een manager BI & Information management, zes business analisten, en een Data team (bestaande uit een DCC Team Lead, twee Data / BI specialist, en een Lead Data Engineer). Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor de digitale transformatie van Quooker en een gedegen inrichting van het IT/data landschap & -processen.Het team werkt nauw samen met de IT-afdeling, interne stakeholders en externe partners. Feitelijk is de BI&IM afdeling de linking pin tussen de business en IT (partners) om van een functionele vraag naar een werkende oplossing of werkwijze te komen.HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van Business Information Management, Informatica, Business Analytics, Data Science of vergelijkbaar.Ervaring met data governance, datakwaliteit, datadefinities en/of KPI-management.Kennis van moderne data-platformen, bij voorkeur Microsoft Fabric, en ervaring met het analyseren en verbeteren van datasets.Sterk analytisch vermogen en in staat om complexe datavraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete verbeterinitiatieven.Communicatief sterk en ervaren in stakeholdermanagement; je weet business, processen en data met elkaar te verbinden.

title: Researcher (LNG Industry)
description: Would you like to be part of a team that delivers value through effective analysis?Would you like to join our great analysis team?About The BusinessAt ICIS, our mission is to optimize the world’s resources. We help companies make strategic, sustainable decisions by bringing transparency to markets across the world. We create a comprehensive view of commodities markets, providing companies with the data and intelligence to successfully navigate across global value chains every day. Our customers benefit from instant access to price assessments, reports and forecasts, a dedicated news channel and supply and demand data. You can learn more about ICIS at the link below. https://www.icis.com/exploreAbout The TeamWelcome to the LNG Analytics team, part of the wider ICIS Gas and LNG Analytics organisation. Based in Asia, our team is responsible for maintaining and continuously enhancing our LNG products, while developing and managing global LNG supply, demand, and gas datasets and forecasts. Beyond our analytical work, we represent ICIS as LNG subject matter experts at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and other commercial engagements. We work closely with colleagues across the wider Gas Analytics team to ensure our data, forecasts, and market insights are aligned, consistent, and deliver a unified view of the global gas and LNG markets. As a member of the team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to market-leading analysis, collaborate with experts across regions, and help shape the future direction of ICIS's LNG analytics offering.About The RoleThis role will primarily focus on the China gas and LNG market, although you will also be expected to support analysis across other countries and markets as business needs evolve.Your day-to-day responsibilities will include monitoring market developments through news, industry contacts, and other information sources to understand key market drivers and events. You will gather and validate data to support market analysis, maintain and improve our datasets, and run internal forecasting models to produce monthly supply, demand, and price outlooks.A significant part of the role involves producing high-quality analytical content. You will regularly write market insight articles, prepare presentations, and create clear data visualisations to communicate complex market trends effectively. Strong storytelling through data and visuals is an important aspect of the role. You will also respond to client enquiries on a regular basis, providing timely, accurate, and insightful market analysis.Maintaining the integrity of our data is fundamental to everything we do. You will be expected to perform regular data validation, quality checks, processing, and clean-up to ensure our forecasts and analysis remain robust and reliable.In addition to strong analytical skills, you should be comfortable communicating with both internal and external stakeholders. You will work closely with analysts and editors within the LNG Analytics team, as well as colleagues across other ICIS teams, to produce high-quality market analysis, news, and thought leadership that delivers value to our clients.ResponsibilitiesTo maintain existing LNG analytics products which includes forecast, LNG data processing and enhancements.To drive ICIS analytics through analysis and content creation such as articles, presentations, research and white papers.To work with wider teams such as editorial, sales, commercial in the common goal to pursue greater level of interest in ICIS products, thought leadership and contentTo support existing clients queries and business use for ICIS products and services.RequirementsFluent in Mandarin and EnglishBachelor/Master degree in relevant areaA motivated individual who can demonstrate their interest in the Gas & LNG marketProven analytical and visualization skillsAttention to detail and high level of proficiency with Microsoft ExcelAn independent thinker with a pro-active mentality. Curious to learn Gas and LNG market related happenings and how it all relates to each otherExcellent communication skills and an aptitude for building contacts and networksExperience with forecast modelling software and methodologies would be an advantageWe know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping both our internal analytics and the customer-facing data products we bring to market. Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn are essential.Experience with product and business event tracking — including defining business events, understanding product flows, and identifying the signals that drive meaningful analytics.Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and an interest in applying them to build and iterate on data pipelines, models, and analytics products more efficiently.Great knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data warehouse concepts.Proficiency in Python for analytics and statistics.Experience building or contributing to customer-facing data products is a plus (embedded analytics, data APIs, or AI-based self-service tools).Strong communication skills and commercial awareness — able to simplify complex insights, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and manage diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Finance.Experience in fintech domains — such as payments, PSPs and checkout is a plus.Fluent in English; German is a plus.BenefitsPaid time off – 30 vacation days.A competitive salary.A personal training and development budget of €1,500 per year.Responsibility and trust from day one.Individual coaching and further training to support you in your development.A free BVG ticket.Employee discounts at numerous companies (e.g. at the gym or in online stores).Pension program with company match up to 30% of employee contributions.A culture of equity and inclusion where you are appreciated for the person you are.Diversity & InclusionAt ablefy, we embrace our differences, as they are our greatest strength. We recognize that everyone has a unique perspective based on their experiences, identities, and thought processes, and we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. Discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or any other aspect that makes you unique is not tolerated at ablefy. We aim to make growth accessible to everyone!We know that no candidate checks every single box, and that’s okay! If you’re excited about this role and think you can bring something valuable to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’d love to hear from you!AI at ablefyAs an AI-first company, we put intelligent technology at the heart of everything we do. AI is part of how we build, learn, and grow together. It helps us work smarter, move faster, and focus on creating real impact. We believe the strongest results come from combining thoughtful technology with curious, driven people — and we’re excited to shape what’s next, together.

title: Data Scientist, Music DISCO
description: DescriptionAmazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.We are seeking a highly skilled and analytical Data Scientist. You will play an integral part in the measurement and optimization of Amazon Music marketing activities. You will have the opportunity to work with a rich marketing dataset together with the marketing managers. This role will focus on developing and implementing models that aids in audience segmentation, AI-enablement in data/reporting, and assessing randomized controlled trials to rate marketing effectiveness. This role is suitable for candidates with strong background in cohort analysis, causal inference, statistical analysis, and data-driven problem-solving, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. As a key member of our team, you will work closely with cross-functional partners to optimize marketing strategies and drive business growth.Key job responsibilitiesDevelop Causal & Predictive ModelsBuild and validate causal and predictive models that quantify how marketing and lifecycle programs affect customer retention, engagement, and subscriber growth for Amazon Music. Own the team's models end to end.Statistical Analysis at ScaleAnalyze large customer datasets using SQL and Python or R to interpret results and uncover meaningful patterns, grounding your work in trusted, well-governed data.Enable Data-Driven DecisionsPartner with marketing and finance stakeholders to deliver recommendations that improve retention and return on investment. Prioritize the work with the greatest impact on customer growth, and present findings clearly to both technical and executive audiences.Bring AI into Self-Service ToolsPartner with product managers and engineers to incorporate AI and machine learning into the team's self-service analytics tools, so stakeholders can answer their own questions faster and at greater scale.Cross-Functional Problem SolvingWork across marketing, product, and engineering teams to frame key business questions and build credible analytical solutions.Innovate & DocumentTrack emerging methods and apply them to improve measurement; maintain reproducible documentation and clear reporting for non-technical audiences.Basic Qualifications Experience working as a Data Scientist Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent) Experience with machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environmentPreferred Qualifications Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology companyAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. description: L’IFIP est un organisme professionnel de R&D et d’innovation au service de tous les métiers de la filière porcine. professionnels.Participer, selon les projets, à des études collectives et travaux de prospective en lien avec les transformations des filières agroalimentaires et des attentes consommateurs.Missions title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics at Picnic is a two-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket.We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.Tricks of the tradeLead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.From learning to leadingThroughout the two-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, the pace is yours to set, and there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.Where you’ll make an impactFrom day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnic: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much moreYour superpowersYou don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.More specifically, you:Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative fieldHave experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships.Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being askedThink like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutionsYou have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages EU citizenship or valid EU working permit required.Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.Why Picnic?Grow as we grow. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours.Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic.When are you joining? Fall Edition 2026 Start dates: September, Octoberearlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application questionSpring Edition 2027 Start dates: February, Marchearlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question📍 Location: Full-time in Paris, with period trips to NL and DEThere is no deadline: Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride.Picnic Perks🚲Health and TransportationThrough our partnerships with Malakoff Humanis and OpenUp, you have the opportunity to enroll in our company health insurance plan, as well as free and easy access to professional psychologists, workshops, and practical tools. Additionally, if you commute to work using public transportation, we reimburse 50% of your subscription cost.🍉FoodSince we are located in the center of Paris, there is no on-site cafeteria. However, you will receive meal vouchers worth €11 per day to explore all the delicious restaurants nearby. Our small kitchen is also stocked with tasty snacks and refreshments.📈Personal and Professional DevelopmentYou will have the opportunity to develop your skills not only through exciting projects and a dynamic environment but also via training programs offered by Lepaya.🏖️All the restYou get 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional rest days (RTT) based on the number of days worked in the year. Picnic provides you with a laptop, a phone, and a paid SIM card.🚀Access to exclusive deals and perks through our Works Council (CSE) and our partner Swile (gift cards, concert tickets, cinema discounts, and more)FAQDo I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover.Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

description: Tereos figure parmi les leaders des marchés du sucre, de l'alcool et de l'amidon. En 2024/2025, Tereos a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 5,93 milliards d'euros.Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur tereos.comCe poste en Data Science est intégré à l'équipe Market Research et joue un rôle clé dans le développement d'outils et d'analyses soutenant la prise de décision au quotidien.Le candidat idéal adopte une approche très opérationnelle, prêt à plonger dans la data, construire des modèles, créer des visualisations et produire des analyses actionnables selon les besoins. Il évolue avec aisance dans un environnement dynamique et est motivé par l'impact immédiat de son travail.À ce titre, les missions couvrent l'ensemble des activités liées à la création de pipelines de données, la mise en place de modèles, le reporting et les outils digitaux, afin de générer de nouveaux insights, d'améliorer la fiabilité des analyses existantes et d'apporter plus d'agilité dans la consolidation et l'analyse des données de marché.Le poste est rattaché directement au Responsable Market Research.Missions principales :Définir des méthodologies et des bonnes pratiques sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée : collecte, analyse, modélisation, gestion des versions, documentation, tests et suivi.Collaborer avec les responsables des différents domaines d'études pour identifier les besoins et faire évoluer les analyses.Accompagner les analystes de l'équipe Market Research sur les questions techniques et liées aux marchés.Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les experts métiers pour concevoir et déployer des solutions compréhensibles et utilisables par des interlocuteurs non techniques au sein de Tereos.Être le point de contact et collaborer avec les équipes IT et les responsables des outils commerciaux sur les sujets liés aux nouveaux développements, à la maintenance, à la gestion des incidents, ainsi qu'à l'ensemble des systèmes et outils digitaux.Développer et maintenir des pipelines de données automatisés pour l'ingestion, le nettoyage et la transformation (ETL/ELT) à partir de sources multiples (API, bases de données, fichiers Excel, etc.).Gérer et optimiser les bases de données utilisées par l'équipe Market Research en garantissant leur performance et leur scalabilité.Développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord (Power BI, Streamlit, Excel, etc.).Concevoir des modèles prédictifs et statistiques pour anticiper les prix, la consommation, la météo, les flux commerciaux, les opportunités d'arbitrage et d'autres indicateurs.Tester, valider et suivre les modèles à l'aide d'indicateurs de performance adaptés.Automatiser les processus analytiques et mettre en place des pipelines de machine learning, de l'entraînement au déploiement.Contribuer aux demandes ponctuelles et aux activités récurrentes afin de fournir de nouvelles analyses et garantir le respect des délais de livraison de l'équipe.Assurer un rôle de backup, si nécessaire, lors des routines et des présentations de l'équipe marché.Data Scientist / Data Analyst orienté métiers et marchés des commodities, disposant d'une solide expertise en data science, machine learning, title: Knowledge Analyst - Private Capital
description: Who You'll Work WithDriving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.When you join us, you will have:Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. title: Senior Research Analyst
description: OverviewIf you've spent time studying or working outside Japan and you're ready to put that global perspective to work, this role was built for you. Japan's IT services market is one of the most complex and distinctive in the world — and IDC needs analysts who can read it from the inside while connecting it to what's happening globally. That combination is rare, and it's exactly what makes this role compelling.About The RoleThis is an opportunity to shape how the world understands Japan's IT services market — and to do it from Tokyo, at the center of one of Asia-Pacific's most dynamic technology ecosystems.As a Research Analyst on IDC Japan's Services team, you will lead original research on Japan's IT services landscape, with a particular focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and domestic local vendors that define much of the market's character. You will contribute to two flagship IDC programs — the Japan Services CIS program and the Worldwide Semiannual Services Tracker — and collaborate closely with IDC's global and Asia-Pacific analyst network. This role is well-suited for candidates who have pursued graduate education internationally and are ready to return to Japan to build a career at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and market intelligence. You will bring a global perspective to a market that is deeply local — and that combination is exactly what our clients need. What You’ll DoResearch & Analysis Lead ongoing research and analysis of Japan’s IT services market, with a focus on mid-tier vendors, system integrators, and local players  Develop market forecasts, vendor share analyses, and demand-side surveys of enterprise IT buyers  Conduct primary research including interviews with IT suppliers and user companies, web surveys, and secondary data analysis  Author high-quality research reports, market perspectives, and vendor assessments for IDC’s syndicated research services Client Engagement & Business Development Provide direct analyst support to mid-tier clients, translating research into actionable guidance  Support business development for cloud-related subscription and custom research services  Present at external industry events and IDC-hosted events on cloud and services market trends  Engage in consulting projects and deliver advisory services to technology vendors and buyers Global Collaboration Partner with IDC’s Asia-Pacific and global services analysts to contribute a Japanese market perspective to IDC’s worldwide thought leadership  Build and maintain relationships with services vendors and system integrators across Japan, especially in the mid-tier and local vendor segments What You BringWe’re looking for candidates who combine analytical rigor, IT market knowledge, and the ability to work fluently across Japanese and international business contexts. There is no single background that defines a strong candidate — we welcome applications from those who bring experience from different angles: IT vendor, system integrator, or consulting firm experience: Background in system development, implementation support, IT solution marketing, or business planning, with solid knowledge of the IT market  Enterprise IT buyer experience: Experience selecting and implementing vendors or systems, or managing technology planning at a client organization, with knowledge of IT products and solutions  Analyst or research background: Experience conducting IT market research, competitive analysis, or technology advisory — particularly relevant for candidates transitioning from other analyst roles Skills & Qualifications Japanese: Native or near-native proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) — required for client-facing research and vendor engagement in Japan  English: Business-level proficiency for collaboration with global IDC teams, international report writing, and external communications  Education: Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) a strong plus, particularly for candidates with international academic experience who are returning to Japan  Analytical tools: Proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables and data modeling), PowerPoint, and Word  Curiosity & rigor: Genuine interest in technology markets, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling insights Why This Role Stands OutAt IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.This is an ongoing talent pipeline posting. We review applications on a rolling basis and extend offers as strong candidates are identified and business needs are confirmed. Submitting your application does not guarantee an immediate opening — but it ensures your profile is considered as opportunities become available. We will reach out if your background is a strong match.What We Offer Individualized Culture: An environment where you can explore new areas outside your specialty and stay engaged with work you enjoy. Hybrid Working: Hybrid working with certain days in office per week/month required. (Depends on Team) Time-off and holidays: On top of your statutory holiday allowance and public holidays, IDC grants annually reviewed company-wide closures on 19 August (Unplug Day) and 24 December – 1 January inclusive (Global Shutdown) and a volunteering day. A position in a highly professional and globally respected market research and advisory firm, where initiative leading to results is rewarded.Equal Opportunity EmployerIDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

title: Senior Reference Data Associate

title: マーケティングディビジョン ブランドマーケティング戦略部：マーケティング戦略担当
description: Job Description楽天・事業についてマーケティングディビジョンは、70以上のサービスを有する楽天グループのメンバーシップバリュー、エコシステムの拡大をミッションに、グループ横断組織としてブランド、クリエイティブ、マーケティング、メンバーシップをリードしております。モバイル領域はエコシステムの根幹を担うプラットフォームと考えており、マーケティングディビジョンとして、楽天モバイルとの連携をより推進しております。部署・サービスについてブランドマーケティング戦略部は楽天モバイル事業においてお客さまが目にする手にする全ての制作物の開発を担当しております。サービスを開始しすでに3年が経ちますが、ブランディング領域は市場動向（ユーザー動向）を見ながら常に改善を目指し進化しております。メンバーの年齢幅も広いですが常にディスカッションできるチーム環境です。案件一つ一つを惰性でなく、また諦めることもなく、より良いものを作り上げる環境とその達成感を味わえる部署です。ブランドマーケティングコミュニケーション課は、楽天モバイルが一般消費者に提供する全サービスを対象に、自社メディア・外部メディア横断で広告コミュニケーション活動を担っています。急成長する重点事業において、戦略立案から実行までのマーケティングコミュニケーション活動を一気通貫で推進しており、ロジカル且つスピード感溢れる業務環境となっております。マーケティング戦略企画グループは、その中でも主にマーケティング戦略やKPIの策定を担いつつ、ユーザー調査の設計や運用と関連するデータ分析を行います。また、それらを会社上層部へレポーティングする役割も担っています。ポジション：募集背景モバイル事業拡大に伴い、プロダクトマーケティング領域の強化に向けた追加採用です。業務内容マーケティング戦略企画グループは下記の業務を推進しており、いずれか一つまたは複数を担っていただきます。・ユーザーニーズ動向のアンケート調査設計、分析・統合的マーケティング戦略の策定・策定したマーケティング戦略の実行チームへの浸透、進行管理・KPI管理・その他各種データ分析・経営層へのレポーティングプレゼンテーション資料の作成は基本的に英語となります。必須要件：事業会またはコンサルティングファームでマーケティングコミュニケーション戦略立案とそれに付随するデータ分析業務5年以上の経験。歓迎要件：調査会社で調査設計や分析業務経験。[ id: cmorec bmd ]#マーケティングディビジョン #marketingdivLanguagesEnglish (総合 - 2 - 中級), Japanese (総合 - 4 - 流暢)

title: Market Research Analyst
description: Modern business enterprises do not operate in a vacuum. Knowing what our customers want and what they don’t want, knowing what our competition canprovide and what they cannot provide, knowing how our markets are acting and anticipating how they will act in the future are all key to establishing a measurable and actionable competitive advantage.INTERDEV is searching for a highly-skilled, meticulous, and motivated Market Research Analyst to work with the marketing department to survey customers, collect competitive intelligence, and analyze autonomously qualitative data, trends, and strategies with the goal of increasing overall competitiveness in our industry. The analyst will assess consumer preferences to help our organization decide how to shape, advertise, and market their products and services.ResponsibilitiesThe Market Research Analyst will:Collect data on consumers, competitors, the industry. and the marketplace and consolidate that data into actionable information, reports, and presentations.Collect, compile, and analyze statistical data using modern and traditional methods.Apply business objectives to design customer surveys and other data collection methods. analytical thinker.Proficiency in math, web analytics, and business research tools.Proven personnel management skills, including the ability to delegate responsibilities, diffuse conflicts, and description: We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Senior Specialist to join our client's team to drive vertical strategy, market intelligence, and profitable growth across Canada. Sitting at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and commercial decision-making, this newly created role focuses on market sizing, market intelligence, and turning complex data into actionable strategy. You will interact regularly with cross-functional teams and present directly to executive leadership, serving as a key driver in evaluating new market dynamics, tariffs, and international growth corridors.In this role, you will take full ownership of analyzing customer insights, lane expansion, and competitive landscapes to guide executive-level decision-making. You will bridge the gap between heavy data analysis and strategic storytelling, using tools like SQL, Python, and Power BI to build dashboards and deliver compelling presentations. The ideal candidate possesses an advanced analytical skillset paired with strong executive presence and the confidence to present strategic insights in person and to cross-functional stakeholders.ResponsibilitiesLead industry vertical and international lane analysis to identify, size, and prioritize growth opportunities and emerging market trends.Conduct market sizing, share-of-wallet, and attainable share assessments using CRM data, digital analytics, and external market intelligence.Quantify and prioritize growth opportunities through corridor-level analysis, trade flows, customer demand, service feasibility, and geopolitical impact (such as tariffs and market shifts).Develop deep insights into customer shipping behavior and demand patterns to inform targeted market and lane expansion strategies.Partner collaboratively with Sales, Pricing, and Revenue Management teams to evaluate conversion potential, competitive positioning, and network decision-making.Lead market intelligence and revenue management initiatives with minimal supervision, presenting findings directly to executives and key internal stakeholders.RequirementsBachelor’s or master’s degree in Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field.6+ years of experience in market intelligence, market sizing, customer insights, strategy, or revenue management (less focused on traditional marketing).Strong hands-on technical proficiency with SQL, Python, and Power BI, with demonstrated experience building quantitative market models and executive dashboards.Strong, native-level understanding of the Canadian market landscape.Proven track record of strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability and confidence to stand up in front of executive audiences to communicate complex analytical findings.Highly collaborative mindset with exceptional interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively across a variety of internal teams.Industry background in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or B2B services is strongly preferred.Ready to shape commercial strategy and drive high-visibility growth? title: Creator Optimization Analyst
description: The roleMost agencies grade ads. We grade brands on how well they operate as creators.The Creator Optimization Analyst owns that judgment. You'll assess how a brand shows up as a creator across Meta, TikTok, and adjacent platforms — what the creative is actually saying, how it's built, where it lands, and where the brand's creator identity is thin, inconsistent, or missing entirely. Then you'll tell the client, in their own language, what to do about it.This is a technical job and a creative job. You'll be in the data every day: pulling performance, structuring creative databases, building tagging systems, running AI-assisted analysis at volume. You'll also be making calls that don't come out of a dashboard — whether a hook works, whether a creator reads as authentic to the brand, whether the messaging is compounding or contradicting itself across a hundred assets. Both halves are the job. Neither one carries it alone.Primary focus is paid, where the volume and the signal live. But creator performance doesn't respect the paid/organic line, and neither will you.What you'll doAssess the client's brand creator identity. This is the center of the role. Apply and extend our Brand Creator Identity (BCI) methodology to judge how a brand is actually performing as a creator in-platform — what identity it projects, whether that identity is consistent, whether it's the right one, and whether it's compounding across paid and organic. You'll set the frameworks that make this assessment repeatable across accounts, and fix them when they stop explaining what you're seeing.Provide the optimizations. Assessment without a recommendation is trivia. Where is the brand over-indexed on one creative identity? Which formats are carrying spend but not conversion? Which creator archetypes have never been tested? What is a competitor doing in-platform that this brand structurally can't do yet? You'll name the gaps in the creator opportunity and say specifically what to make, test, or kill next.Communicate it to clients and lead on the calls. Turn the analysis into a clear point of view and deliver it. You'll build reporting in Figma, write the narrative, and be a key voice on recurring client calls — not a note-taker. Presenting findings, taking hard questions, and steering the conversation from how did last month do to here's what we're changing and why. Insight the client doesn't act on is a failed deliverable.Manage the creative tagging data warehouse. Own the tagging operation end to end. Build and maintain creative catalogues that collapse thousands of ad IDs into the real creative templates underneath them. Use AI to assess and break down every asset — hook, format, talent, setting, messaging beat, brand mention timing, claim type, production tier — so that performance can be read against creative decisions instead of guessed at. You set the taxonomy, define what gets tagged and why, and keep it consistent enough that cross-account patterns actually surface.Work with our creator teams. Findings feed rebriefs. You'll bring insight and feedback directly to strategy, creative, and production — what's working, what's fatiguing, which creators and formats to lean into — then measure whether the next round moved.Who you are3+ years in performance marketing, creative strategy, creative analytics, or a hybrid — enough time in-platform that Meta and TikTok reporting are second nature.Fluent in Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager. You understand attribution, delivery, and why two ads with identical CPMs can behave completely differently.Comfortable with data infrastructure. SQL is a plus; the ability to reason about a data model, spot a bad number, and build a repeatable pull is required.Working with AI tools is already part of how you operate, not something you're curious about trying. You know how to prompt for consistency across thousands of assets and where the output needs a human check.Strong creative instincts and the vocabulary to explain them. You can articulate why a piece of content works without hiding behind it just feels better.Agency experience across multiple concurrent accounts.Notion, Figma, and Hex (or similar BI over a warehouse).Experience working with creators — sourcing, briefing, or producing.Multi-location, franchise, or DTC background.

description: About Keystone Custom HomesKeystone Custom Homes is one of the fastest-growing semi-custom homebuilders on the East Coast, building across Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina. You will run paid media, build the attribution stack, write the queries nobody else can write, and ship AI workflows that make the whole marketing team faster. If the phrase cost-per-LCA by community by creative format makes you lean forward — keep reading. If you have opinions about GA4 event models, Meta optimization objectives, UTM hygiene, Supermetrics query design, and which LLM you'd wire into a lead-routing workflow — we want to talk to you. You will work directly with Sales & Marketing leadership on the highest-leverage questions in the business: where to put the next dollar, which communities are under-supported, and how to build data infrastructure that makes Keystone's marketing function measurably smarter every quarter. Reporting line will be finalized with the hire. This role is hybrid preferred with some days working in our Lancaster, PA office, but remote eligible for the right candidate.What You'll Actually DoPaid Media — Meta, Google, SEO, and Emerging Channels Run and optimize paid media across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and emerging platforms. You are hands-on in Ads Manager and Google Ads every week. Own the strategy behind campaign structure, bidding, audience design, creative testing, and budget allocation across 70+ active communities in five states. Own organic search strategy — technical SEO, community page optimization, keyword coverage across our 74+ communities and 22 floorplans. Test aggressively. Ship experiments weekly. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does. Attribution, Analytics, and Data InfrastructureBuild and maintain the source-of-truth reporting stack across GA4, HubSpot, Salesforce, Supermetrics, and Meta/Google Ads. Untangle multi-touch attribution across a long, considered sales cycle (lead → appointment → sale → close can take months). Write the queries. Build the dashboards. Maintain the pipelines. You are the person who knows why a number changed. Translate data into plain-English recommendations for sales leaders who don't care about event parameters — they care about appointments and sales. AI and Automation Build AI-powered workflows into the marketing stack — lead scoring, content generation, campaign analysis, competitive research, reporting automation. Be a force multiplier for the rest of the marketing team by shipping AI tools they can actually use. Stay on the front edge of what's possible with LLMs, MCP, and automation tooling. We are an AI-forward company and this role is one of the places that shows up most visibly. Budget, ROI, and Strategic Decisions Manage the digital advertising budget. Make the case for where spend should go, defend it with data, and answer for the results. Partner with Sales leadership on community launches, inventory pushes, and market-specific campaigns across PA, MD, VA, NC, and SC. Surface the unsexy-but-important insights: which communities are underperforming, which channels are saturated, where the funnel is actually leaking. What We're Looking ForA data-and-ads person who geeks out. Specifically:4+ years running paid digital campaigns at a senior level — Google Ads, Meta Ads, and ideally one or more of: programmatic, YouTube, or paid social beyond Meta. You can pull up an account and diagnose what's wrong in 20 minutes. Deep GA4 fluency. Event models, conversion setup, custom dimensions, exploration reports, API. Google Tag Manager proficiency is assumed. SQL-level comfort with marketing data. Supermetrics, Looker Studio, BigQuery, or equivalent. You are not afraid of a messy dataset. Attribution literacy. Clear communicator. You can take a 30-tab spreadsheet and turn it into a three-bullet recommendation. You push back when the data says something inconvenient. Nice to Have Experience in homebuilding, real estate, or another considered-purchase industry with a long sales cycle and multi-touch funnel. Google Ads and/or Meta Blueprint certification. Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRMs at the data-model level (not just the UI). Python, R, or similar for ad-hoc analysis. You've shipped a marketing tool or script that your team actually uses. You read one of: Benedict Evans, Stratechery, Marketing Brew, Do You Convert, a good analytics newsletter. You have taste. Keystone has an active AI Task Force and treats AI fluency as a real strategic priority. Your work will fund HOPE International's global microfinance mission. That matters to us and it's not a marketing tagline. for new creative trends, angles, and formats that we can adapt and test.Partner with channel managers – Work as a strategic partner to paid social and search managers, providing them with a steady stream of creative insights to improve their channel performance.Who You Are2+ years of experience in a creative strategy, media buying, or performance marketing role where you were responsible for analysing ad creative performance.An exceptional analytical thinker who has the ability to look at a spreadsheet of ad results and see a compelling story and actionable insights.Highly proficient with native ad platforms (especially Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager) and analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Looker).A natural-born problem solver, driven by an insatiable curiosity to understand why some creative works and other creative fails.An excellent communicator who can translate complex data into a simple, clear, and persuasive narrative for creative- and data-minded title: Optimisation Manager
description: Who We AreWPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. Commercieel inzicht en begrip van hoe retail media waarde geeft aan merken en Coolblue.Dit zoek jij verder in een baanGeld.Met meer dan 30 trainingen in onze eigen Studiefabriek kun je elke dag een beetje beter worden.Korting op alle spullen die we verkopen.Ongekend goede werksfeer. Met collega's waar je blij van wordt, (digitale) epische feesten, pubquizzen en andere teamactiviteiten.25 vakantiedagen. Oké, het is 2 minuten lopen.Een baan bij één van de snelst groeiende bedrijven van de Benelux.Ruimte voor nieuwe initiatieven en ideeën. Daar staan we altijd voor open. Of je nu een week, maand of een jaar bij ons werkt.Uitdagend werk om helemaal in op te gaan, zodat je af en toe vergeet dat je aan het werk bent.Op dit moment werken we thuis wanneer dit mogelijk is. title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description: Hi, I am Ard Raemakers here at GoodHabitz and I am hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist for our newly structured Marketing team!  About this role: As Marketing Automation Specialist at GoodHabitz, you are the engine behind our email and CRM campaigns, and the person actively shaping how AI and workflow automation make our marketing smarter and faster. You thrive at the intersection of hands-on campaign execution and modern tooling: you don't just run automation, you continuously improve it.  You sit within our Digital Performance team - a tight-knit group focused on advertising campaigns, email/CRM, and ongoing support of our go-to-market operations. Working closely with Performance Media, Demand Generation, and RevOps, you make sure campaigns go out the door on time, on target, and built to scale. What you'll do:Run and optimise email & CRM campaigns. Build and improve automated email flows — nurture, onboarding, retention - with segmentation, personalisation and A/B testing. Own campaign calendars from brief to post-send reporting. Own Pardot day-to-day. Manage campaign setup, automation rules and engagement programmes. Monitor deliverability and engagement and work with the CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager on scoring models and journey logic. Flag and fix data issues that affect targeting or reporting. Build AI and workflow automation. Spot repetitive manual work and eliminate it using tools like Make.com and Claude. Create and document multi-step workflows connecting Pardot, Salesforce, advertising platforms and beyond. Bring practical ideas, not hype - to the team's automation roadmap. Track and improve performance. Monitor results across email and automation programmes, analyse what's working, and run structured tests with clear hypotheses and documented outcomes.  This role is for you if you have: Experience in marketing automation, ideally with a background in specialist email marketing; experience in digital advertising is a plus Hands-on experience with Pardot (Account Engagement) Detailled knowledge of Salesforce CRM and how it connects to Pardot Experience with automation tools like Make.com (or similar), and genuine curiosity about AI tools such as Claude Familiarity with advertising platforms (LinkedIn, Google Ads) is a plus Strong written and spoken English; additional languages (Dutch, German, Spanish) are a bonus, not a requirement A data-driven mindset - you understand data and can interpret it to make quick, informed decisions.  This role is not for you if: You'd rather run one steady campaign than juggle several in parallel: This role means keeping multiple workstreams moving without things slipping Manual, repetitive tasks don't bother you: This role is about spotting them and building your way out of them You want to stick with familiar tools: You'll be expected to explore new AI and automation tools and bring practical ideas back to the team You prefer to wait for direction on automation opportunities: This role rewards people who proactively spot what to fix Who we are: GoodHabitz is a B2B SaaS EdTech business making professional development genuinely engaging — for individuals and the organisations that invest in them. With approximately €50M ARR and teams across 10 European countries, the company is building a marketing function capable of producing ambitious, high-quality campaigns at real scale. This role sits within the Digital Performance team: a focused group driving our digital advertising campaigns and email/CRM journeys. The team owns how GoodHabitz reaches, converts and retains prospects through paid and owned digital channels, working closely with regional field marketing to make sure campaigns land where they need to. What we offer: Become part of the leader online training company in the European market, the benchmark in our sector, and help organisations thrive while you grow professionally at a trailblazing company with unstoppable momentum on an exciting growth journey even as others in the industry face challenges. 💰 Competitive salary and role-specific performance bonus because we value your contributions and reward your hard work. 🏖️ Paid time off – 25 days holiday. 🚆 Travel budget. 💻 Flexible work & tools – work in a supportive environment with the comforts you need, plus a laptop. 📈 Growth & development – unlimited access to GoodHabitz resources and MyAcademy to fuel your personal and professional growth. 🧠 Mental coaching – support from our partner, to keep your mind in top shape. 🌍 Diverse & inclusive teams – work with colleagues from across Europe, bringing different cultures, perspectives, and ideas together. 🎉 Themed events & team-building – from creativity workshops to vitality socials, our events are full of energy and fun surprises. 🤝 Annual Do-Good Day – a fully paid day to do volunteer work, alone or with your team, supporting a cause you care about. 🛡️ Pension & insurance – disability and pension coverage for your long-term security.  Ready to be part of our Marketing Team? Apply now and become part of the GoodHabitz experience! Interested and want to find out more? Feel free to reach out to our recruiters by email – recruitment@goodhabitz.com
